function omitUndefined(value: unknown): unknown {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as unknown;
}

function expectValidEnvironmentRegions(room: GeneratedRoom): void {
  const environment = room.encounter.state.environment;
  const regions = [
    ...environment.difficultTerrainRegions,
    ...environment.lightRegions,
    ...environment.obscurementRegions,
    ...(environment.movementRegions ?? []),
  ];
  for (const region of regions) {
    expect(region.id.trim()).not.toBe('');
    expect(region.cells.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  }
}

function d466NonRosterProjection(room: GeneratedRoom): unknown {
  const monsterTokenIndexes = new Map(room.spec.monsterRoster.map((entry, index) => [
    String(entry.tokenId),
    index,
  ]));
  return omitUndefined({
    spec: { ...room.spec, monsterRoster: [] },
    encounter: {
      ...room.encounter,
      state: {
        ...room.encounter.state,
        combatants: room.encounter.state.combatants.filter(
          (combatant) => combatant.profile.kind !== 'monster',
        ).map((combatant) => ({
          ...combatant,
          profile: {
            ...combatant.profile,
            rules: { ...combatant.profile.rules, sizeCategory: legacyFixtureSize(combatant.profile) },
          },
        })),
        tokens: room.encounter.state.tokens.map((token) => {
          const monsterIndex = monsterTokenIndexes.get(String(token.id));
          return {
            ...token,
            placementMode: undefined,
            position: monsterIndex === undefined
              ? token.position
              : {
                  column: room.spec.dimensions.columns - 2 - monsterIndex % 2,
                  row: 1 + Math.floor(monsterIndex / 2) * 2,
                },
          };
        }),
        environment: {
          ...room.encounter.state.environment,
          narrowOpeningRegions: undefined,
        },
        sharedSpaceRelations: undefined,
        adjudicationPending: undefined,
        observationHistory: undefined,
      },
    },
  });
}

function fixtureSize(profile: GeneratedRoom['encounter']['state']['combatants'][number]['profile']): KnownCreatureSize {
  if (profile.kind === 'player_character') return 'Medium';
  const row = BUNDLED_MONSTER_ROSTER.find((candidate) => candidate.id === profile.statblockId);
  const size = row?.statblock.sourceDetails.classification.kind === 'present'
    ? row.statblock.sourceDetails.classification.value.sizes[0]
    : undefined;
  if (size === undefined || !creatureSizes.includes(size as KnownCreatureSize)) {
    throw new Error(`Frozen room references ${profile.statblockId} without an authoritative size.`);
  }
  return size as KnownCreatureSize;
}

function legacyFixtureSize(
  profile: GeneratedRoom['encounter']['state']['combatants'][number]['profile'],
): KnownCreatureSize | undefined {
  if (profile.kind === 'player_character') return undefined;
  const row = BUNDLED_MONSTER_ROSTER.find((candidate) => candidate.id === profile.statblockId);
  const sizes = row?.statblock.sourceDetails.classification.kind === 'present'
    ? row.statblock.sourceDetails.classification.value.sizes
    : [];
  const [size] = sizes;
  return sizes.length === 1 && size !== undefined && creatureSizes.includes(size as KnownCreatureSize)
    ? size as KnownCreatureSize
    : undefined;
}

function footprintWidth(size: KnownCreatureSize): 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 {
  switch (size) {
    case 'Tiny':
    case 'Small':
    case 'Medium': return 1;
    case 'Large': return 2;
    case 'Huge': return 3;
    case 'Gargantuan': return 4;

   216	            hook.effect.payload.payload.kind === 'movement_modifier');

   413	export type D569ExperimentManifest = z.infer<typeof d569ExperimentManifestSchema>;
   414	export type D569ExperimentArm = z.infer<typeof armSchema>;
   415	export type D569ExperimentBasis = 'hard' | 'brutal';
   416	export type D569ExperimentFamily = 'primary' | 'second';
   417	
   418	export interface D569ExperimentValidationAccess {
   419	  readonly readText: (path: string) => string;
   420	  readonly secondFamilyAccess: D569SecondFamilyValidationAccess;
   421	}
   422	
   423	export interface D569ExperimentViolation {
   424	  readonly code: string;
   425	  readonly message: string;
   426	}
   427	
   428	function addViolation(
   429	  violations: D569ExperimentViolation[],
   430	  condition: boolean,
   431	  code: string,
   432	  message: string,
   433	): void {
   434	  if (!condition) violations.push({ code, message });
   435	}
   436	
   437	function canonicalEqual(left: unknown, right: unknown): boolean {
   438	  return canonicalJson(left) === canonicalJson(right);
   439	}
   440	
   441	function expectedPrimarySeeds(difficulty: D569ExperimentBasis): readonly number[] {
   442	  const first = difficulty === 'hard' ? 5_117_001 : 6_203_001;
   443	  return Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => first + index);
   444	}
   445	
   446	function expectedPrimaryDirectory(difficulty: D569ExperimentBasis): string {
   447	  return `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-${difficulty}`;
   448	}

   480	function kbComponentKey(path: string): string {

   484	
   485	/** Exact, model-free validation of the preregistration and all frozen inputs. */
   486	export function validateD569ExperimentManifest(
   487	  input: unknown,
   488	  access: D569ExperimentValidationAccess,
   489	): readonly D569ExperimentViolation[] {
   490	  const decoded = d569ExperimentManifestSchema.safeParse(input);
   491	  if (!decoded.success) return [{ code: 'manifest_shape', message: decoded.error.message }];
   492	  const manifest = decoded.data;
   493	  const violations: D569ExperimentViolation[] = [];
   494	
   495	  addViolation(violations, canonicalEqual(manifest.coreArms, D569_CORE_ARM_IDENTITIES),
   496	    'core_arm_set', 'manifest must contain the exact eight active model/mode arms');
   497	  addViolation(violations, canonicalEqual(manifest.hintArms, D569_HINT_ARM_IDENTITIES),
   498	    'hint_arm_set', 'manifest must contain the three preregistered hint diagnostics');
   499	  addViolation(violations, canonicalEqual(manifest.analysisComparisons, D569_ANALYSIS_COMPARISONS),
   500	    'analysis_comparison_set', 'manifest must contain the amended active and advice-ceiling comparisons');
   501	  addViolation(violations,
   502	    canonicalEqual(manifest.judgePanel.scoringSeats, D569_SCORING_PANEL_IDENTITIES),

   262	function executableCaster(room: GeneratedRoom): boolean {
   263	  return room.spec.monsterRoster.some((entry) => {
   264	    const row = BUNDLED_MONSTER_ROSTER.find((candidate) => candidate.id === entry.statblockId);
   265	    const actions = row?.statblock.sourceDetails.actions;
   266	    return actions?.kind === 'present' && actions.value.some((action) =>
   267	      action.kind === 'spellcasting' && action.execution?.kind !== 'absent' &&
   268	      action.spells.some((spell) => spell.manifestStatus === 'implemented'));
   269	  });
   270	}

   272	function everyMonsterProductive(room: GeneratedRoom): boolean {
   273	  const planningState = freshMonsterPlanningState(room.encounter.state);
   274	  return planningState.combatants
   275	    .filter((combatant) => combatant.profile.kind === 'monster')
   276	    .every((monster) => availableEngineActorOptions(planningState, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)
   277	      .some((option) => {
   278	        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(planningState, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
   279	        return resolution.valid && (resolution.mechanics.movementCostFeet > 0 ||
   280	          resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((slot) =>
   281	            slot.kind === 'attack' || slot.kind === 'saving_throw' || slot.kind === 'cast_spell' ||
   282	            slot.kind === 'use_world_object'));
   283	      }));
   284	}

   286	/** State-derived brutal membership; hashes and creature names alone cannot satisfy it. */
   287	export function brutalRoomMembershipViolations(
   288	  room: GeneratedRoom,
   289	  sameSeedHard: GeneratedRoom = generateRoom(room.spec.seed, { difficulty: 'hard' }),
   290	): readonly D569SecondFamilyViolation[] {
   291	  const violations: D569SecondFamilyViolation[] = [];
   292	  addViolation(violations, room.spec.difficultyProfile === 'brutal', 'brutal_difficulty', 'room is not tagged brutal');
   293	  addViolation(
   294	    violations,
   295	    room.spec.challengeBudgetEighths ===
   296	      sameSeedHard.spec.challengeBudgetEighths * BRUTAL_CHALLENGE_BUDGET_SCALE &&
   297	      room.spec.challengeSpentEighths >= room.spec.challengeBudgetEighths * 0.9 &&
   298	      room.spec.challengeSpentEighths <= room.spec.challengeBudgetEighths,
   299	    'brutal_budget',
   300	    'brutal budget must be scaled from hard and spend 90-100 percent',
   301	  );
   302	  addViolation(
   303	    violations,
   304	    executableCaster(room),
   305	    'brutal_caster',
   306	    'brutal roster must contain an executable implemented caster',
   307	  );
   308	
   309	  const terrainCounts = {
   310	    difficult: room.spec.terrain.filter((feature) => feature.kind === 'difficult-terrain-patch').length,
   311	    hazards: room.spec.terrain.filter((feature) => feature.kind === 'hazard-object').length,
   312	    lights: room.spec.terrain.filter((feature) => feature.kind === 'light-source').length,
   313	    obscurement: room.spec.terrain.filter((feature) => feature.kind === 'obscurement-patch').length,
   314	  };
   315	  const terrainTotal = Object.values(terrainCounts).reduce((total, count) => total + count, 0);
   316	  addViolation(
   317	    violations,
   318	    terrainCounts.difficult >= 3 && terrainCounts.hazards >= 3 && terrainCounts.lights >= 2 &&
   319	      terrainCounts.obscurement >= 2 &&
   320	      terrainTotal >= BRUTAL_TERRAIN_FEATURE_COUNT_BAND.minimum &&
   321	      terrainTotal <= BRUTAL_TERRAIN_FEATURE_COUNT_BAND.maximum &&
   322	      room.spec.terrain.length > sameSeedHard.spec.terrain.length,
   323	    'brutal_terrain',
   324	    'brutal terrain must meet every configured minimum/count band and exceed hard density',
   325	  );
   326	  addViolation(
   327	    violations,
   328	    everyMonsterProductive(room),
   329	    'brutal_productivity',
   330	    'every brutal monster must have a productive first-turn offer',
   331	  );
   332	  return violations;
   333	}

   345	/**
   346	 * Validates the pins only after state membership and two independent canonical
   347	 * regenerations. It is pure/model-free; callers provide repository bytes.
   348	 */
   349	export function validateD569SecondFamilyManifest(
   350	  input: unknown,
   351	  access: D569SecondFamilyValidationAccess,
   352	): readonly D569SecondFamilyViolation[] {
   353	  const decoded = manifestSchema.safeParse(input);
   354	  if (!decoded.success) {
   355	    return [{ code: 'manifest_shape', message: decoded.error.message }];
   356	  }
   357	  const manifest = decoded.data;
   358	  const violations: D569SecondFamilyViolation[] = [];
   359	  addViolation(
   360	    violations,
   361	    manifest.ledgerEntry === D569_SECOND_FAMILY_LEDGER_ENTRY,
   362	    'ledger_evidence',
   363	    'manifest must cite the supervisor ledger entry verbatim',
   364	  );
   365	  addViolation(
   366	    violations,
   367	    sameNamespace(manifest.usedSeedNamespaces),
   368	    'used_seed_ledger',
   369	    'manifest must list every used seed namespace from the supervisor ledger',
   370	  );
   371	  addViolation(
   372	    violations,
   373	    manifest.cohorts.length === 2 && new Set(manifest.cohorts.map((cohort) => cohort.difficulty)).size === 2,
   374	    'cohort_set',
   375	    'manifest must contain exactly one hard and one brutal cohort',
   376	  );
   377	
   378	  const seenSeeds = new Set<number>();
   379	  for (const difficulty of ['hard', 'brutal'] as const) {
   380	    const cohort = manifest.cohorts.find((candidate) => candidate.difficulty === difficulty);
   381	    if (cohort === undefined) continue;
   382	    const expectedSeeds = D569_SECOND_FAMILY_SEEDS[difficulty];
   383	    addViolation(
   384	      violations,
   385	      cohort.directory === expectedDirectory(difficulty),
   386	      'cohort_directory',
   387	      `${difficulty} cohort directory is not the frozen second-family directory`,
   388	    );
   389	    addViolation(
   390	      violations,
   391	      canonicalJson(cohort.fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.seed)) === canonicalJson(expectedSeeds),
   392	      'cohort_seed_range',
   393	      `${difficulty} cohort must contain its exact ten contiguous second-family seeds`,
   394	    );
   395	
   396	    for (const [index, fixture] of cohort.fixtures.entries()) {
   397	      const expectedSeed = expectedSeeds[index];
   398	      addViolation(
   399	        violations,
   400	        !seenSeeds.has(fixture.seed),
   401	        'duplicate_seed',
   402	        `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} appears more than once`,
   403	      );
   404	      seenSeeds.add(fixture.seed);
   405	      for (const namespace of manifest.usedSeedNamespaces) {
   406	        addViolation(
   407	          violations,
   408	          fixture.seed < namespace.start || fixture.seed > namespace.end,
   409	          'seed_overlap',
   410	          `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} overlaps used namespace ${namespace.label}`,
   411	        );
   412	      }
   413	      addViolation(
   414	        violations,
   415	        d466GeneratedRoomOverride(fixture.seed) === null,
   416	        'generator_override',
   417	        `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} is subject to a generator override`,
   418	      );
   419	      if (expectedSeed === undefined || fixture.seed !== expectedSeed) continue;
   420	
   421	      const expectedPath = `${cohort.directory}/seed-${String(fixture.seed)}.json`;
   422	      addViolation(
   423	        violations,
   424	        fixture.path === expectedPath,
   425	        'fixture_path',
   426	        `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} has a non-canonical fixture path`,
   427	      );
   428	      let fixtureBytes: string;
   429	      try {
   430	        fixtureBytes = access.readFixture(fixture.path);
   431	      } catch (error) {
   432	        violations.push({
   433	          code: 'fixture_missing',
   434	          message: `cannot read ${fixture.path}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
   435	        });
   436	        continue;
   437	      }
   438	      addViolation(
   439	        violations,
   440	        sha256(fixtureBytes) === fixture.sha256,
   441	        'fixture_hash',
   442	        `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} fixture hash changed`,
   443	      );
   444	
   445	      try {
   446	        const room = JSON.parse(fixtureBytes) as GeneratedRoom;
   447	        addViolation(
   448	          violations,
   449	          room.spec.seed === fixture.seed,
   450	          'fixture_seed',
   451	          `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} fixture contains a different seed`,
   452	        );
   453	        violations.push(...generatedRoomIntegrityViolations(room, fixtureBytes));
   454	        violations.push(...(difficulty === 'hard'
   455	          ? hardRoomMembershipViolations(room)
   456	          : brutalRoomMembershipViolations(room)));
   457	      } catch (error) {
   458	        violations.push({
   459	          code: 'fixture_parse',
   460	          message: `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} fixture is invalid JSON: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
   461	        });
   462	      }
   463	
   464	      const firstGeneration = access.regenerate(fixture.seed, difficulty, 1);
   465	      const secondGeneration = access.regenerate(fixture.seed, difficulty, 2);
   466	      addViolation(
   467	        violations,
   468	        firstGeneration === fixtureBytes,
   469	        'first_regeneration',
   470	        `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} first canonical regeneration differs from the fixture`,
   471	      );
   472	      addViolation(
   473	        violations,
   474	        secondGeneration === firstGeneration && secondGeneration === fixtureBytes,
   475	        'independent_regeneration',
   476	        `seed ${String(fixture.seed)} independent canonical regeneration differs`,
   477	      );
   478	    }
   479	  }
   480	  return violations;
   481	}

   222	export function heldoutBasisSchedule(protocol: HeldoutOrdinaryProtocol, ordinal: number) {
   223	  const localOrdinal = ordinal % 24;
   224	  const level = (3 + localOrdinal % 4) as HeldoutPartyLevel;
   225	  const targetXp: Readonly<Record<HeldoutPartyLevel, HeldoutTargetXp>> = {
   226	    3: 900, 4: 1_500, 5: 3_000, 6: 4_000,
   227	  };
   228	  const slices = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F'] as const;
   229	  const partition: HeldoutPartition | undefined = protocol === 'heldout-development-v1'
   230	    ? 'development'
   231	    : slices[Math.floor(ordinal / 24)];
   232	  if (partition === undefined) throw new RangeError('Held-out reserve supports six 24-room slices.');
   233	  return {
   234	    partition,
   235	    level,
   236	    targetXp: targetXp[level],
   237	    terrainProfile: Math.floor(localOrdinal / 4) % 2 === 0
   238	      ? 'los_cover_v1' as const
   239	      : null,
   240	  };
   241	}

   742	async function frozenRoomStates(config: ArenaConfig): Promise<readonly import('../src/combat/encounter').EncounterState[]> {
   743	  if (config.basis === 'scenario' && config.rooms !== 1) {
   744	    throw new RangeError('The scenario basis contains exactly one hypnotic-pattern-cc room.');
   745	  }
   746	  if (config.basis === 'scenario' && config.generateMissingRooms) {
   747	    throw new TypeError('--generate-missing-rooms is unavailable for the frozen scenario basis.');
   748	  }
   749	  if (config.basis === 'challenge' && config.generateMissingRooms) {
   750	    throw new TypeError('--generate-missing-rooms is unavailable for the closed challenge basis.');
   751	  }
   752	  const fixturesPath = basisFixturesPath(config);
   753	  return Promise.all(Array.from({ length: config.rooms }, async (_unused, index) => {
   754	    const seed = config.seed + index;
   755	    const fixturePath = resolve(fixturesPath, config.basis === 'scenario'
   756	      ? 'hypnotic-pattern-cc.json'
   757	      : `seed-${String(seed)}.json`);
   758	    try {
   759	      await access(fixturePath);
   760	      if (config.basis === 'challenge') {
   761	        const sidecarPath = resolve(fixturesPath, `seed-${String(seed)}.provenance.json`);
   762	        const sidecar = decodeChallengeRoomProvenanceV1(JSON.parse(await readFile(sidecarPath, 'utf8')) as unknown);
   763	        const room = decodeArenaBasisEnvelopeV1(JSON.parse(await readFile(fixturePath, 'utf8')) as unknown, { mode: 'challenge' });
   764	        if (sidecar.seed !== seed || room.spec.seed !== seed) {
   765	          throw new TypeError(`Challenge sidecar seed ${String(sidecar.seed)} does not match envelope seed ${String(room.spec.seed)}.`);
   766	        }
   767	        if (sidecar.certification !== 'ready_for_witness') {
   768	          throw new TypeError(`Challenge room ${sidecar.roomId} is not ready_for_witness.`);
   769	        }
   770	        return room.encounter.state;
   771	      }
   772	      return applyRoomInitiativeProfile(await loadArenaFixture(fixturePath), config.initiativeProfile);
   773	    } catch (error) {
   774	      if (!config.generateMissingRooms || !(error instanceof Error) ||
   775	        !('code' in error) || error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
   776	      return generateRoom(seed, {
   777	        difficulty: config.basis === 'scenario' || config.basis === 'challenge'
   778	          ? 'standard'
   779	          : config.basis === 'brutal-b'
   780	            ? 'brutal'
   781	            : config.basis,
   782	        initiativeProfile: config.initiativeProfile,
   783	      }).encounter.state;
   784	    }
   785	  }));
   786	}

   142	    if (combatant.life === 'dead') continue;
   143	    if (combatant.profile.kind === 'player_character') break;
   144	    actors.push(combatant.profile.id);
   145	  }
   146	  return actors;

   541	      expect(room.spec.challengeBudgetEighths, `seed ${String(seed)} changed CR budget`).toBe(

   544	      expect(room.spec.challengeSpentEighths, `seed ${String(seed)} changed CR spend`).toBe(

   549	      if (override === undefined) {

   552	          `seed ${String(seed)} roster changed; making the override also fire for 6204005 must fail`,
   553	        ).toBe(D466_6204_PRE_OVERRIDE_ROSTER_DIGESTS[typedSeed]);
   554	        continue;
   555	      }
   556	
   557	      const replacement = d466CreatureReplacement(override.original);
   558	      const replacementEntries = room.spec.monsterRoster.filter(
   559	        (entry) => entry.statblockId === replacement.replacement,
   560	      );
   561	      expect(replacementEntries.length, `seed ${String(seed)} did not receive its replacement`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
   562	      expect(room.spec.monsterRoster.some((entry) => entry.statblockId === replacement.original)).toBe(false);
   563	      for (const entry of replacementEntries) {

   566	          challengeEighths: replacement.crEighths,
   567	        });
   568	        const combatant = room.encounter.state.combatants.find(

   574	        ));

   576	      const restoredRoster = room.spec.monsterRoster.map((entry) =>
   577	        entry.statblockId !== replacement.replacement ? entry : {
   578	          ...entry,
   579	          statblockId: replacement.original,
   580	        });
   581	      expect(
   582	        sha256(canonicalJson(restoredRoster)),
   583	        `seed ${String(seed)} changed sampled roster data beyond the typed id replacement`,
   584	      ).toBe(D466_6204_PRE_OVERRIDE_ROSTER_DIGESTS[typedSeed]);
   585	    }
   586	  });

specs.map(({ id, operation }) => ({\n      ...template,\n      recordId: id,\n      name: id,\n      level: 0,\n      duration: { kind: 'rounds', rounds: 10 },\n      targeting: { kind: 'single', rangeFeet: 150, willing: true },\n      operation,\n    })),\n  });\n  if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Roll-defense fixture refused: ${loaded.refusal.reason}`);\n  return loaded.content;\n}\n\nfunction started(pack: LoadedContentPack, combatants: readonly CombatantProfile[]): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' },\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n    combatants,\n    tokens: combatants.map((profile, index) => placedToken(profile, index)),\n    contentPacks: [pack],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.475).state;\n}\n\nfunction cast(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  actor: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  id: string,\n  selectedOption: string | null = null,\n  modifierSource?: CombatantProfile,\n): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'cast_spell', actor: actor.id, spellId: `greenforge:${id}`, slotLevel: null,\n    castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 8, saveDc: 15,\n    spellcastingModifier: 4, targets: [target.id], area: null, weaponAttack: null,\n    selectedOption,\n    ...(modifierSource === undefined ? {} : { modifierSource: modifierSource.id }),\n  }, () => 0).state;\n}\n\nfunction endTurn(state: EncounterState, actor: CombatantProfile): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: actor.id }, () => 0).state;\n}\n\nfunction rngFaces(...faces: readonly { readonly face: number; readonly sides: number }[]): Rng {\n  let index = 0;\n  return () => {\n    const next = faces[index];\n    if (next === undefined) throw new Error('Test RNG exhausted.');\n    index += 1;\n    return (next.face - 0.5) / next.sides;\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attack(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  actor: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  rng: Rng,\n  attackBonus = 0,\n): { readonly state: EncounterState; readonly events: readonly EncounterEvent[] } {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'attack', actor: actor.id, target: target.id, attackBonus, criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal', attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 1 } }],\n      critical: false, responses: [],\n    },\n  }, rng);\n}\n\nfunction attackEvent(events: readonly EncounterEvent[]) {\n  const event = events.find((candidate) => candidate.type === 'attack_resolved');\n  if (event?.type !== 'attack_resolved') throw new Error('Attack did not resolve.');\n  return event;\n}\n\nfunction fixedDamage(amount: number, type = damageType('Force')): SpellOperation {\n  return {\n    kind: 'damage_operation', delivery: { kind: 'automatic' }, instancesPerTarget: 1,\n    packets: [{\n      damageType: { kind: 'fixed', damageType: type },\n      dice: { baseCount: 0, sides: 4, modifier: amount, perSlotCount: 0, perSlotModifier: 0, cantripUpgrade: false },\n      scaling: { kind: 'none' }, thresholdRider: null,\n    }],\n    timing: { kind: 'immediate' },\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('CAP-IMP-013 imported roll and defense modifiers', () => {\n  it('roll_dice_faces_and_order: Bless/Bane use the lowest and highest faces in stable pre-d20 order, while Guidance is skill-selected', () => {\n    // Bless/Bane: spell-descriptions.txt:670-681,824-837. Guidance: spell-descriptions.txt:4000-4009.\n    const pack = packWithSpells([\n      {\n        id: 'bless-like', operation: {\n          kind: 'roll_dice_modifier', application: 'every_qualifying_roll',\n          tests: ['attack_roll', 'saving_throw'], die: { count: 1, sides: 4 }, sign: 1, duration: twoRounds,\n        },\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'bane-like', operation: {\n          kind: 'roll_dice_modifier', application: 'every_qualifying_roll',\n          tests: ['attack_roll', 'saving_throw'], die: { count: 1, sides: 4 }, sign: -1, duration: twoRounds,\n        },\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'guidance-like', operation: {\n          kind: 'roll_dice_modifier', application: 'chosen_skill_checks',\n          skill: { kind: 'chosen_when_cast', options: ['athletics', 'acrobatics'] },\n          die: { count: 1, sides: 4 }, sign: 1, duration: twoRounds,\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n    const blessing = playerProfile('roll-order-blessing', { initiativeBonus: 40 });\n    const baning = playerProfile('roll-order-baning', { initiativeBonus: 30 });\n    const guided = playerProfile('roll-order-guided', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const defender = monsterProfile('roll-order-defender', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 20 });\n    let state = started(pack, [blessing, baning, guided, defender]);\n    state = cast(state, blessing, guided, 'bless-like');\n    state = endTurn(state, blessing);\n    state = cast(state, baning, guided, 'bane-like');\n    state = endTurn(state, baning);\n    const ordered = attack(state, guided, defender, rngFaces(\n      { face: 1, sides: 4 }, { face: 4, sides: 4 }, { face: 12, sides: 20 },\n    ), 3);\n    expect(attackEvent(ordered.events).attack).toMatchObject({ total: 12, outcome: 'hit' });\n    expect(ROLL_MODIFIER_ORDER).toBe('created_revision_then_effect_id_before_d20');\n\n    const guidanceState = cast(started(pack, [blessing, guided]), blessing, guided, 'guidance-like', 'athletics');\n    const athletics = reduceEncounter(endTurn(guidanceState, blessing), {\n      type: 'roll_ability_check', actor: guided.id, ability: 'strength', skill: 'athletics',\n      bonus: 0, dc: 14, rollMode: 'normal', cost: 'none',\n    }, rngFaces({ face: 4, sides: 4 }, { face: 10, sides: 20 }));\n    const acrobatics = reduceEncounter(endTurn(guidanceState, blessing), {\n      type: 'roll_ability_check', actor: guided.id, ability: 'dexterity', skill: 'acrobatics',\n      bonus: 0, dc: 14, rollMode: 'normal', cost: 'none',\n    }, rngFaces({ face: 10, sides: 20 }));\n    expect(athletics.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'ability_check_resolved', check: expect.objectContaining({ total: 14, outcome: 'success' }),\n    }));\n    expect(acrobatics.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'ability_check_resolved', check: expect.objectContaining({ total: 10, outcome: 'failure' }),\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('resistance_cantrip_faces_and_once_per_turn: the literal SRD 5.2.1 damage reduction uses both d4 boundaries and only the first instance', () => {\n    // Resistance is damage reduction, not a save bonus, in SRD 5.2.1 (spell-descriptions.txt:6540-6552).\n    const pack = packWithSpells([\n      {\n        id: 'resistance-like', operation: {\n          kind: 'damage_dice_reduction',\n          damageType: { kind: 'chosen_when_cast', options: [damageType('Cold'), damageType('Fire')] },\n          die: { count: 1, sides: 4 }, uses: 'once_per_turn', duration: twoRounds,\n        },\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'two-fire-instances', operation: {\n          kind: 'damage_operation', delivery: { kind: 'automatic' }, instancesPerTarget: 2,\n          packets: [{\n            damageType: { kind: 'fixed', damageType: damageType('Fire') },\n            dice: { baseCount: 0, sides: 4, modifier: 6, perSlotCount: 0, perSlotModifier: 0, cantripUpgrade: false },\n            scaling: { kind: 'none' }, thresholdRider: null,\n          }],\n          timing: { kind: 'immediate' },\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n    const warder = playerProfile('resistance-warder', { initiativeBonus: 30 });\n    const attacker = playerProfile('resistance-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = monsterProfile('resistance-target', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n    const run = (face: 1 | 4) => {\n      let state = cast(started(pack, [warder, attacker, target]), warder, target, 'resistance-like', 'Fire');\n      state = endTurn(state, warder);\n      const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n        type: 'cast_spell', actor: attacker.id, spellId: 'greenforge:two-fire-instances', slotLevel: null,\n        castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 8, saveDc: 15,\n        spellcastingModifier: 4, targets: [target.id], area: null, weaponAttack: null,\n        selectedOption: null,\n      }, rngFaces({ face, sides: 4 }));\n      return result.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied').map((event) => event.amount);\n    };\n    expect(run(1)).toEqual([5, 6]);\n    expect(run(4)).toEqual([2, 6]);\n  });\n\n  it('advantage_sources: duplicate sources stay at two dice, one disadvantage cancels them, and Faerie-Fire scope does not affect another target', () => {\n    // General combination: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:493-512. Specific target: spell-descriptions.txt:2887-2900.\n    const pack = packWithSpells([\n      { id: 'general-advantage', operation: { kind: 'roll_mode_modifier', roll: 'attack_roll', mode: 'advantage', scope: { kind: 'target_rolls' }, duration: twoRounds } },\n      { id: 'general-disadvantage', operation: { kind: 'roll_mode_modifier', roll: 'attack_roll', mode: 'disadvantage', scope: { kind: 'target_rolls' }, duration: twoRounds } },\n      { id: 'specific-advantage', operation: { kind: 'roll_mode_modifier', roll: 'attack_roll', mode: 'advantage', scope: { kind: 'attacks_against_target' }, duration: twoRounds } },\n    ]);\n    const first = playerProfile('adv-first', { initiativeBonus: 50 });\n    const second = playerProfile('adv-second', { initiativeBonus: 40 });\n    const third = playerProfile('adv-third', { initiativeBonus: 30 });\n    const attacker = playerProfile('adv-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const marked = monsterProfile('adv-marked', { initiativeBonus: -10, hitPoints: 20 });\n    const unmarked = monsterProfile('adv-unmarked', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 20 });\n\n    let duplicate = started(pack, [first, second, attacker, marked]);\n    duplicate = cast(duplicate, first, attacker, 'general-advantage');\n    duplicate = endTurn(duplicate, first);\n    duplicate = cast(duplicate, second, attacker, 'general-advantage');\n    duplicate = endTurn(duplicate, second);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(duplicate, attacker, marked, rngFaces(\n      { face: 3, sides: 20 }, { face: 15, sides: 20 },\n    )).events).attack.roll).toMatchObject({ 'general-advantage');\n    cancelled = endTurn(cancelled, first);\n    cancelled = cast(cancelled, second, attacker, 'general-advantage');\n    cancelled = endTurn(cancelled, second);\n    cancelled = cast(cancelled, third, attacker, 'general-disadvantage');\n    cancelled = endTurn(cancelled, third);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(cancelled, attacker, marked, rngFaces({ face: 9, sides: 20 })).events).attack.roll)\n      .toMatchObject({ mode: 'normal', faces: [9], chosen: 9 });\n\n    let specific = started(pack, [first, attacker, marked, unmarked]);\n    specific = cast(specific, 20 },\n    )).events).attack.roll.mode).toBe('advantage');\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(specific, attacker, unmarked, rngFaces({ face: 13, sides: 20 })).events).attack.roll.mode)\n      .toBe('normal');\n  });\n\n  it('ac_floor_bonus_boundary: exact AC hits, one below misses, and a Barkskin floor does not add to a Shield-style bonus', () => {\n    // Barkskin floor: duration: twoRounds } },\n      { id: 'ac-bonus', operation: { kind: 'armor_class_modifier', modification: { kind: 'bonus', amount: 2 }, duration: twoRounds } },\n    ]);\n    const floorCaster = initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = playerProfile('ac-target', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 20 });\n    let state = started(pack, [floorCaster, bonusCaster, attacker, target]);\n    state = cast(state, floorCaster, target, 'ac-floor');\n    state = endTurn(state, floorCaster);\n    state = cast(state, bonusCaster, target, 'ac-bonus');\n    state = endTurn(state, bonusCaster);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(state, attacker, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 })).events).attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(state, attacker, target, rngFaces({ face: 17, sides: 20 })).events).attack.outcome).toBe('hit');\n  });\n\n  it('modifier_duration_first_and_final_round: a two-round AC bonus protects the first and final rounds, then expires', () => {\n    const pack = packWithSpells([{\n      id: 'two-round-ac', operation: {\n        kind: 'armor_class_modifier', modification: { kind: 'bonus', amount: 3 }, duration: twoRounds,\n      },\n    }]);\n    const caster = playerProfile('duration-caster', { initiativeBonus: 30 });\n    const attacker = playerProfile('duration-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = playerProfile('duration-target', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 20 });\n    let state = cast(started(pack, [caster, attacker, target]), caster, target, 'two-round-ac');\n    state = endTurn(state, caster);\n    const first = attack(state, attacker, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 }));\n    expect(attackEvent(first.events).attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n    state = endTurn(first.state, attacker);\n    state = endTurn(state, target);\n    state = endTurn(state, caster);\n    const final = attack(state, attacker, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 }));\n    expect(attackEvent(final.events).attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n    state = endTurn(final.state, attacker);\n    state = endTurn(state, target);\n    state = endTurn(state, caster);\n    const expired = attack(state, attacker, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 }));\n    expect(attackEvent(expired.events).attack.outcome).toBe('hit');\n  });\n\n  it('resistance_vulnerability_region: resistance Response order: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:1044-1072.\n    const region = (modifier: number): SpellOperation => ({\n      kind: 'movement_region', region: { id: `thorn-${String(modifier)}`, cells: [{ column: 3, row: 0 }] },\n      difficultTerrain: false, entry: 'allowed',\n      damage: {\n        damageType: damageType('Piercing'), dice: { count: 1, sides: 4, modifier },\n        unitFeet: 5, rngFaces({ face: 1, sides: 4 }));\n    };\n    expect(runRegion(4).events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'damage_applied', amount: 2 }));\n    expect(runRegion(5).events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'damage_applied', amount: 3 }));\n\n    const responsePack = packWithSpells([\n      {\n        id: 'fire-resistance', duration: twoRounds,\n        },\n      },\n      { id: 'fire-vulnerability', operation: { kind: 'damage_response_modifier', damageType: damageType('Fire'), response: 'vulnerable', duration: twoRounds playerProfile('response-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = monsterProfile('response-target', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n    const amountFor = (spell: 'fire-resistance' | 'fire-vulnerability') => {\n      let state = cast(\n        started(responsePack, [warder, attacker, target]), warder, target, spell,\n        spell === 'fire-resistance' ? null,\n      }, () => 0);\n      return result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied')?.amount;\n    };\n    expect(amountFor('fire-resistance')).toBe(2);\n    expect(amountFor('fire-vulnerability')).toBe(10);\n  });\n\n  it('targeted_modifier_scope: a selected-attacker AC defense blocks that attacker but not a non-targeted source, unlike a blanket bonus', () => {\n    // Protection from Evil and Good scopes its defense by attacker source (spell-descriptions.txt:6337-6362).\n    const pack = packWithSpells([\n      { id: 'targeted-ward', operation: { kind: 'targeted_defense_modifier', against: 'selected_attacker', armorClassBonus: 3, duration: twoRounds } },\n      { id: 'blanket-ward', operation: { kind: 'armor_class_modifier', modification: { kind: 'bonus', amount: 3 }, duration: twoRounds } },\n    ]);\n    const warder = playerProfile('targeted-warder', { initiativeBonus: 40 });\n    const selected = playerProfile('targeted-selected', { });\n    let targeted = cast(started(pack, [warder, selected, outsider, target]), warder, target, 'targeted-ward', null, selected);\n    targeted = endTurn(targeted, warder);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(targeted, selected, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 })).events).attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n    targeted = endTurn(targeted, selected);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(targeted, outsider, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 })).events).attack.outcome).toBe('hit');\n\n    let blanket = cast(started(pack, [warder, selected, outsider, target]), warder, target, 'blanket-ward');\n    blanket = endTurn(blanket, warder);\n    blanket = endTurn(blanket, selected);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(blanket, outsider, target, rngFaces({ canCombatantSee,\n  createEncounter,\n  EquipmentRuleError,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from type LoadedContentPack,\n} from '../../../src/content/content-pack';\nimport { placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst { readText: readFileSync } = declareTestInputs({\n  fixtures: ['tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json'],\n}).fixtures;\n\ninterface MutableFormsPack {\n  packId: string;\n  spells: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  items: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  monsters: Array<{\n    recordId: string;\n    name: string;\n    statblock: Record<string, unknown>;\n    actions: unknown[];\n  }>;\n  [key: string]: unknown;\n}\n\nconst FORM_ITEM = itemId('greenforge:shape-knife');\n\nfunction sourcePack(): MutableFormsPack {\n  const source = JSON.parse(readFileSync('tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json', 'utf8')) as MutableFormsPack;\n  source.packId = 'forms-fixture';\n  const monster = source.monsters[0];\n  if (monster === undefined) throw new Error('Forms fixture has no monster statblock.');\n  monster.statblock.speedFeet = 40;\n  monster.statblock.senses = [\n    { kind: 'normal_sight' },\n    { kind: 'blindsight', rangeFeet: 30 },\n  ];\n  source.items = [{\n    sourceId: 'greenforge', recordId: 'shape-knife', name: 'Shape Knife',\n    materials: [{ kind: 'other', name: 'bone' }],\n    equip: { kind: 'held', handCapacity: 1, droppable: true },\n  }];\n  return source;\n}\n\nfunction packMonsterOperation(\n  equipmentDisposition: 'merged_into_form' | 'dropped_at_origin' = 'merged_into_form',\n): Extract<BranchSpellOperation, { readonly kind: 'form_replacement' }> {\n  return {\n    kind: 'form_replacement',\n    form: { kind: 'pack_monster', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote' },\n    retainedStatistics: FORM_REPLACEMENT_RETAINED_STATISTICS,\n    hitPoints: 'temporary_form_pool',\n    equipmentDisposition,\n    actionAccess: 'form_statblock_only',\n    spellcasting: 'prohibited',\n    lifecycle: { concentration: true, durationRounds: 10, expiresAt: 'source_start' },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction statOverrideOperation(): Extract<BranchSpellOperation, { readonly kind: 'form_replacement' }> {\n  return {\n    ...packMonsterOperation('dropped_at_origin'),\n    form: {\n      kind: 'stat_override',\n      stats: {\n        id: 'mist-hound', name: 'Mist Hound', armorClass: 13, hitPointMaximum: 7,\n        speedFeet: 45, initiativeBonus: 3,\n        savingThrowBonuses: {\n          strength: 2, dexterity: 3, constitution: 1,\n          intelligence: -2, wisdom: 2, charisma: -1,\n        },\n        attacksPerAction: 1, reachFeet: 5,\n        damageResponses: [{ type: 'Cold', response: 'resistant' }],\n        conditionImmunities: ['Prone'],\n        senses: [{ kind: 'normal_sight' }, { kind: 'truesight', rangeFeet: 20 }],\n        actions: [{\n          kind: 'attack', id: 'mist-bite', name: 'Mist Bite', attackBonus: 5,\n          delivery: { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: 5 },\n          damage: [{\n            average: 5, dice: { count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 1 }, type: 'Cold',\n            trigger: { kind: 'always' },\n          }],\n          attackRollAdvantage: null, onHit: [],\n        }],\n      },\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction formSpell(source: MutableFormsPack, operation: unknown, recordId = 'assume-brassleaf'): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const template = source.spells[0];\n  if (template === undefined) throw new Error('Forms fixture has no spell template.');\n  return {\n    ...template,\n    recordId,\n    name: recordId,\n    level: 1,\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', rounds: 10 },\n    concentration: true,\n    targeting: { kind: 'single', rangeFeet: 30, willing: true },\n    operation,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction loadedFormsPack(operation: unknown = packMonsterOperation()): LoadedContentPack {\n  const source = sourcePack();\n  source.spells = [formSpell(source, operation)];\n  const result = loadContentPack(source);\n  if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Forms pack refused: ${result.refusal.reason}`);\n  expect(result.content.diagnostics).toEqual([]);\n  return result.content;\n}\n\ninterface FormsEncounter {\n  readonly content: LoadedContentPack;\n  readonly caster: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly target: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly enemy: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n}\n\nfunction started(operation: unknown = packMonsterOperation()): FormsEncounter {\n  const content = loadedFormsPack(operation);\n  const caster = playerProfile('forms-caster', {\n    initiativeBonus: 20, spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 4 }],\n  });\n  const target = playerProfile('forms-target', {\n    hitPoints: 20, initiativeBonus: 10, spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }],\n  });\n  const enemy = playerProfile('forms-enemy', { hitPoints: 30, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 10, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [caster, target, enemy],\n    tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(target, 1), placedToken(enemy, 2)],\n    contentPacks: [content],\n    equipment: [{\n      combatant: target.id,\n      hands: { kind: 'one_handed', items: [FORM_ITEM] },\n      worn: [], carried: [],\n    }],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  return { content, caster, target, enemy, state };\n}\n\nfunction cast(subject: FormsEncounter): EncounterState {\n  const command: SpellCastCommand = {\n    type: 'cast_spell', actor: subject.caster.id, spellId: 'greenforge:assume-brassleaf',\n    slotLevel: 1, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 6, saveDc: 14,\n    spellcastingModifier: 3, targets: [subject.target.id], area: null,\n    weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n  };\n  return reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0).state;\n}\n\nfunction fixedDamage(subject: FormsEncounter, state: EncounterState, amount: number): ReturnType<typeof reduceEncounter> {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'force_save', actor: subject.caster.id, target: subject.target.id,\n    ability: 'dexterity', dc: 30, rollMode: 'normal',\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: amount } }],\n      critical: false, responses: [],\n    },\n    onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n  }, () => 0);\n}\n\nfunction targetState(state: EncounterState, target: CombatantProfile) {\n  const found = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === target.id);\n  if (found === undefined) throw new Error('Forms target is absent from encounter state.');\n  return found;\n}\n\ndescribe('D348.1 imported form and stat replacement', () => {\n  it('form_assumed_and_stats_replaced: pack statblock supplies form HP, stats, speed, senses, and actions while identity and original HP persist', () => {\n    // Replaced statistics and retained continuity: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5952-5963.\n    const subject = started();\n    const before = targetState(subject.state, subject.target);\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    const after = targetState(transformed, subject.target);\n\n    expect(after.form).toMatchObject({\n      formId: 'greenforge:brassleaf-mote', formName: 'Brassleaf Mote',\n      hitPoints: 9, hitPointMaximum: 9,\n      retainedStatistics: FORM_REPLACEMENT_RETAINED_STATISTICS,\n      equipmentDisposition: 'merged_into_form', spellcasting: 'prohibited',\n    });\n    expect(after.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(after.profile.name).toBe(before.profile.name);\n    expect(after.profile.rules).toMatchObject({ armorClass: 12, speed: 40, initiativeBonus: 1 });\n    expect(availableFormActions(transformed, subject.target.id)?.map(({ id }) => id))\n      .toEqual(['attack:brassleaf-tap']);\n\n    const enemyCell = transformed.tokens.find(({ combatantId }) => combatantId === subject.enemy.id)?.position;\n    if (enemyCell === undefined) throw new Error('Forms enemy has no token.');\n    const dark = {\n      ...transformed,\n      environment: {\n        ...transformed.environment,\n        lightRegions: [{ id: 'form-sense-darkness', cells: [enemyCell], level: 'darkness' as const }],\n      },\n    };\n    const originalDark = { ...subject.state, environment: dark.environment };\n    expect(canCombatantSee(originalDark, subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id)).toBe(false);\n    expect(canCombatantSee(dark, subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('carryover_lost and carryover_boundary_exact_vs_one_over: exactly the remaining form HP reverts without original damage; one over carries exactly one', () => {\n    // Form THP ends the spell: spell-descriptions.txt:5958-5963. Leftover damage\n    // carries to actual HP: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:1126-1131.\n    const exactSubject = started();\n    const exact = fixedDamage(exactSubject, cast(exactSubject), 9);\n    const exactTarget = targetState(exact.state, exactSubject.target);\n    expect(exactTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(exactTarget.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(exact.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'effect_ended', reason: 'form_hit_points_depleted',\n    }));\n\n    const overSubject = started();\n    const over = fixedDamage(overSubject, cast(overSubject), 10);\n    const overTarget = targetState(over.state, overSubject.target);\n    expect(overTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(overTarget.hitPoints).toBe(19);\n  });\n\n  it('original_hp_touched_in_form and revert_keeps_form_stats: partial form damage drains only the form pool and effect-end reversion differs from zero-HP reversion', () => {\n    const subject = started();\n    const partial = fixedDamage(subject, cast(subject), 4).state;\n    expect(targetState(partial, subject.target)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 20,\n      form: { hitPoints: 5, hitPointMaximum: 9 },\n    });\n\n    const ended = reduceEncounter(partial, {\n      type: 'end_concentration', actor: subject.caster.id,\n    }, () => 0);\n    const endedTarget = targetState(ended.state, subject.target);\n    expect(endedTarget.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(endedTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(endedTarget.profile.rules).toMatchObject({ armorClass: 14, speed: 30 });\n    expect(ended.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'effect_ended', reason: 'concentration_ended',\n    }));\n    expect(ended.events.some((event) =>\n      event.type === 'effect_ended' && event.reason === 'form_hit_points_depleted')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('form_actions_and_casting_restriction: only an unchanged statblock attack is legal and spellcasting is refused', () => {\n    // Form anatomy and casting restriction: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5965-5967.\n    const subject = started();\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n      type: 'cast_spell', actor: subject.target.id, spellId: 'greenforge:assume-brassleaf',\n      slotLevel: 1, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 5, saveDc: 13,\n      spellcastingModifier: 2, targets: [subject.target.id], area: null,\n      weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n    }, () => 0)).toThrow('cannot cast spells in its current form');\n\n    let targetTurn = reduceEncounter(transformed, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(targetTurn, {\n      type: 'attack', actor: subject.target.id, target: subject.enemy.id,\n      attackBonus: 4, criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal',\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Bludgeoning'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5)).toThrow('must use an attack from form');\n\n    const monster = subject.content.monsters.find(({ recordId }) => recordId === 'brassleaf-mote');\n    if (monster === undefined) throw new Error('Loaded form monster is missing.');\n    targetTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      targetTurn,\n      importedMonsterAttackCommand(monster, 'attack:brassleaf-tap', subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id),\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(targetState(targetTurn, subject.enemy).hitPoints).toBeLessThan(30);\n  });\n\n  it('merged_equipment_is_unavailable: worn and carried shape with the form and cannot be interacted with', () => {\n    // Polymorph gear melds and provides no benefit: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5971-5973.\n    const subject = started();\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(transformed.equipment?.find(({ combatant }) => combatant === subject.target.id)?.hands)\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'one_handed', items: [FORM_ITEM] });\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n      type: 'drop_item', actor: subject.target.id, item: FORM_ITEM, interaction: 'free',\n    }, () => 0)).toThrow(EquipmentRuleError);\n    try {\n      reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n        type: 'drop_item', actor: subject.target.id, item: FORM_ITEM, interaction: 'free',\n      }, () => 0);\n      expect.fail('Merged form equipment unexpectedly remained interactable.');\n    } catch (error) {\n      expect(error).toMatchObject({ code: 'form_equipment_unavailable' });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('declared_stat_override_and_drop: a pack can declare the replacement block and drop equipment at the origin', () => {\n    const subject = started(statOverrideOperation());\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(targetState(transformed, subject.target)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 20,\n      form: { formId: 'mist-hound', hitPoints: 7, equipmentDisposition: 'dropped_at_origin' },\n      profile: { rules: { armorClass: 13, speed: 45 } },\n    });\n    expect(transformed.equipment?.find(({ combatant }) => combatant === subject.target.id)?.hands)\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'empty' });\n    expect(transformed.groundItems).toContainEqual({ item: FORM_ITEM, position: { column: 1, row: 0 } });\n    expect(transformed.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'item_dropped', item: FORM_ITEM, cause: 'form_replacement',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('unknown_form_id_transforms: rejects only the missing-id form record and loads the rest of the pack', () => {\n    const source = sourcePack();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    const missing = {\n      ...packMonsterOperation(),\n      form: { kind: 'pack_monster', monsterId: 'absent-form' },\n    };\n    source.spells = [healthy, formSpell(source, missing, 'missing-form')];\n    const loaded = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(loaded.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Missing form record unexpectedly refused the pack envelope.');\n    expect(loaded.content.spells.map(({ recordId }) => recordId)).toEqual(['prism-pebble']);\n    expect(loaded.content.monsters.map(({ recordId }) => recordId)).toEqual(['brassleaf-mote']);\n    expect(loaded.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'missing_form_reference', recordId: 'missing-form',\n      monsterId: 'greenforge:absent-form',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('true_polymorph_and_object_transformation_refusals: unsupported permanence and object-to-creature shapes have named reasons', () => {\n    const source = sourcePack();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    source.spells = [\n      healthy,\n      formSpell(source, { kind: 'true_polymorph_permanence' }, 'permanent-form'),\n      formSpell(source, { kind: 'object_to_creature_transformation' }, 'object-creature'),\n    ];\n    const loaded = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(loaded.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Named form refusals unexpectedly refused the pack envelope.');\n    expect(loaded.content.spells.map(({ TRUE_POLYMORPH_PERMANENCE_REFUSAL, recordId: 'permanent-form' }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ reason: OBJECT_TO_CREATURE_REFUSAL, recordId: 'object-creature' }),\n    ]));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/turn-exhaustion-coordinator.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1732","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator authorizes an initial declared fallback and journals the selected
