boundary"},{"id":"1786","name":"D368.3 opportunity attacks and fork #18 decisions moots the remaining opportunity-attack offers when the first accepted offer kills their mover"},{"id":"1787","name":"D368.3 opportunity attacks and fork #18 decisions Flyby suppresses the real movement-triggered opportunity attack"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  createEncounter,\n  detectCombatant,\n  PendingDecisionRuleError,\n  REACTION_KINDS,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  VisionTargetingRuleError,\n  type EncounterState,\n  type DetectionRulesEdition,\n  type ReactionPolicy,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { monsterCombatantProfile, type CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/homebrew-beast-families';\nimport { feetPoint } from '../../../src/combat/templates';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, feet } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction withRules(\n  profile: CombatantProfile,\n  patch: Partial<CombatantProfile['rules']>,\n): CombatantProfile {\n  const rules = { ...profile.rules, ...patch };\n  return profile.kind === 'player_character'\n    ? { ...profile, rules }\n    : { ...profile, rules };\n}\n\nfunction face(value: number): () => number {\n  return () => (value - 0.5) / 20;\n}\n\nfunction sequence(...values: readonly number[]): () => number {\n  let index = 0;\n  return () => {\n    const value = values[index] ?? values.at(-1) ?? 10;\n    index += 1;\n    return (value - 0.5) / 20;\n  };\n}\n\nfunction darkEnvironment(...cells: readonly { readonly column: number; readonly row: number }[]) {\n  return {\n    lightRegions: [{ id: 'darkness', cells, level: 'darkness' as const }],\n    obscurementRegions: [], difficultTerrainRegions: [], movementRegions: [],\n  };\n}\n\nfunction startedEncounter(options: {\n  readonly actor?: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly reactor?: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly actorColumn?: number;\n  readonly reactorColumn?: number;\n  readonly edition?: DetectionRulesEdition;\n  readonly policy?: ReactionPolicy;\n  readonly darkness?: readonly { readonly column: number; readonly row: number }[];\n} = {}): { readonly state: EncounterState; readonly actor: CombatantProfile; readonly reactor: CombatantProfile } {\n  const actor = options.actor ?? playerProfile('detection-actor', { initiativeBonus: 20, spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }] });\n  const reactor = options.reactor ?? monsterProfile('detection-reactor', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    ...(options.edition === undefined ? {} : { rulesEdition: options.edition }),\n    bounds: { columns: 20, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [actor, reactor],\n    tokens: [placedToken(actor, options.actorColumn ?? 1, 1), placedToken(reactor, options.reactorColumn ?? 0, 1)],\n    ...(options.darkness === undefined ? {} : { environment: darkEnvironment(...options.darkness) }),\n    ...(options.policy === undefined ? {} : {\n      reactionPolicies: [{ combatant: reactor.id, reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack', policy: options.policy }],\n    }),\n  });\n  return { state: reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, face(10)).state, actor, reactor };\n}\n\nfunction basicAttack(actor: CombatantProfile, target: CombatantProfile, requiresSight = false): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack', actor: actor.id, target: target.id, attackBonus: 0,\n    criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal', attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    ...(requiresSight ? { requiresSight: true as const } : {}),\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Slashing'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 } }],\n      critical: false, responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('D356 full detection vocabulary', () => {\n  it('stealth_dc_off_by_one: 2024 Hide succeeds at exactly 15 and fails at 14', () => {\n    // Hide DC and prerequisites: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:11774-11789.\n    const at = startedEncounter({ darkness: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }] });\n    const succeeded = reduceEncounter(at.state, { type: 'hide', actor: at.actor.id }, face(15));\n    expect(succeeded.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'hide_resolved', total: 15, outcome: 'hidden' }));\n    expect(succeeded.state.hiddenCombatants).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ combatant: at.actor.id, stealthTotal: 15, edition: '2024' }));\n\n    const below = startedEncounter({ darkness: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }] });\n    const failed = reduceEncounter(below.state, { type: 'hide', actor: below.actor.id }, face(14));\n    expect(failed.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'hide_resolved', total: 14, outcome: 'failed_dc' }));\n    expect(failed.state.hiddenCombatants).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it('keeps 2014 contested hiding distinct from the 2024 fixed DC under the edition lock', () => {\n    // 2014 hiding and passive detection: docs/homebrew/ogl/srd-5.1/srd-5.1-ogl.txt:4604-4619,4629-4645.\n    const state2014 = startedEncounter({ edition: '2014', darkness: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }] });\n    const hidden2014 = reduceEncounter(state2014.state, { type: 'hide', actor: state2014.actor.id }, face(14));\n    expect(hidden2014.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'hide_resolved', edition: '2014', total: 14, outcome: 'hidden' }));\n\n    const state2024 = startedEncounter({ edition: '2024', darkness: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }] });\n    const hidden2024 = reduceEncounter(state2024.state, { type: 'hide', actor: state2024.actor.id }, face(14));\n    expect(hidden2024.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'hide_resolved', edition: '2024', total: 14, outcome: 'failed_dc' }));\n  });\n\n  it('passive Perception at the hiding total immediately detects the creature', () => {\n    // Passive score and equality gate: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:11781-11789,11965-11979.\n    const observer = withRules(monsterProfile('passive-observer', { initiativeBonus: -20 }), {\n      passivePerception: 15,\n    });\n    const setup = startedEncounter({ reactor: observer, darkness: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }] });\n    const result = reduceEncounter(setup.state, { type: 'hide', actor: setup.actor.id }, face(15));\n    expect(result.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'hide_resolved', total: 15, outcome: 'passively_detected',\n    }));\n    expect(result.state.hiddenCombatants).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it('passive_five_shift: Advantage adds 5 and Disadvantage subtracts 5 from passive Perception', () => {\n    const keenObserver = withRules(monsterProfile('keen-passive-observer', { initiativeBonus: -20 }), {\n      passivePerception: 12,\n      detectionTraits: ['keen_sight'],\n    });\n    const advantage = startedEncounter({\n      reactor: keenObserver,\n      darkness: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }],\n    });\n    const advantageResult = reduceEncounter(\n      advantage.state,\n      { type: 'hide', actor: advantage.actor.id },\n      face(17),\n    );\n    expect(advantageResult.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'hide_resolved', total: 17, outcome: 'passively_detected',\n    }));\n\n    const disadvantagedObserver = withRules(monsterProfile('dim-passive-observer', { initiativeBonus: -20 }), {\n      passivePerception: 20,\n    });\n    const disadvantage = startedEncounter({ reactor: disadvantagedObserver });\n    const subjectCell = { column: 1, row: 1 } as const;\n    const obscured: EncounterState = {\n      ...disadvantage.state,\n      environment: {\n        ...disadvantage.state.environment,\n        lightRegions: [{ id: 'dim-passive', cells: [subjectCell], level: 'dim' }],\n        obscurementRegions: [{ id: 'heavy-passive', cells: [subjectCell], obscurement: 'heavy' }],\n      },\n    };\n    const disadvantageResult = reduceEncounter(\n      obscured,\n      { type: 'hide', actor: disadvantage.actor.id },\n      face(16),\n    );\n    expect(disadvantageResult.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'hide_resolved', total: 16, outcome: 'hidden',\n    }));\n    expect(disadvantageResult.state.hiddenCombatants).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      combatant: disadvantage.actor.id,\n      stealthTotal: 16,\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('hidden attacker has Advantage and making the attack roll reveals it', () => {\n    // Unseen attacks and reveal: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:884-894,11784-11789.\n    const setup = startedEncounter({ darkness: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }] });\n    const hidden: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      hiddenCombatants: [{ combatant: setup.actor.id, stealthTotal: 18, edition: '2024' }],\n    };\n    const result = reduceEncounter(hidden, basicAttack(setup.actor, setup.reactor), sequence(18, 2));\n    const attack = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved');\n    expect(attack?.attack.roll).toMatchObject({ mode: 'advantage', faces: [18, 2], chosen: 18 });\n    expect(result.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'hidden_ended', combatant: setup.actor.id, reason: 'attack_roll' }));\n    expect(result.state.hiddenCombatants).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it('sight-required attacks and spells return the typed target-not-seen refusal', () => {\n    const setup = startedEncounter({ darkness: [{ column: 0, row: 1 }] });\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(setup.state, basicAttack(setup.actor, setup.reactor, true), face(15)))\n      .toThrowError(VisionTargetingRuleError);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'cast_spell', actor: setup.actor.id, spellId: 'magic-missile', slotLevel: 1,\n      castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 1, attackBonus: 3, saveDc: 11, spellcastingModifier: 1,\n      targets: [setup.reactor.id, setup.reactor.id, setup.reactor.id], area: null, weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n    }, face(15))).toThrowError(VisionTargetingRuleError);\n  });\n\n  it('Keen Sight drives sight-based Search Advantage and Web Sense locates creatures on the same web', () => {\n    // Search: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:12010-12024. Keen Sight: docs/homebrew/ogl/srd-5.1/srd-5.1-ogl.txt:23547-23550.\n    // Web Sense: docs/homebrew/ogl/srd-5.1/srd-5.1-ogl.txt:23501-23503.\n    const raptorRow = HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER.find((row) => row.design.family === 'raptor');\n    const arachnidRow = HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER.find((row) => row.design.family === 'arachnid');\n    if (raptorRow === undefined || arachnidRow === undefined) throw new Error('Detection beasts are missing.');\n    const raptor = monsterCombatantProfile(raptorRow.statblock, { combatantId: 'combatant:keen-raptor', tokenId: 'token:keen-raptor' });\n    const hiddenTarget = playerProfile('keen-target', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const keen = startedEncounter({ actor: raptor, reactor: hiddenTarget, actorColumn: 0, reactorColumn: 2 });\n    const concealed: EncounterState = {\n      ...keen.state,\n      hiddenCombatants: [{ combatant: hiddenTarget.id, stealthTotal: 14, edition: '2024' }],\n    };\n    const searched = reduceEncounter(concealed, {\n      type: 'search', actor: raptor.id, target: hiddenTarget.id, reliance: 'sight',\n    }, sequence(3, 15));\n    expect(searched.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'search_resolved', outcome: 'found' }));\n    expect(searched.state.hiddenCombatants).toEqual([]);\n\n    const spider = monsterCombatantProfile(arachnidRow.statblock, { combatantId: 'combatant:web-spider', tokenId: 'token:web-spider' });\n    const webTarget = playerProfile('web-target', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const caster = playerProfile('web-caster', { initiativeBonus: 30, spellSlots: [{ level: 2, maximum: 1 }] });\n    let webState = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 10, rows: 5 }, combatants: [caster, spider, webTarget],\n      tokens: [placedToken(caster, 6, 1), placedToken(spider, 1, 1), placedToken(webTarget, 2, 1)],\n    });\n    webState = reduceEncounter(webState, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, face(10)).state;\n    webState = reduceEncounter(webState, {\n      type: 'cast_spell', actor: caster.id, spellId: 'web', slotLevel: 2,\n      castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 3, attackBonus: 5, saveDc: 13, spellcastingModifier: 3,\n      targets: [], weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n      area: {\n        shape: 'cube',\n        template: { origin: feetPoint(0, 10), center: feetPoint(10, 10), axis: { x: 1, y: 0 }, size: feet(20), includeOrigin: false },\n      },\n    }, face(10)).state;\n    expect(spider.rules.detectionTraits).toContain('web_sense');\n    expect(detectCombatant(webState, spider.id, webTarget.id)).toEqual({ kind: 'located', sense: 'web_sense' });\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('D368.3 opportunity attacks and fork #18 decisions', () => {\n  it('closes the unified reaction vocabulary over exactly five trigger kinds', () => {\n    expect(REACTION_KINDS).toEqual([\n      'hit_by_attack', 'damaged_by_creature', 'taking_damage_of_type',\n      'creature_casts_spell', 'opportunity_attack',\n    ]);\n  });\n  it('fires the fifth reaction trigger when a seen creature voluntarily leaves reach', () => {\n    // Opportunity Attack trigger: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:933-956.\n    const setup = startedEncounter();\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20));\n    expect(moved.state.pendingDecisions).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(moved.state.pendingDecisions[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'reaction_offer', reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack', combatant: setup.reactor.id });\n  });\n\n  it('does not trigger on Disengage, teleport, or forced movement', () => {\n    // Exemptions: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:941-956.\n    const disengaging = startedEncounter();\n    const disengaged = reduceEncounter(disengaging.state, { type: 'disengage', actor: disengaging.actor.id }, face(10)).state;\n    expect(reduceEncounter(disengaged, {\n      type: 'move', actor: disengaging.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state.pendingDecisions).toEqual([]);\n    for (const cause of ['teleport', 'forced'] as const) {\n      const setup = startedEncounter();\n      expect(reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n        type: 'move', actor: setup.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause,\n      }, face(20)).state.pendingDecisions, cause).toEqual([]);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('hidden_still_provokes: a Hidden mover does not provoke because the reactor cannot see it', () => {\n    const setup = startedEncounter({ darkness: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }] });\n    const hidden = reduceEncounter(setup.state, { type: 'hide', actor: setup.actor.id }, face(15)).state;\n    expect(hidden.hiddenCombatants).toHaveLength(1);\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(hidden, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20));\n    expect(moved.state.pendingDecisions).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it('always_policy_silent: always and never auto-resolve with explicit records', () => {\n    const always = startedEncounter({ policy: 'always' });\n    const fired = reduceEncounter(always.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: always.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20));\n    expect(fired.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'reaction_policy_auto_resolved', policy: 'always', resolution: 'accept', autoFired: true,\n    }));\n    expect(fired.events.some((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved')).toBe(true);\n\n    const never = startedEncounter({ policy: 'never' });\n    const declined = reduceEncounter(never.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: never.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20));\n    expect(declined.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'reaction_policy_auto_resolved', policy: 'never', resolution: 'decline', autoFired: false,\n    }));\n    expect(declined.events.some((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('advance_past_pending: an unresolved ask decision blocks its turn boundary until explicitly resolved', () => {\n    const setup = startedEncounter();\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(moved, { type: 'end_turn', actor: setup.actor.id }, face(10)))\n      .toThrowError(PendingDecisionRuleError);\n    const decision = moved.pendingDecisions[0];\n    if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Expected queued OA decision.');\n    const resolved = reduceEncounter(moved, {\n      type: 'resolve_pending_decision', decisionId: decision.id, optionId: 'decline',\n    }, face(10));\n    expect(resolved.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'pending_decision_resolved', optionId: 'decline' }));\n    expect(resolved.state.pendingDecisions).toEqual([]);\n    expect(reduceEncounter(resolved.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: setup.actor.id }, face(10)).state.activeCombatant)\n      .toBe(setup.reactor.id);\n  });\n\n  it('resolved_offer_reissues + resolution_leaves_pending: a resolved trigger stays resolved for its turn boundary', () => {\n    const setup = startedEncounter();\n    const firstMove = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    const decision = firstMove.pendingDecisions[0];\n    if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Expected queued OA decision.');\n    const resolved = reduceEncounter(firstMove, {\n      type: 'resolve_pending_decision', decisionId: decision.id, optionId: 'decline',\n    }, face(10)).state;\n    expect(resolved.pendingDecisions).toEqual([]);\n\n    const returned = reduceEncounter(resolved, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.actor.id, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    const crossedAgain = reduceEncounter(returned, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.actor.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n\n    expect(crossedAgain.pendingDecisions).toEqual([]);\n    expect(reduceEncounter(crossedAgain, {\n      type: 'end_turn', actor: setup.actor.id,\n    }, face(10)).state.activeCombatant).toBe(setup.reactor.id);\n  });\n\n  it('moots the remaining opportunity-attack offers when the first accepted offer kills their mover', () => {\n    const mover = monsterProfile('oa-moot-mover', { initiativeBonus: 30, hitPoints: 1 });\n    const first = playerProfile('oa-moot-first', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const second = playerProfile('oa-moot-second', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const remainingEnemy = monsterProfile('oa-moot-remaining-enemy', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 3 },\n      combatants: [mover, first, second, remainingEnemy],\n      tokens: [\n        placedToken(mover, 1, 1),\n        placedToken(first, 0, 1),\n        placedToken(second, 0, 0),\n        placedToken(remainingEnemy, 4, 2),\n      ],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, face(10)).state;\n    const opportunityAttack = (\n      reactor: CombatantProfile,\n    ): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'opportunity_attack' }> => ({\n      ...basicAttack(reactor, mover),\n      type: 'opportunity_attack',\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: mover.id,\n      path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }],\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n      executableOpportunityAttacks: [opportunityAttack(first), opportunityAttack(second)],\n    }, face(10)).state;\n    expect(state.pendingDecisions).toHaveLength(2);\n    const accepted = state.pendingDecisions[0];\n    if (accepted === undefined) throw new Error('The first opportunity-attack offer is missing.');\n\n    const resolved = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'resolve_pending_decision',\n      decisionId: accepted.id,\n      optionId: 'accept',\n    }, face(20));\n\n    expect(resolved.state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === mover.id)?.life)\n      .toBe('dead');\n    expect(resolved.state.pendingDecisions).toEqual([]);\n    expect(resolved.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'pending_decision_resolved')).toEqual([\n      expect.objectContaining({ decisionId: accepted.id, optionId: 'accept' }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ optionId: 'moot', reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack' }),\n    ]);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(\n      resolved.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: mover.id },\n      face(10),\n    )).not.toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it('Flyby suppresses the real movement-triggered opportunity attack', () => {\n    // Flyby: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:23236-23237.\n    const row = HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER.find((candidate) => candidate.design.family === 'pterosaur');\n    if (row === undefined) throw new Error('Flyby pterosaur missing.');\n    const flyer = monsterCombatantProfile(row.statblock, { combatantId: 'combatant:flyby', tokenId: 'token:flyby' });\n    const reactor = withRules(playerProfile('flyby-reactor', { initiativeBonus: -20 }), { passivePerception: 20 });\n    const setup = startedEncounter({ actor: flyer, reactor });\n    expect(flyer.rules.detectionTraits).toContain('flyby');\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: flyer.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20));\n    expect(moved.state.pendingDecisions).toEqual([]);\n    expect(moved.events.some((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved')).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/spells-batch-two.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1788","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries 'hold-monster' pins casting time and components"},{"id":"1789","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries 'faerie-fire' pins casting time and components"},{"id":"1790","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries 'vicious-mockery' pins casting time and components"},{"id":"1791","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries 'pass-without-trace' pins casting time and components"},{"id":"1792","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries 'entangle' pins casting time and components"},{"id":"1793","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries 'dissonant-whispers' pins casting time and components"},{"id":"1794","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries 'goodberry' pins casting time and components"},{"id":"1795","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries Hold Monster pins targeting, duration, concentration, and its repeated Wisdom save"},{"id":"1796","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries hold_monster_save_end_dropped: DC-1 Paralyzes and blocks actions, then an exact-DC end-turn save ends it"},{"id":"1797","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries faerie_fire_no_advantage: DC-1 outlines while exact DC saves; outline grants Advantage and suppresses Invisible benefits"},{"id":"1798","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries mockery_disadvantage_persists: DC-1 takes scaled Psychic damage and only the next attack has Disadvantage"},{"id":"1799","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries Pass without Trace accepts a beneficiary at exactly 30 feet and exposes +10 in the Stealth modifier"},{"id":"1800","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries Entangle DC-1 applies Restrained in its exact square while an exact-DC save avoids it"},{"id":"1801","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries Dissonant Whispers pins 3d6 Psychic, DC-1 full damage, and exact-DC half damage"},{"id":"1802","name":"D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries Goodberry creates a ten-use pool whose bonus-action consumption decrements once and heals exactly 1 HP"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile, SpellSlotLevel } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  effectiveSkillModifier,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand, EncounterEvent } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { spellDefinition } from '../../../src/combat/spells/definitions';\nimport type { SpellCastCommand } from '../../../src/combat/spells/types';\nimport { feetPoint } from '../../../src/combat/templates';\nimport {\n  damageType,\n  dieSides,\n  effectStackingIdentity,\n  feet,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nfunction sequenceRng(values: readonly number[]): () => number {\n  let index = 0;\n  return () => {\n    const value = values[index];\n    if (value === undefined) throw new Error(`RNG sequence exhausted at index ${index}.`);\n    index += 1;\n    return value;\n  };\n}\n\nfunction startedEncounter(\n  caster: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  targetColumn = 2,\n): EncounterState {\n  const state = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 20, rows: 8 },\n    combatants: [caster, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0, 0), placedToken(target, targetColumn, 0)],\n  });\n  return reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\nfunction casterFor(\n  key: string,\n  level: SpellSlotLevel,\n  options: { readonly hitPoints?: number } = {},\n): CombatantProfile {\n  return playerProfile(key, {\n    hitPoints: options.hitPoints ?? 30,\n    initiativeBonus: 20,\n    spellSlots: [{ level, maximum: 2 }],\n  });\n}\n\nfunction cast(\n  caster: CombatantProfile,\n  spellId: string,\n  slotLevel: SpellSlotLevel | null,\n  options: Partial<Pick<SpellCastCommand, 'targets' | 'area' | 'casterLevel'>> = {},\n): SpellCastCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'cast_spell',\n    actor: caster.id,\n    spellId,\n    slotLevel,\n    castAsRitual: false,\n    casterLevel: options.casterLevel ?? 7,\n    attackBonus: 8,\n    saveDc: 10,\n    spellcastingModifier: 4,\n    targets: options.targets ?? [],\n    area: options.area ?? null,\n    weaponAttack: null,\n    selectedOption: null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction cube20(): NonNullable<SpellCastCommand['area']> {\n  return {\n    shape: 'cube',\n    template: {\n      origin: feetPoint(5, 0),\n      center: feetPoint(15, 10),\n      axis: { x: 1, y: 0 },\n      size: feet(20),\n      includeOrigin: false,\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction weaponAttack(\n  actor: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Slashing'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 0 } }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attackEvent(events: readonly EncounterEvent[]) {\n  const event = events.findLast(\n    (candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'attack_resolved' }> =>\n      candidate.type === 'attack_resolved',\n  );\n  if (event === undefined) throw new Error('Expected an attack event.');\n  return event;\n}\n\nconst COMPONENT_PINS = [\n  { id: 'hold-monster', castingTime: 'action', components: 'VSM', material: 'a straight piece of iron' },\n  { id: 'faerie-fire', castingTime: 'action', components: 'V', material: null },\n  { id: 'vicious-mockery', castingTime: 'action', components: 'V', material: null },\n  { id: 'pass-without-trace', castingTime: 'action', components: 'VSM', material: 'ashes from burned mistletoe' },\n  { id: 'entangle', castingTime: 'action', components: 'VS', material: null },\n  { id: 'dissonant-whispers', castingTime: 'action', components: 'V', material: null },\n  { id: 'goodberry', castingTime: 'action', components: 'VSM', material: 'a sprig of mistletoe' },\n] as const;\n\ndescribe('D318.1 spell batch 2 boundaries', () => {\n  it.each(COMPONENT_PINS)('$id pins casting time and components', (pin) => {\n    const definition = spellDefinition(pin.id);\n    if (definition === null) throw new Error(`Missing definition ${pin.id}.`);\n    expect({\n      castingTime: definition.castingTime,\n      components: `${definition.components.verbal ? 'V' : ''}${definition.components.somatic ? 'S' : ''}${definition.components.material === null ? '' : 'M'}`,\n      material: definition.components.material?.text ?? null,\n    }).toEqual({ castingTime: pin.castingTime, components: pin.components, material: pin.material });\n  });\n\n  it('Hold Monster pins targeting, duration, concentration, and its repeated Wisdom save', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('hold-monster')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 5,\n      targeting: { kind: 'multiple', rangeFeet: 90, baseMaximum: 1, additionalPerSlot: 1 },\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'save_effect', ability: 'wisdom',\n        effect: {\n          concentration: true, durationRounds: 10, expiresAt: 'target_end',\n          repeatedSave: { ability: 'wisdom', timing: 'target_end' },\n          payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Paralyzed' },\n        },\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('hold_monster_save_end_dropped: DC-1 Paralyzes and blocks actions, then an exact-DC end-turn save ends it', () => {\n    const caster = casterFor('hold-monster-caster', 5);\n    const target = monsterProfile('hold-monster-target', { hitPoints: 40, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'hold-monster', 5, { targets: [target.id] }), () => 0.4).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Paralyzed' });\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'dash', actor: target.id }, () => 0.5))\n      .toThrow('Incapacitated');\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: target.id }, () => 0.45).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target.id)).not.toContainEqual({ name: 'Paralyzed' });\n\n    const successState = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    const exactDc = reduceEncounter(\n      successState,\n      cast(caster, 'hold-monster', 5, { targets: [target.id] }),\n      () => 0.45,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(exactDc, target.id)).not.toContainEqual({ name: 'Paralyzed' });\n  });\n\n  it('faerie_fire_no_advantage: DC-1 outlines while exact DC saves; outline grants Advantage and suppresses Invisible benefits', () => {\n    const caster = casterFor('faerie-caster', 1);\n    const target = monsterProfile('faerie-target', { hitPoints: 40, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'apply_effect', actor: caster.id, cost: 'none',\n      effect: {\n        targets: [target.id], duration: { kind: 'permanent' }, concentration: false,\n        stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('test:invisible'), stacking: 'coexist', repeatedSave: null,\n        payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Invisible' },\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Invisible' });\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'faerie-fire', 1, { area: cube20() }), () => 0.4).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target.id)).not.toContainEqual({ name: 'Invisible' });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: target.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const attacked = reduceEncounter(state, weaponAttack(caster, target), sequenceRng([0.1, 0.8, 0]));\n    expect(attackEvent(attacked.events).attack.roll.mode).toBe('advantage');\n\n    const exactDc = reduceEncounter(\n      startedEncounter(caster, target),\n      cast(caster, 'faerie-fire', 1, { area: cube20() }),\n      () => 0.45,\n    ).state;\n    expect(exactDc.effects.some((effect) =>\n      effect.targets.includes(target.id) && effect.payload.kind === 'faerie_fire')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('mockery_disadvantage_persists: DC-1 takes scaled Psychic damage and only the next attack has Disadvantage', () => {\n    const caster = casterFor('mockery-caster', 1);\n    const target = monsterProfile('mockery-target', { hitPoints: 50, initiativeBonus: 0, attacksPerAction: 2 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      cast(caster, 'vicious-mockery', null, { targets: [target.id], casterLevel: 5 }),\n      sequenceRng([0, 0, 0.4]),\n    ).state;\n    expect(state.combatants.find((subject) => subject.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(48);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    const first = reduceEncounter(state, weaponAttack(target, caster), sequenceRng([0.8, 0.2, 0]));\n    expect(attackEvent(first.events).attack.roll.mode).toBe('disadvantage');\n    const second = reduceEncounter(first.state, weaponAttack(target, caster), sequenceRng([0.5, 0]));\n    expect(attackEvent(second.events).attack.roll.mode).toBe('normal');\n\n    const exactDc = reduceEncounter(\n      startedEncounter(caster, target),\n      cast(caster, 'vicious-mockery', null, { targets: [target.id] }),\n      sequenceRng([0, 0, 0.45]),\n    ).state;\n    expect(exactDc.effects.some((effect) => effect.targets.includes(target.id) &&\n      effect.payload.kind === 'attack_roll_mode_modifier')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('Pass without Trace accepts a beneficiary at exactly 30 feet and exposes +10 in the Stealth modifier', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('pass-without-trace')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 2,\n      targeting: { kind: 'all_in_range', rangeFeet: 30 },\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'persistent_area', origin: 'anchored_to_caster', concentration: true, durationRounds: 600,\n        shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(30) },\n        hooks: [{\n          hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger',\n          effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'effect', payload: { kind: 'skill_modifier', skill: 'stealth', amount: 10 }, lifetime: { kind: 'while_inside' } } },\n        }],\n      },\n    });\n    const caster = casterFor('trace-caster', 2);\n    const beneficiary = monsterProfile('trace-beneficiary', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    const state = startedEncounter(caster, beneficiary, 6);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      cast(caster, 'pass-without-trace', 2, { targets: [caster.id, beneficiary.id] }),\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(effectiveSkillModifier(result, caster.id, 'stealth')).toBe(10);\n    expect(effectiveSkillModifier(result, beneficiary.id, 'stealth')).toBe(10);\n    expect(result.persistentAreas[0]?.owner).toBe(caster.id);\n    expect(result.persistentAreas[0]?.duration.kind).toBe('concentration');\n    let moving = reduceEncounter(result, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    moving = reduceEncounter(moving, {\n      type: 'move', actor: beneficiary.id, path: [{ column: 7, row: 0 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(effectiveSkillModifier(moving, beneficiary.id, 'stealth')).toBe(0);\n    moving = reduceEncounter(moving, {\n      type: 'move', actor: beneficiary.id, path: [{ column: 6, row: 0 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(effectiveSkillModifier(moving, beneficiary.id, 'stealth')).toBe(10);\n\n    const outside = startedEncounter(caster, beneficiary, 7);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(\n      outside,\n      cast(caster, 'pass-without-trace', 2, { targets: [beneficiary.id] }),\n      () => 0.5,\n    )).toThrow('out of range');\n  });\n\n  it('Entangle DC-1 applies Restrained in its exact square while an exact-DC save avoids it', () => {\n    const caster = casterFor('entangle-caster', 1);\n    const target = monsterProfile('entangle-target', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    const failed = reduceEncounter(\n      startedEncounter(caster, target),\n      cast(caster, 'entangle', 1, { area: cube20() }),\n      () => 0.4,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(failed, target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Restrained' });\n    expect(combatantConditions(failed, caster.id)).not.toContainEqual({ name: 'Restrained' });\n    const exactDc = reduceEncounter(\n      startedEncounter(caster, target),\n      cast(caster, 'entangle', 1, { area: cube20() }),\n      () => 0.45,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(exactDc, target.id)).not.toContainEqual({ name: 'Restrained' });\n    const terrain = reduceEncounter(exactDc, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const terrainMove = reduceEncounter(terrain, {\n      type: 'move', actor: target.id, path: [{ column: 3, row: 0 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(terrainMove.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ type: 'movement_completed', spent: feet(10) }));\n  });\n\n  it('Dissonant Whispers pins 3d6 Psychic, DC-1 full damage, and exact-DC half damage', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('dissonant-whispers')?.operation).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'save_damage', ability: 'wisdom', onSuccess: 'half', damageType: damageType('Psychic'),\n      dice: { baseCount: 3, sides: 6, perSlotCount: 1 },\n    });\n    const caster = casterFor('whispers-caster', 1);\n    const target = monsterProfile('whispers-target', { hitPoints: 50, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    const failed = reduceEncounter(\n      startedEncounter(caster, target),\n      cast(caster, 'dissonant-whispers', 1, { targets: [target.id] }),\n      sequenceRng([0, 0, 0, 0.4]),\n    ).state;\n    expect(failed.combatants.find((subject) => subject.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(47);\n\n    const exactDc = reduceEncounter(\n      startedEncounter(caster, target),\n      cast(caster, 'dissonant-whispers', 1, { targets: [target.id] }),\n      sequenceRng([0, 0, 0, 0.45]),\n    ).state;\n    expect(exactDc.combatants.find((subject) => subject.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(49);\n  });\n\n  it('Goodberry creates a ten-use pool whose bonus-action consumption decrements once and heals exactly 1 HP', () => {\n    const caster = casterFor('goodberry-caster', 1, { hitPoints: 20 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, monsterProfile('goodberry-witness', { initiativeBonus: 0 }));\n    state = {\n      ...state,\n      combatants: state.combatants.map((subject) =>\n        subject.profile.id === caster.id ? { ...subject, hitPoints: 5 } : subject),\n    };\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'goodberry', 1), () => 0.5).state;\n    const pool = state.effects.find((effect) => effect.payload.kind === 'consumable_healing_pool');\n    if (pool === undefined) throw new Error('Goodberry did not create its healing pool.');\n    expect(pool.payload).toMatchObject({ remainingUses: 10, healingPerUse: 1, activation: 'bonus_action' });\n\n    const consumed = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'consume_healing_pool', actor: caster.id, effectId: pool.id,\n    }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(consumed.state.combatants.find((subject) => subject.profile.id === caster.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(6);\n    expect(consumed.state.effects.find((effect) => effect.id === pool.id)?.payload)\n      .toMatchObject({ kind: 'consumable_healing_pool', remainingUses: 9 });\n    expect(consumed.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'healing_pool_consumed', combatant: caster.id, effectId: pool.id, remaining: 9,\n    }));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/effects.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1803","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle enforces at most one concentration effect per caster by ending the first"},{"id":"1804","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle runs a sourced repeated save at the target turn start boundary and not the other boundary"},{"id":"1805","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle runs a sourced repeated save at the target turn end boundary and not the other boundary"},{"id":"1806","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle expires exactly on its matching start duration boundary, never one turn late"},{"id":"1807","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle expires exactly on its matching end duration boundary, never one turn late"},{"id":"1808","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle applies recurring condition damage at its sourced start-of-turn boundary"},{"id":"1809","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle uses stacking identity to replace only the configured source scope"},{"id":"1810","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle represents a non-Exhaustion condition once even when two effects impose it"},{"id":"1811","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle accumulates Exhaustion contributions into one exact level and dies at level 6"},{"id":"1812","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle mints deterministic reducer effect ids and byte-equivalent event output"},{"id":"1813","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle pins concentration damage checks at the minimum DC 10 boundary"},{"id":"1814","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle pins concentration damage checks at the half damage rounded down to DC 11 boundary"},{"id":"1815","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle pins concentration damage checks at the maximum DC 30 boundary"},{"id":"1816","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle removes condition-immune targets inside the reducer and stores no empty effect"},{"id":"1817","name":"reducer-owned effect lifecycle requires the repeated-save boundary to name a source"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterReduction,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EffectApplication, TurnBoundary } from '../../../src/combat/effects';\nimport {\n  combatantId,\n  damageType,\n  dieSides,\n  effectStackingIdentity,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport type { EncounterCommand, EncounterEvent } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst fire = damageType('Fire');\n\nfunction setup(): {\n  readonly source: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly target: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n} {\n  const source = playerProfile('effect-source', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n  const target = monsterProfile('effect-target', { initiativeBonus: 0, usesDeathSaves: true });\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [source, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(source, 0), placedToken(target, 3)],\n  });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n  return { source, target, state };\n}\n\nfunction conditionEffect(\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  condition: 'Blinded' | 'Deafened' | 'Incapacitated',\n  options: {\n    readonly concentration?: boolean;\n    readonly identity?: string;\n    readonly duration?: EffectApplication['duration'];\n    readonly repeatedSave?: EffectApplication['repeatedSave'];\n  } = {},\n): EffectApplication {\n  return {\n    targets: [target.id],\n    duration: options.duration ?? { kind: 'permanent' },\n    concentration: options.concentration ?? false,\n    stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity(options.identity ?? `condition:${condition}`),\n    stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n    repeatedSave: options.repeatedSave ?? null,\n    payload: { kind: 'condition', condition },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction apply(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  source: CombatantProfile,\n  effect: EffectApplication,\n): EncounterReduction {\n  return reduceEncounter(\n    state,\n    { type: 'apply_effect', actor: source.id, effect, cost: 'none' },\n    () => 0.5,\n  );\n}\n\nfunction reachTargetTurn(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  source: CombatantProfile,\n): EncounterReduction {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: source.id }, () => 0.5);\n}\n\nfunction concentrationDamage(amount: number) {\n  return {\n    terms: [{ type: fire, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount } }],\n    critical: false,\n    responses: [],\n  } as const;\n}\n\nfunction concentrationAttack(\n  actor: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  amount: number,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: concentrationDamage(amount),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction rngForD20Faces(faces: readonly number[]): () => number {\n  let index = 0;\n  return () => {\n    const face = faces[index];\n    if (face === undefined) throw new Error('Test RNG exhausted.');\n    index += 1;\n    return (face - 0.5) / 20;\n  };\n}\n\nfunction runConcentrationDamage(\n  damageAmount: number,\n  constitutionSaveBonus: number,\n  saveFace: number,\n): { readonly effectCount: number; readonly save: Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'save_resolved' }> } {\n  const concentrator = monsterProfile('concentration-holder', {\n    hitPoints: 200,\n    initiativeBonus: 10,\n    constitutionSaveBonus,\n  });\n  const attacker = playerProfile('concentration-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n    combatants: [concentrator, attacker],\n    tokens: [placedToken(concentrator, 0), placedToken(attacker, 3)],\n  });\n  let state = reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n  state = apply(\n    state,\n    concentrator,\n    conditionEffect(attacker, 'Deafened', {\n      concentration: true,\n      identity: 'spell:concentration-dc',\n    }),\n  ).state;\n  state = reduceEncounter(\n    state,\n    { type: 'end_turn', actor: concentrator.id },\n    () => 0.5,\n  ).state;\n  const result = reduceEncounter(\n    state,\n    concentrationAttack(attacker, concentrator, damageAmount),\n    rngForD20Faces([11, saveFace]),\n  );\n  const save = result.events.find(\n    (event): event is Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'save_resolved' }> =>\n      event.type === 'save_resolved',\n  );\n  if (save === undefined) throw new Error('Missing concentration saving throw.');\n  return { effectCount: result.state.effects.length, save };\n}\n\ndescribe('reducer-owned effect lifecycle', () => {\n  it('enforces at most one concentration effect per caster by ending the first', () => {\n    const fixture = setup();\n    let result = apply(\n      fixture.state,\n      fixture.source,\n      conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Blinded', {\n        concentration: true,\n        identity: 'spell:first',\n      }),\n    );\n    const firstId = result.state.effects[0]?.id;\n    if (firstId === undefined) throw new Error('Missing first concentration effect.');\n\n    result = apply(\n      result.state,\n      fixture.source,\n      conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Deafened', {\n        concentration: true,\n        identity: 'spell:second',\n      }),\n    );\n\n    expect(result.state.effects).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(result.state.effects[0]).toMatchObject({\n      id: 'effect:2',\n      createdRevision: 3,\n      concentrationOwner: fixture.source.id,\n      payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Deafened' },\n    });\n    expect(result.events).toEqual([\n      {\n        sequence: 6,\n        type: 'effect_ended',\n        effectId: firstId,\n        reason: 'concentration_replaced',\n      },\n      {\n        sequence: 7,\n        type: 'effect_applied',\n        effectId: 'effect:2',\n        source: fixture.source.id,\n        targets: [fixture.target.id],\n      },\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it.each(['start', 'end'] as const)(\n    'runs a sourced repeated save at the target turn %s boundary and not the other boundary',\n    (boundary) => {\n      const fixture = setup();\n      const applied = apply(\n        fixture.state,\n        fixture.source,\n        conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Blinded', {\n          repeatedSave: {\n            timing: {\n              combatant: fixture.target.id,\n              boundary,\n              source: 'docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:test-fixture',\n            },\n            ability: 'wisdom',\n            dc: 30,\n            rollMode: 'normal',\n            onSuccess: 'remove_target',\n          },\n        }),\n      );\n      const targetStart = reachTargetTurn(applied.state, fixture.source);\n      const startSaves = targetStart.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved');\n\n      expect(applied.state.effects[0]?.repeatedSave).toEqual({\n        timing: {\n          combatant: fixture.target.id,\n          boundary,\n          source: 'docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:test-fixture',\n        },\n        ability: 'wisdom',\n        dc: 30,\n        rollMode: 'normal',\n        onSuccess: 'remove_target',\n      });\n\n      if (boundary === 'start') {\n        expect(startSaves).toMatchObject([\n          {\n            sequence: 7,\n            target: fixture.target.id,\n            ability: 'wisdom',\n            save: { outcome: 'failure', total: 11 },\n            effectId: applied.state.effects[0]?.id,\n          },\n        ]);\n      } else {\n        expect(startSaves).toHaveLength(0);\n        const targetEnd = reduceEncounter(\n          targetStart.state,\n          { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.target.id },\n          () => 0.5,\n        );\n        expect(targetEnd.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')).toMatchObject([\n          {\n            sequence: 8,\n            target: fixture.target.id,\n            ability: 'wisdom',\n            save: { outcome: 'failure', total: 11 },\n            effectId: applied.state.effects[0]?.id,\n          },\n        ]);\n      }\n    },\n  );\n\n  it.each(['start', 'end'] as const)(\n    'expires exactly on its matching %s duration boundary, never one turn late',\n    (boundary) => {\n      const fixture = setup();\n      const applied = apply(\n        fixture.state,\n        fixture.source,\n        conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Deafened', {\n          duration: {\n            kind: 'turn_boundaries',\n            timing: {\n              combatant: fixture.target.id,\n              boundary,\n              source: 'docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:test-fixture',\n            },\n            remaining: 1,\n          },\n        }),\n      );\n      const targetStart = reachTargetTurn(applied.state, fixture.source);\n\n      expect(applied.state.effects[0]?.duration).toEqual({\n        kind: 'turn_boundaries',\n        timing: {\n          combatant: fixture.target.id,\n          boundary,\n          source: 'docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:test-fixture',\n        },\n        remaining: 1,\n      });\n\n      if (boundary === 'start') {\n        expect(targetStart.state.effects).toHaveLength(0);\n        expect(targetStart.events).toContainEqual({\n          sequence: 7,\n          type: 'effect_clock_ticked',\n          effectId: applied.state.effects[0]?.id,\n          boundary,\n          remaining: 0,\n        });\n        expect(targetStart.events).toContainEqual({\n          sequence: 8,\n          type: 'effect_ended',\n          effectId: applied.state.effects[0]?.id,\n          reason: 'duration_expired',\n        });\n      } else {\n        expect(targetStart.state.effects).toHaveLength(1);\n        const targetEnd = reduceEncounter(\n          targetStart.state,\n          { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.target.id },\n          () => 0.5,\n        );\n        expect(targetEnd.state.effects).toHaveLength(0);\n        expect(targetEnd.events).toContainEqual({\n          sequence: 8,\n          type: 'effect_clock_ticked',\n          effectId: applied.state.effects[0]?.id,\n          boundary,\n          remaining: 0,\n        });\n        expect(targetEnd.events).toContainEqual({\n          sequence: 9,\n          type: 'effect_ended',\n          effectId: applied.state.effects[0]?.id,\n          reason: 'duration_expired',\n        });\n      }\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('applies recurring condition damage at its sourced start-of-turn boundary', () => {\n    const fixture = setup();\n    const applied = apply(fixture.state, fixture.source, {\n      targets: [fixture.target.id],\n      duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n      concentration: false,\n      stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('ongoing:fire'),\n      stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n      repeatedSave: null,\n      payload: {\n        kind: 'ongoing_damage',\n        timing: {\n          combatant: fixture.target.id,\n          boundary: 'start',\n          source: 'D254; docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt',\n        },\n        damage: {\n          terms: [{ type: fire, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 3 } }],\n          critical: false,\n          responses: [],\n        },\n      },\n    });\n\n    expect(applied.state.effects[0]?.payload).toEqual({\n      kind: 'ongoing_damage',\n      timing: {\n        combatant: fixture.target.id,\n        boundary: 'start',\n        source: 'D254; docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt',\n      },\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: fire, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 3 } }],\n        critical: false,\n        responses: [],\n      },\n    });\n    expect(\n      applied.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied'),\n    ).toHaveLength(0);\n    const started = reachTargetTurn(applied.state, fixture.source);\n    expect(\n      started.events.find((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied'),\n    ).toMatchObject({ target: fixture.target.id, amount: 3, hitPointsAfter: 7 });\n  });\n\n  it('uses stacking identity to replace only the configured source scope', () => {\n    const fixture = setup();\n    const first = apply(\n      fixture.state,\n      fixture.source,\n      conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Blinded', { identity: 'shared-stack' }),\n    );\n    const second = apply(\n      first.state,\n      fixture.source,\n      conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Deafened', { identity: 'shared-stack' }),\n    );\n\n    expect(second.state.effects).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(second.events.some(\n      (event) => event.type === 'effect_ended' && event.reason === 'stacking_replaced',\n    )).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('represents a non-Exhaustion condition once even when two effects impose it', () => {\n    const fixture = setup();\n    const first = apply(\n      fixture.state,\n      fixture.source,\n      conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Blinded', { identity: 'blind:first' }),\n    );\n    const second = apply(\n      first.state,\n      fixture.source,\n      conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Blinded', { identity: 'blind:second' }),\n    );\n\n    expect(second.state.effects).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(combatantConditions(second.state, fixture.target.id)).toEqual([\n      { name: 'Blinded' },\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('accumulates Exhaustion contributions into one exact level and dies at level 6', () => {\n    const fixture = setup();\n    const exhaustion = (identity: string): EffectApplication => ({\n      targets: [fixture.target.id],\n      duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n      concentration: false,\n      stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity(identity),\n      stacking: 'coexist',\n      repeatedSave: null,\n      payload: { kind: 'exhaustion', level: 3 },\n    });\n    const first = apply(\n      fixture.state,\n      fixture.source,\n      exhaustion('exhaustion:first'),\n    );\n    const second = apply(\n      first.state,\n      fixture.source,\n      exhaustion('exhaustion:second'),\n    );\n\n    expect(first.state.effects[0]?.payload).toEqual({ kind: 'exhaustion', level: 3 });\n    expect(combatantConditions(first.state, fixture.target.id)).toEqual([\n      { name: 'Exhaustion', level: 3 },\n    ]);\n    expect(combatantConditions(second.state, fixture.target.id)).toEqual([\n      { name: 'Exhaustion', level: 6 },\n    ]);\n    expect(\n      second.state.combatants.find(\n        (candidate) => candidate.profile.id === fixture.target.id,\n      ),\n    ).toMatchObject({ hitPoints: 0, life: 'dead' });\n  });\n\n  it('mints deterministic reducer effect ids and byte-equivalent event output', () => {\n    const run = () => {\n      const fixture = setup();\n      return apply(\n        fixture.state,\n        fixture.source,\n        conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Blinded', { identity: 'deterministic' }),\n      );\n    };\n    const first = run();\n    const second = run();\n\n    expect(first.state.nextEffectSequence).toBe(2);\n    expect(first.state.effects).toMatchObject([{ id: 'effect:1', createdRevision: 2 }]);\n    expect(first.events).toEqual([\n      {\n        sequence: 5,\n        type: 'effect_applied',\n        effectId: 'effect:1',\n        source: first.state.effects[0]?.source,\n        targets: first.state.effects[0]?.targets,\n      },\n    ]);\n    expect(JSON.stringify(first.events)).toBe(JSON.stringify(second.events));\n    expect(first.events).toEqual(second.events);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['minimum DC 10', 1, 0, 10, 0, 9],\n    ['half damage rounded down to DC 11', 23, 0, 11, 0, 10],\n    ['maximum DC 30', 100, 10, 20, 10, 19],\n  ] as const)(\n    'pins concentration damage checks at the %s boundary',\n    (\n      _boundary,\n      damageAmount,\n      successBonus,\n      successFace,\n      failureBonus,\n      failureFace,\n    ) => {\n      const success = runConcentrationDamage(damageAmount, successBonus, successFace);\n      const failure = runConcentrationDamage(damageAmount, failureBonus, failureFace);\n\n      expect(success.save.save).toMatchObject({\n        outcome: 'success',\n        roll: { faces: [successFace], chosen: successFace },\n        total: successFace + successBonus,\n      });\n      expect(success.effectCount).toBe(1);\n      expect(failure.save.save).toMatchObject({\n        outcome: 'failure',\n        roll: { faces: [failureFace], chosen: failureFace },\n        total: failureFace + failureBonus,\n      });\n      expect(failure.effectCount).toBe(0);\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('removes condition-immune targets inside the reducer and stores no empty effect', () => {\n    const source = playerProfile('immune-source', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const target = monsterProfile('immune-target', {\n      initiativeBonus: 0,\n      conditionImmunities: ['Blinded'],\n    });\n    const initial = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [source, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(source, 0), placedToken(target, 3)],\n    });\n    const state = reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const result = apply(state, source, conditionEffect(target, 'Blinded'));\n\n    expect(result.state.effects).toHaveLength(0);\n    expect(result.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([\n      'effect_target_removed',\n      'effect_ended',\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('requires the repeated-save boundary to name a source', () => {\n    const fixture = setup();\n    const invalid = conditionEffect(fixture.target, 'Blinded', {\n      repeatedSave: {\n        timing: {\n          combatant: combatantId('combatant:effect-target'),\n          boundary: 'end' as TurnBoundary,\n          source: ' ',\n        },\n        ability: 'wisdom',\n        dc: 12,\n        rollMode: 'normal',\n        onSuccess: 'remove_target',\n      },\n    });\n\n    expect(() => apply(fixture.state, fixture.source, invalid)).toThrow(\n      'Repeated-save timing requires a source locator',\n    );\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/death-saves.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1818","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow queues a closed death_save PendingDecision at the start of a dying PC turn"},{"id":"1819","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins d20 1 as natural_1 with exact counters and HP"},{"id":"1820","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins d20 2 as failure with exact counters and HP"},{"id":"1821","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins d20 9 as failure with exact counters and HP"},{"id":"1822","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins d20 10 as success with exact counters and HP"},{"id":"1823","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins d20 19 as success with exact counters and HP"},{"id":"1824","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins d20 20 as natural_20 with exact counters and HP"},{"id":"1825","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins success at 10 rather than 11"},{"id":"1826","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins a natural 1 to exactly two failures"},{"id":"1827","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow pins ordinary save and damage-at-zero marks
