flow three successes stabilize and reset both counters"},{"id":"1830","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow three failures kill"},{"id":"1831","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow stabilized then healed transitions stable to conscious and keeps counters reset"},{"id":"1832","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow healing at 0 HP restores consciousness and clears a queued Death Save"},{"id":"1833","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow damage at 0 HP adds one failure and restarts a stable creature as dying"},{"id":"1834","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow critical damage at 0 HP adds two failures while normal damage adds one"},{"id":"1835","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow survives when initial overkill is one point below the massive-damage boundary"},{"id":"1836","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow massive_damage_remainder_boundary: exact-maximum remainder kills while one less leaves the character dying"},{"id":"1837","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow massive_damage_ignored: kills at the exact massive-damage boundary while already at 0 HP"},{"id":"1838","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow override_unlogged: every explicit DM death override emits a D357 adjudicated ruling card"},{"id":"1839","name":"SRD death-save reducer flow hidden_roll_leaks: the toggle redacts only the number from PlayerView while DmView retains it"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand, EncounterEvent } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { projectDmView, projectPlayerView } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { damageType, dieSides } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst force = damageType('Force');\n\nconst DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS = Object.freeze({\n  successFloor: 10,\n  resolutionCount: 3,\n  naturalOne: 1,\n  naturalOneFailures: 2,\n  naturalTwenty: 20,\n  naturalTwentyHitPoints: 1,\n  ordinarySuccessMarks: 1,\n  ordinaryFailureMarks: 1,\n  damageAtZeroFailures: 1,\n  criticalDamageAtZeroFailures: 2,\n});\n\nfunction fixedD20(face: number): () => number {\n  return () => (face - 0.5) / 20;\n}\n\nfunction attack(\n  actor: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  amount: number,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{\n        type: force,\n        dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount },\n      }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction subject(state: EncounterState, profile: CombatantProfile) {\n  const found = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === profile.id);\n  if (found === undefined) throw new Error('Missing death-save fixture combatant.');\n  return found;\n}\n\nfunction dyingEncounter(): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly attacker: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly patient: CombatantProfile;\n} {\n  const attacker = playerProfile('death-save-attacker', {\n    hitPoints: 30,\n    initiativeBonus: 20,\n    attacksPerAction: 2,\n  });\n  const patient = playerProfile('death-save-patient', {\n    hitPoints: 10,\n    initiativeBonus: -20,\n  });\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [attacker, patient],\n    tokens: [placedToken(attacker, 0), placedToken(patient, 1)],\n  });\n  const started = reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(11)).state;\n  const state = reduceEncounter(started, attack(attacker, patient, 10), fixedD20(11)).state;\n  return { state, attacker, patient };\n}\n\nfunction startPatientTurn(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  attacker: CombatantProfile,\n  deathSaveFace: number,\n): { readonly state: EncounterState; readonly event: Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'death_save_resolved' }> } {\n  const started = reduceEncounter(\n    state,\n    { type: 'end_turn', actor: attacker.id },\n    fixedD20(11),\n  );\n  const decision = started.state.pendingDecisions.find((candidate) =>\n    candidate.kind === 'death_save');\n  if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Missing death-save pending decision.');\n  const reduction = reduceEncounter(started.state, {\n    type: 'resolve_pending_decision',\n    decisionId: decision.id,\n    optionId: 'roll',\n  }, fixedD20(deathSaveFace));\n  const event = reduction.events.find(\n    (candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'death_save_resolved' }> =>\n      candidate.type === 'death_save_resolved',\n  );\n  if (event === undefined) throw new Error('Missing death-save result event.');\n  return { state: reduction.state, event };\n}\n\nfunction advanceToAttacker(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  patient: CombatantProfile,\n): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(\n    state,\n    { type: 'end_turn', actor: patient.id },\n    fixedD20(11),\n  ).state;\n}\n\ndescribe('SRD death-save reducer flow', () => {\n  it('queues a closed death_save PendingDecision at the start of a dying PC turn', () => {\n    // Start-of-turn Death Save: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:1084-1093,11633-11636.\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    const started = reduceEncounter(\n      fixture.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.attacker.id },\n      fixedD20(11),\n    );\n    expect(started.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'pending_decision_queued',\n      kind: 'death_save',\n      combatant: fixture.patient.id,\n    }));\n    expect(started.state.pendingDecisions).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'death_save',\n      combatant: fixture.patient.id,\n      options: [{ id: 'roll', label: 'Roll Death Save' }],\n    }));\n    expect(started.events.some((event) => event.type === 'death_save_resolved')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [1, 'natural_1', 0, 2, 'dying', 0],\n    [2, 'failure', 0, 1, 'dying', 0],\n    [9, 'failure', 0, 1, 'dying', 0],\n    [10, 'success', 1, 0, 'dying', 0],\n    [19, 'success', 1, 0, 'dying', 0],\n    [20, 'natural_20', 0, 0, 'living', 1],\n  ] as const)(\n    'pins d20 %i as %s with exact counters and HP',\n    (roll, outcome, successes, failures, life, hitPoints) => {\n      const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n      const result = startPatientTurn(fixture.state, fixture.attacker, roll);\n\n      expect(result.event).toMatchObject({\n        roll,\n        outcome,\n        successes,\n        failures,\n        lifeState: life,\n        stableRecovery: null,\n      });\n      expect(subject(result.state, fixture.patient)).toMatchObject({\n        hitPoints,\n        life,\n      });\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('pins success at 10 rather than 11', () => {\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.successFloor).toBe(10);\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    expect(startPatientTurn(fixture.state, fixture.attacker, 10).event.outcome).toBe(\n      'success',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('pins a natural 1 to exactly two failures', () => {\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.naturalOne).toBe(1);\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.naturalOneFailures).toBe(2);\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    const result = startPatientTurn(fixture.state, fixture.attacker, 1);\n    expect(result.event.failures).toBe(2);\n    expect(subject(result.state, fixture.patient).deathSaves).toEqual({\n      successes: 0,\n      failures: 2,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('pins ordinary save and damage-at-zero marks independently', () => {\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.ordinarySuccessMarks).toBe(1);\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.ordinaryFailureMarks).toBe(1);\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.damageAtZeroFailures).toBe(1);\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.criticalDamageAtZeroFailures).toBe(2);\n  });\n\n  it('nat20_plain_success: a natural 20 restores exactly 1 HP and a playable conscious turn', () => {\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.naturalTwenty).toBe(20);\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.naturalTwentyHitPoints).toBe(1);\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    const result = startPatientTurn(fixture.state, fixture.attacker, 20);\n    expect(subject(result.state, fixture.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 1,\n      life: 'living',\n      deathSaves: null,\n      turn: {\n        action: { kind: 'available' },\n        bonusActionAvailable: true,\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['three successes stabilize and reset both counters', 10, 'stable'],\n    ['three failures kill', 9, 'dead'],\n  ] as const)('%s', (_label, roll, life) => {\n    expect(DEATH_SAVE_RULE_EXPECTATIONS.resolutionCount).toBe(3);\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    let state = fixture.state;\n    let finalEvent: Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'death_save_resolved' }> | null = null;\n    for (let count = 0; count < 3; count += 1) {\n      const result = startPatientTurn(state, fixture.attacker, roll);\n      state = result.state;\n      finalEvent = result.event;\n      if (count < 2) state = advanceToAttacker(state, fixture.patient);\n    }\n    expect(finalEvent).toMatchObject({\n      lifeState: life,\n      stableRecovery: life === 'stable' ? '1d4_hours_outside_encounter' : null,\n    });\n    expect(subject(state, fixture.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 0,\n      life,\n      deathSaves: null,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('stabilized then healed transitions stable to conscious and keeps counters reset', () => {\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    let state = fixture.state;\n    for (let count = 0; count < 3; count += 1) {\n      state = startPatientTurn(state, fixture.attacker, 10).state;\n      if (count < 2) state = advanceToAttacker(state, fixture.patient);\n    }\n    state = advanceToAttacker(state, fixture.patient);\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      {\n        type: 'heal',\n        actor: fixture.attacker.id,\n        target: fixture.patient.id,\n        amount: 2,\n        cost: 'none',\n      },\n      fixedD20(11),\n    ).state;\n    expect(subject(state, fixture.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 2,\n      life: 'living',\n      deathSaves: null,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('healing at 0 HP restores consciousness and clears a queued Death Save', () => {\n    // Healing ends Unconsciousness and resets Death Saves: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:1081-1099.\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    let state = reduceEncounter(\n      fixture.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.attacker.id },\n      fixedD20(11),\n    ).state;\n    expect(state.pendingDecisions).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'death_save' }));\n    state = reduceEncounter({ ...state, activeCombatant: fixture.attacker.id }, {\n      type: 'heal',\n      actor: fixture.attacker.id,\n      target: fixture.patient.id,\n      amount: 1,\n      cost: 'none',\n    }, fixedD20(11)).state;\n    expect(subject(state, fixture.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 1,\n      life: 'living',\n      deathSaves: null,\n    });\n    expect(state.pendingDecisions).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it('damage at 0 HP adds one failure and restarts a stable creature as dying', () => {\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    let state = fixture.state;\n    for (let count = 0; count < 3; count += 1) {\n      state = startPatientTurn(state, fixture.attacker, 10).state;\n      if (count < 2) state = advanceToAttacker(state, fixture.patient);\n    }\n    state = advanceToAttacker(state, fixture.patient);\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      {\n        type: 'force_save',\n        actor: fixture.attacker.id,\n        target: fixture.patient.id,\n        ability: 'constitution',\n        dc: 30,\n        rollMode: 'normal',\n        damage: {\n          terms: [{\n            type: force,\n            dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 },\n          }],\n          critical: false,\n          responses: [],\n        },\n        onSuccess: 'none',\n        cost: 'none',\n      },\n      fixedD20(11),\n    ).state;\n    expect(subject(state, fixture.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 0,\n      life: 'dying',\n      deathSaves: { successes: 0, failures: 1 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('critical damage at 0 HP adds two failures while normal damage adds one', () => {\n    const ordinary = dyingEncounter();\n    const ordinaryState = reduceEncounter(\n      ordinary.state,\n      {\n        type: 'force_save',\n        actor: ordinary.attacker.id,\n        target: ordinary.patient.id,\n        ability: 'constitution',\n        dc: 30,\n        rollMode: 'normal',\n        damage: {\n          terms: [{\n            type: force,\n            dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 },\n          }],\n          critical: false,\n          responses: [],\n        },\n        onSuccess: 'none',\n        cost: 'none',\n      },\n      fixedD20(11),\n    ).state;\n    const critical = dyingEncounter();\n    const criticalState = reduceEncounter(\n      critical.state,\n      attack(critical.attacker, critical.patient, 1),\n      fixedD20(20),\n    ).state;\n    expect(subject(ordinaryState, ordinary.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      life: 'dying',\n      deathSaves: { successes: 0, failures: 1 },\n    });\n    expect(subject(criticalState, critical.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      life: 'dying',\n      deathSaves: { successes: 0, failures: 2 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('survives when initial overkill is one point below the massive-damage boundary', () => {\n    const attacker = playerProfile('below-boundary-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const patient = playerProfile('below-boundary-patient', {\n      hitPoints: 10,\n      initiativeBonus: -20,\n    });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 3, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [attacker, patient],\n      tokens: [placedToken(attacker, 0), placedToken(patient, 1)],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(11)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(attacker, patient, 19), fixedD20(11)).state;\n    expect(subject(state, patient)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 0,\n      life: 'dying',\n      deathSaves: { successes: 0, failures: 0 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('massive_damage_remainder_boundary: exact-maximum remainder kills while one less leaves the character dying', () => {\n    // SRD example: max 12, current 6, 18 damage leaves 12 and kills:\n    // docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:1062-1067.\n    const applyExampleDamage = (amount: 17 | 18, fixtureName: string) => {\n      const attacker = playerProfile(`${fixtureName}-attacker`, {\n        initiativeBonus: 20,\n        attacksPerAction: 2,\n      });\n      const patient = playerProfile(`${fixtureName}-patient`, {\n        hitPoints: 12,\n        initiativeBonus: -20,\n      });\n      let state = createEncounter({\n        bounds: { columns: 3, rows: 2 },\n        combatants: [attacker, patient],\n        tokens: [placedToken(attacker, 0), placedToken(patient, 1)],\n      });\n      state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(11)).state;\n      state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(attacker, patient, 6), fixedD20(11)).state;\n      expect(subject(state, patient).hitPoints).toBe(6);\n      const result = reduceEncounter(state, attack(attacker, patient, amount), fixedD20(11));\n      const damageEvent = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied');\n      return { result, damageEvent, patient };\n    };\n\n    const exact = applyExampleDamage(18, 'exact-boundary');\n    expect(exact.damageEvent).toMatchObject({\n      amount: 18,\n      hitPointsBefore: 6,\n      hitPointsAfter: 0,\n      massiveDamage: true,\n      lifeState: 'dead',\n    });\n    expect(subject(exact.result.state, exact.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 0,\n      life: 'dead',\n      deathSaves: null,\n    });\n\n    const oneBelow = applyExampleDamage(17, 'below-boundary-sibling');\n    expect(oneBelow.damageEvent).toMatchObject({\n      amount: 17,\n      hitPointsBefore: 6,\n      hitPointsAfter: 0,\n      massiveDamage: false,\n      lifeState: 'dying',\n    });\n    expect(subject(oneBelow.result.state, oneBelow.patient)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 0,\n      life: 'dying',\n      deathSaves: { successes: 0, failures: 0 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('massive_damage_ignored: kills at the exact massive-damage boundary while already at 0 HP', () => {\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    const result = reduceEncounter(\n      fixture.state,\n      {\n        type: 'force_save',\n        actor: fixture.attacker.id,\n        target: fixture.patient.id,\n        ability: 'constitution',\n        dc: 30,\n        rollMode: 'normal',\n        damage: {\n          terms: [{\n            type: force,\n            dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 10 },\n          }],\n          critical: false,\n          responses: [],\n        },\n        onSuccess: 'none',\n        cost: 'none',\n      },\n      fixedD20(11),\n    );\n    const damageEvent = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied');\n    expect(damageEvent).toMatchObject({\n      amount: 10,\n      hitPointsBefore: 0,\n      massiveDamage: true,\n      lifeState: 'dead',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('override_unlogged: every explicit DM death override emits a D357 adjudicated ruling card', () => {\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    const commands = [\n      { type: 'dm_stabilize', target: fixture.patient.id },\n      { type: 'dm_revive_at_one_hit_point', target: fixture.patient.id },\n      { type: 'dm_set_death_save_counts', target: fixture.patient.id, successes: 2, failures: 1 },\n      { type: 'dm_mark_dead', target: fixture.patient.id },\n    ] as const satisfies readonly EncounterCommand[];\n    let state = fixture.state;\n    const overrides: string[] = [];\n    for (const command of commands) {\n      const reduction = reduceEncounter(state, command, fixedD20(11));\n      state = reduction.state;\n      const ruling = reduction.events.find((event) => event.type === 'adjudicated');\n      expect(ruling).toMatchObject({\n        type: 'adjudicated',\n        target: fixture.patient.id,\n        subject: expect.stringMatching(/^dm-override:/u),\n        consequence: expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'death_override' }),\n      });\n      if (ruling?.type === 'adjudicated' && ruling.consequence.kind === 'death_override') {\n        overrides.push(ruling.consequence.override);\n      }\n    }\n    expect(overrides).toEqual([\n      'stabilize',\n      'revive_at_one_hit_point',\n      'set_death_save_counts',\n      'mark_dead',\n    ]);\n    expect(subject(state, fixture.patient)).toMatchObject({ life: 'dead', hitPoints: 0, deathSaves: null });\n  });\n\n  it('hidden_roll_leaks: the toggle redacts only the number from PlayerView while DmView retains it', () => {\n    const fixture = dyingEncounter();\n    const resolved = startPatientTurn(fixture.state, fixture.attacker, 9).state;\n    const dm = projectDmView(resolved);\n    const shownState = reduceEncounter(resolved, {\n      type: 'set_hidden_roll_category', category: 'death_saves', hidden: false,\n    }, fixedD20(11)).state;\n    const hiddenState = reduceEncounter(resolved, {\n      type: 'set_hidden_roll_category', category: 'death_saves', hidden: true,\n    }, fixedD20(11)).state;\n    const shown = projectPlayerView(shownState, {\n      seatId: 'seat:death-save',\n      combatantId: fixture.patient.id,\n    });\n    const hidden = projectPlayerView(hiddenState, {\n      seatId: 'seat:death-save',\n      combatantId: fixture.patient.id,\n    });\n    const shownEvent = shown.recentEvents.find((event) => event.type === 'death_save_resolved');\n    const hiddenEvent = hidden.recentEvents.find((event) => event.type === 'death_save_resolved');\n    expect(shownEvent).toMatchObject({ rollVisibility: 'player_visible', roll: 9, lifeState: 'dying' });\n    expect(hiddenEvent).toMatchObject({ rollVisibility: 'dm_only', lifeState: 'dying', failures: 1 });\n    expect(hiddenEvent === undefined ? true : Object.hasOwn(hiddenEvent, 'roll')).toBe(false);\n    expect(dm.state.eventLog.find((event) => event.type === 'death_save_resolved')).toMatchObject({ roll: 9 });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/world-objects.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1840","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment wall_ignored_by_pathing: a movement blocker forces a strictly longer route"},{"id":"1841","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment a sight-blocker breaks line of sight and targeting"},{"id":"1842","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment cover_tier_off_by_one: half and three-quarters cover change exact attack boundaries"},{"id":"1843","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment cover_no_bonus: line-crossing cover grants its cited AC and Dexterity-save bonus"},{"id":"1844","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment cover_blocks_allies_only: line-crossing cover protects monster and player targets symmetrically"},{"id":"1845","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment pins the three applied, killed, and restored cover-map mutations"},{"id":"1846","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment difficult_terrain_not_doubled: difficult terrain doubles entry cost exactly once"},{"id":"1847","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment destroyed_object_still_blocks: damage destroys an HP object and immediately opens its cell"},{"id":"1848","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment a light-level mutation flips the visibility query"},{"id":"1849","name":"typed world objects and encounter environment replaying object commands reconstructs the state byte-exactly"}],"source":"import { readFileSync } from '../../helpers/test-filesystem';\nimport { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { canonicalJson } from '../../../src/commands/canonical-json';\nimport {\n  canCombatantSee,\n  createEncounter,\n  encounterMovementWorld,\n  hasLineOfSight,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { findPath } from '../../../src/combat/movement';\nimport { armorClass, damageType, dieSides, feet, worldObjectId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport type { CoverTier, WorldObject } from '../../../src/combat/world-objects';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst force = damageType('Force');\n\nfunction object(\n  id: string,\n  cells: readonly { readonly column: number; readonly row: number }[],\n  options: {\n    readonly movement?: boolean;\n    readonly sight?: boolean;\n    readonly cover?: CoverTier;\n    readonly hitPoints?: number;\n  } = {},\n): WorldObject {\n  const position = cells[0];\n  if (position === undefined) throw new Error('A test world object needs a footprint.');\n  return {\n    id: worldObjectId(`object:${id}`),\n    name: `Homebrew ${id}`,\n    kind: 'barrier',\n    position,\n    footprint: cells,\n    durability: options.hitPoints === undefined\n      ? { kind: 'indestructible' }\n      : { kind: 'hit_points', hitPoints: options.hitPoints, maximumHitPoints: options.hitPoints },\n    armorClass: armorClass(12),\n    damageResponses: [],\n    blocking: {\n      movement: options.movement ?? false,\n      lineOfSight: options.sight ?? false,\n      cover: options.cover ?? 'none',\n    },\n    createdRevision: 0,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction setup(worldObjects: readonly WorldObject[] = []): EncounterState {\n  const actor = playerProfile('world-actor', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const target = monsterProfile('world-target', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 40 });\n  return createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 5 },\n    combatants: [actor, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0, 2), placedToken(target, 6, 2)],\n    worldObjects,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction started(worldObjects: readonly WorldObject[] = []): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(setup(worldObjects), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\nfunction attack(state: EncounterState): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  const actor = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.kind === 'player_character')?.profile;\n  const target = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.kind === 'monster')?.profile;\n  if (actor === undefined || target === undefined) throw new Error('Attack fixture is incomplete.');\n  return {\n    type: 'attack', actor: actor.id, target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 0, criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: force, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 } }],\n      critical: false, responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attackBy(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  actorKind: 'player_character' | 'monster',\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  const actor = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.kind === actorKind)?.profile;\n  const target = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.kind !== actorKind)?.profile;\n  if (actor === undefined || target === undefined) throw new Error('Attack fixture is incomplete.');\n  return {\n    ...attack(state),\n    actor: actor.id,\n    target: target.id,\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('typed world objects and encounter environment', () => {\n  it('wall_ignored_by_pathing: a movement blocker forces a strictly longer route', () => {\n    const wall = object('path-wall', [2, 3, 4].flatMap((column) =>\n      [0, 1, 2, 3].map((row) => ({ column, row }))), { movement: true });\n    const state = setup([wall]);\n    const actor = state.combatants[0]?.profile.id;\n    if (actor === undefined) throw new Error('Path fixture has no actor.');\n    const path = findPath(encounterMovementWorld(state), {\n      actorId: actor,\n      start: { column: 0, row: 2 },\n      goal: { column: 6, row: 1 },\n      maximumCost: feet(100),\n    });\n    expect(path).toMatchObject({ kind: 'found' });\n    if (path.kind !== 'found') throw new Error('Wall route was unexpectedly unreachable.');\n    expect(path.cost).toBeGreaterThan(30);\n    expect(path.cells.some((cell) => cell.column >= 2 && cell.column <= 4 && cell.row < 4)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('a sight-blocker breaks line of sight and targeting', () => {\n    const blocker = object('sight-wall', [{ column: 3, row: 2 }], { sight: true });\n    const state = started([blocker]);\n    expect(hasLineOfSight(state, { column: 0, row: 2 }, { column: 6, row: 2 })).toBe(false);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(state, attack(state), () => 0.65)).toThrow('outside line of sight');\n  });\n\n  it('cover_tier_off_by_one: half and three-quarters cover change exact attack boundaries', () => {\n    const half = started([object('half-cover', [{ column: 3, row: 2 }], { cover: 'half' })]);\n    const halfHit = reduceEncounter(half, attack(half), () => 0.65);\n    expect(halfHit.events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved')?.attack.outcome).toBe('hit');\n\n    const threeQuarters = started([object('three-cover', [{ column: 3, row: 2 }], { cover: 'three_quarters' })]);\n    const threeQuarterMiss = reduceEncounter(threeQuarters, attack(threeQuarters), () => 0.65);\n    expect(threeQuarterMiss.events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved')?.attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n  });\n\n  it('cover_no_bonus: line-crossing cover grants its cited AC and Dexterity-save bonus', () => {\n    const halfAttack = started([object('half-cover-ac', [{ column: 3, row: 2 }], { cover: 'half' })]);\n    const coveredAttack = reduceEncounter(halfAttack, attack(halfAttack), () => 0.6);\n    expect(coveredAttack.events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved')?.attack)\n      .toMatchObject({ outcome: 'miss', total: 13 });\n\n    const halfSave = started([object('half-cover-dex', [{ column: 3, row: 2 }], { cover: 'half' })]);\n    const actor = halfSave.activeCombatant;\n    const target = halfSave.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.kind === 'monster')?.profile.id;\n    if (actor === null || target === undefined) throw new Error('Cover save fixture is incomplete.');\n    const coveredSave = reduceEncounter(halfSave, {\n      type: 'force_save', actor, target, ability: 'dexterity', dc: 12,\n      rollMode: 'normal', damage: { terms: [], critical: false, responses: [] },\n      onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n    }, () => 0.45);\n    expect(coveredSave.events.find((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')?.save)\n      .toMatchObject({ outcome: 'success', total: 12 });\n\n    const threeQuarterSave = started([\n      object('three-quarter-cover-dex', [{ column: 3, row: 2 }], { cover: 'three_quarters' }),\n    ]);\n    const threeQuarterActor = threeQuarterSave.activeCombatant;\n    const threeQuarterTarget = threeQuarterSave.combatants\n      .find((entry) => entry.profile.kind === 'monster')?.profile.id;\n    if (threeQuarterActor === null || threeQuarterTarget === undefined) {\n      throw new Error('Three-quarters cover save fixture is incomplete.');\n    }\n    const threeQuarterCoveredSave = reduceEncounter(threeQuarterSave, {\n      type: 'force_save', actor: threeQuarterActor, target: threeQuarterTarget,\n      ability: 'dexterity', dc: 15, rollMode: 'normal',\n      damage: { terms: [], critical: false, responses: [] }, onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n    }, () => 0.45);\n    expect(threeQuarterCoveredSave.events.find((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')?.save)\n      .toMatchObject({ outcome: 'success', total: 15 });\n  });\n\n  it('cover_blocks_allies_only: line-crossing cover protects monster and player targets symmetrically', () => {\n    const coverObject = object('symmetric-half-cover', [{ column: 3, row: 2 }], { cover: 'half' });\n    const player = playerProfile('cover-symmetry-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('cover-symmetry-monster', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const playerAttacks = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 5 },\n      combatants: [player, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(player, 0, 2), placedToken(monster, 6, 2)],\n      worldObjects: [coverObject],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(reduceEncounter(playerAttacks, attackBy(playerAttacks, 'player_character'), () => 0.6)\n      .events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved')?.attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n\n    const monsterActsFirst = monsterProfile('cover-symmetry-first-monster', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const playerActsSecond = playerProfile('cover-symmetry-second-player', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const monsterAttacks = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 5 },\n      combatants: [monsterActsFirst, playerActsSecond],\n      tokens: [placedToken(monsterActsFirst, 0, 2), placedToken(playerActsSecond, 6, 2)],\n      worldObjects: [coverObject],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(reduceEncounter(monsterAttacks, attackBy(monsterAttacks, 'monster'), () => 0.7)\n      .events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved')?.attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n  });\n\n  it('pins the three applied, killed, and restored cover-map mutations', () => {\n    const ledger = readFileSync('docs/audits/2026-08-25-cover-maps-mutation-ledger.md', 'utf8');\n    const mechanicsTests = readFileSync('tests/unit/combat/world-objects.test.ts', 'utf8');\n    const policyTests = readFileSync('tests/integration/vtt/pc-algorithm-policy.test.ts', 'utf8');\n    for (const mutation of ['cover_no_bonus', 'cover_blocks_allies_only']) {\n      expect(ledger).toContain(`\\`${mutation}\\``);\n      expect(mechanicsTests).toContain(`${mutation}:`);\n    }\n    expect(ledger).toContain('`policy_ignores_cover`');\n    expect(policyTests).toContain('policy_ignores_cover:');\n    expect(ledger.match(/`exit 1`/gu)).toHaveLength(3);\n    expect(ledger).toContain('All three mutations were restored.');\n  });\n\n  it('difficult_terrain_not_doubled: difficult terrain doubles entry cost exactly once', () => {\n    const base = started();\n    const actor = base.activeCombatant;\n    if (actor === null) throw new Error('Movement fixture has no active actor.');\n    const transformed = reduceEncounter(base, {\n      type: 'world_operation', actor, cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'transform_terrain', difficultTerrain: true,\n        region: { id: 'homebrew-mire', cells: [{ column: 1, row: 2 }] },\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n      type: 'move', actor, path: [{ column: 1, row: 2 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, () => 0.5);\n    const event = moved.events.find((candidate) => candidate.type === 'movement_completed');\n    expect(event).toMatchObject({ spent: 10 });\n    expect(moved.state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === actor)?.turn.movement.remaining).toBe(20);\n  });\n\n  it('destroyed_object_still_blocks: damage destroys an HP object and immediately opens its cell', () => {\n    const wall = object('breakable-wall', [{ column: 1, row: 2 }], { movement: true, hitPoints: 5 });\n    const state = started([wall]);\n    const destroyed = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'world_operation', actor: state.activeCombatant, cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'damage_object', objectId: wall.id, delivery: { kind: 'area_effect' },\n        damage: {\n          terms: [{ type: force, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 5 } }],\n          critical: false, responses: [],\n        },\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(destroyed.state.worldObjects).toEqual([]);\n    expect(destroyed.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([\n      'world_object_damaged', 'world_object_removed',\n    ]);\n    const actor = destroyed.state.activeCombatant;\n    if (actor === null) throw new Error('Destruction fixture has no active actor.');\n    expect(findPath(encounterMovementWorld(destroyed.state), {\n      actorId: actor, start: { column: 0, row: 2 }, goal: { column: 1, row: 2 }, maximumCost: feet(5),\n    })).toMatchObject({ kind: 'found', cost: 5 });\n  });\n\n  it('a light-level mutation flips the visibility query', () => {\n    const base = started();\n    const actor = base.activeCombatant;\n    const target = base.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.kind === 'monster')?.profile.id;\n    if (actor === null || target === undefined) throw new Error('Visibility fixture is incomplete.');\n    expect(canCombatantSee(base, actor, target)).toBe(true);\n    const dark = reduceEncounter(base, {\n      type: 'world_operation', actor, cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'set_light_level', level: 'darkness',\n        region: { id: 'homebrew-eclipse', cells: [{ column: 6, row: 2 }] },\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(canCombatantSee(dark, actor, target)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('replaying object commands reconstructs the state byte-exactly', () => {\n    const initial = started();\n    const actor = initial.activeCombatant;\n    if (actor === null) throw new Error('Replay fixture has no active actor.');\n    const created = object('replay-wall', [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], { movement: true, sight: true });\n    const command: EncounterCommand = {\n      type: 'world_operation', actor, cost: 'none', operation: { kind: 'create_object', object: created },\n    };\n    const first = reduceEncounter(initial, command, () => 0.5);\n    const replayed = reduceEncounter(structuredClone(initial), structuredClone(command), () => 0.5);\n    expect(canonicalJson(replayed.state)).toBe(canonicalJson(first.state));\n    expect(canonicalJson(replayed.events)).toBe(canonicalJson(first.events));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/encounter.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1850","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy requires exactly one identity-matched board token for every rules profile"},{"id":"1851","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy rejects an otherwise valid action from a non-active PC"},{"id":"1852","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy advances initiative when an active combatant was killed by a reaction during its turn"},{"id":"1853","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy splits movement around other choices through the shared movement kernel"},{"id":"1854","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy tracks action, Bonus Action, Reaction, and Dash movement independently"},{"id":"1855","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy temp_hp_stacks_additively keeps the higher grant and replaces it only with a larger grant"},{"id":"1856","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy tracks a multiattack sequence across split movement and closes it at the profile limit"},{"id":"1857","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy resolves saving throws and half damage through the shared resolution kernel"},{"id":"1858","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy Incapacitated condition removes action, Bonus Action, and Reaction availability"},{"id":"1859","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy Disengage suppresses the shared-kernel Opportunity Attack window"},{"id":"1860","name":"encounter reducer authority and action economy Dodge imposes Disadvantage until the target next starts a turn"},{"id":"1861","name":"0-HP, healing, and massive-damage matrix ordinary monster at exactly 0"},{"id":"1862","name":"0-HP, healing, and massive-damage matrix ordinary monster overkilled"},{"id":"1863","name":"0-HP, healing, and massive-damage matrix named monster opted into death saves at exactly 0"},{"id":"1864","name":"0-HP, healing, and massive-damage matrix named monster opted into death saves takes massive damage"},{"id":"1865","name":"0-HP, matrix healing a dying death-save user restores living state without implementing death-save rolls"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, effectStackingIdentity } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst force = damageType('Force');\n\nfunction damage(amount: number) {\n  return {\n    terms: [{ type: force, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount } }],\n    critical: false,\n    responses: [],\n  } as const;\n}\n\nfunction attack(\n  actor: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  amount = 1,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: damage(amount),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction start(\n  profiles: readonly CombatantProfile[],\n  columns = profiles.map((_, index) => index * 2),\n): EncounterState {\n  const setup = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 20, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: profiles,\n    tokens: profiles.map((profile, index) =>\n      placedToken(profile, columns[index] ?? index * 2, 1),\n    ),\n  });\n  return reduceEncounter(setup, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\nfunction stateOf(state: EncounterState, profile: CombatantProfile) {\n  const found = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === profile.id);\n  if (found === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing fixture combatant ${profile.id}.`);\n  return found;\n}\n\ndescribe('encounter reducer authority and action economy', () => {\n  it('requires exactly one identity-matched board token for every rules profile', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('identity');\n    expect(() =>\n      createEncounter({\n        bounds: { columns: 2, rows: 2 },\n        combatants: [pc],\n        tokens: [],\n      }),\n    ).toThrow('exactly one matching board token');\n  });\n\n  it('rejects an otherwise valid action from a non-active PC', () => {\n    const active = playerProfile('active', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const inactive = playerProfile('inactive', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('monster', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    const state = start([active, inactive, monster]);\n\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(active.id);\n    expect(() =>\n      reduceEncounter(\n        state,\n        {\n          type: 'apply_effect',\n          actor: inactive.id,\n          cost: 'none',\n          effect: {\n            targets: [monster.id],\n            duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n            concentration: false,\n            stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('inactive-pc-control'),\n            stacking: 'coexist',\n            repeatedSave: null,\n            payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Blinded' },\n          },\n        },\n        () => 0.5,\n      ),\n    ).toThrow('is not the active combatant');\n    expect(state.revision).toBe(1);\n  });\n\n  it('advances initiative when an active combatant was killed by a reaction during its turn', () => {\n    const active = monsterProfile('reaction-casualty', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const next = playerProfile('reaction-survivor', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    const started = start([active, next]);\n    const killed: EncounterState = {\n      ...started,\n      combatants: started.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.profile.id === active.id\n          ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 0, life: 'dead', deathSaves: null }\n          : combatant),\n    };\n\n    const advanced = reduceEncounter(killed, { type: 'end_turn', actor: active.id }, () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(advanced.state.activeCombatant).toBe(next.id);\n    expect(advanced.events.map((event) => event.type)).toContain('turn_ended');\n    expect(advanced.events.map((event) => event.type)).toContain('turn_started');\n  });\n\n  it('splits movement around other choices through the shared movement kernel', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('mover', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('far', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    let state = start([pc, monster], [0, 10]);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 3, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).turn.movement).toEqual({ speed: 30, spent: 15, remaining: 15 });\n    expect(state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === pc.id)?.position).toEqual({\n      column: 3,\n      row: 1,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('tracks action, Bonus Action, Reaction, and Dash movement independently', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('resources', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('other', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    let state = start([pc, monster], [0, 10]);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'spend_bonus_action', actor: pc.id, purpose: 'fixture feature' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'spend_reaction', actor: pc.id, purpose: 'fixture reaction' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'dash', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).turn).toMatchObject({\n      action: { kind: 'spent' },\n      bonusActionAvailable: false,\n      reactionAvailable: false,\n      movement: { speed: 60, spent: 0, remaining: 60 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('temp_hp_stacks_additively keeps the higher grant and replaces it only with a larger grant', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('temporary-hit-points', { initiativeBonus: 10, hitPoints: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('temporary-hit-points-attacker', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    let state = start([pc, monster]);\n    const grant = (amount: number) => {\n      const reduced = reduceEncounter(state, {\n        type: 'grant_temporary_hit_points',\n        actor: pc.id,\n        target: pc.id,\n        amount,\n        cost: 'none',\n      }, () => 0.5);\n      state = reduced.state;\n      return reduced;\n    };\n\n    grant(10);\n    const smaller = grant(4);\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).temporaryHitPoints).toBe(10);\n    expect(smaller.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'temporary_hit_points_changed',\n      before: 10,\n      after: 10,\n    }));\n\n    const larger = grant(12);\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).temporaryHitPoints).toBe(12);\n    expect(larger.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'temporary_hit_points_changed',\n      before: 10,\n      after: 12,\n    }));\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(monster, pc, 13), () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc)).toMatchObject({ hitPoints: 19, temporaryHitPoints: 0 });\n  });\n\n  it('tracks a multiattack sequence across split movement and closes it at the profile limit', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('multiattacker', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      attacksPerAction: 2,\n    });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('multiattack-target', {\n      initiativeBonus: -10,\n      hitPoints: 20,\n    });\n    let state = start([pc, monster], [0, 4]);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(pc, monster, 1), () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).turn.action).toEqual({\n      kind: 'attack_sequence',\n      attacksRemaining: 1,\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(pc, monster, 1), () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).turn.action).toEqual({ kind: 'spent' });\n    expect(stateOf(state, monster).hitPoints).toBe(18);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(state, attack(pc, monster, 1), () => 0.5)).toThrow(\n      'has no attack available',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('resolves saving throws and half damage through the shared resolution kernel', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('save-source', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('save-target', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    const state = start([pc, monster]);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      {\n        type: 'force_save',\n        actor: pc.id,\n        target: monster.id,\n        ability: 'dexterity',\n        dc: 10,\n        rollMode: 'normal',\n        damage: damage(5),\n        onSuccess: 'half',\n        cost: 'action',\n      },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n\n    expect(result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')).toMatchObject({\n      target: monster.id,\n      save: { outcome: 'success', total: 11 },\n    });\n    expect(stateOf(result.state, monster).hitPoints).toBe(8);\n  });\n\n  it('Incapacitated condition removes action, Bonus Action, and Reaction availability', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('incapacitated', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('other', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    const state = start([pc, monster]);\n    const applied = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      {\n        type: 'apply_effect',\n        actor: pc.id,\n        cost: 'none',\n        effect: {\n          targets: [pc.id],\n          duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n          concentration: false,\n          stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('condition:incapacitated'),\n          stacking: 'replace_any_source',\n          repeatedSave: null,\n          payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Incapacitated' },\n        },\n      },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(applied, pc).turn).toMatchObject({\n      action: { kind: 'spent' },\n      bonusActionAvailable: false,\n      reactionAvailable: false,\n    });\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(applied, { type: 'dash', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5)).toThrow(\n      'is Incapacitated',\n    );\n    expect(() =>\n      reduceEncounter(\n        applied,\n        { type: 'spend_bonus_action', actor: pc.id, purpose: 'forbidden' },\n        () => 0.5,\n      ),\n    ).toThrow('is Incapacitated');\n    expect(() =>\n      reduceEncounter(\n        applied,\n        { type: 'spend_reaction', actor: pc.id, purpose: 'forbidden' },\n        () => 0.5,\n      ),\n    ).toThrow('cannot react');\n  });\n\n  it('Disengage suppresses the shared-kernel Opportunity Attack window', () => {\n    const monster = monsterProfile('reactor', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const pc = playerProfile('walker', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = start([monster, pc], [1, 2]);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: monster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    const offered = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 3, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    expect(offered.state.pendingDecisions).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'reaction_offer', reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack', combatant: monster.id,\n    }));\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'disengage', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 3, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === pc.id)?.position.column).toBe(3);\n  });\n\n  it('Dodge imposes Disadvantage until the target next starts a turn', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('dodger', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('attacker', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = start([pc, monster], [0, 1]);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'dodge', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, attack(monster, pc), () => 0.5);\n    const event = result.events.find((candidate) => candidate.type === 'attack_resolved');\n\n    expect(event?.type).toBe('attack_resolved');\n    if (event?.type !== 'attack_resolved') throw new Error('Missing attack event.');\n    expect(event.attack.roll.mode).toBe('disadvantage');\n    expect(event.attack.roll.faces).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('0-HP, healing, and massive-damage matrix', () => {\n  it.each([\n    ['ordinary monster at exactly 0', monsterProfile('ordinary-exact'), 10, 'dead', false],\n    ['ordinary monster overkilled', monsterProfile('ordinary-over'), 20, 'dead', false],\n    [\n      'named monster opted into death saves at exactly 0',\n      monsterProfile('named-exact', { usesDeathSaves: true }),\n      10,\n      'dying',\n      false,\n    ],\n    [\n      'named monster opted into death saves takes massive damage',\n      monsterProfile('named-massive', { usesDeathSaves: true }),\n      20,\n      'dead',\n      true,\n    ],\n    ['PC at exactly 0', playerProfile('pc-exact', { initiativeBonus: -10 }), 10, 'dying', false],\n    ['PC takes massive damage', playerProfile('pc-massive', { initiativeBonus: -10 }), 20, 'dead', true],\n  ] as const)('%s', (_label, target, amount, expectedLife, massiveDamage) => {\n    const attacker = playerProfile(`attacker-${target.id}`, { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const state = start([attacker, target]);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, attack(attacker, target, amount), () => 0.5);\n    const event = result.events.find((candidate) => candidate.type === 'damage_applied');\n\n    expect(stateOf(result.state, target)).toMatchObject({ hitPoints: 0, life: expectedLife });\n    expect(event?.type).toBe('damage_applied');\n    if (event?.type !== 'damage_applied') throw new Error('Missing damage event.');\n    expect(event.massiveDamage).toBe(massiveDamage);\n  });\n\n  it('healing a dying death-save user restores living state without implementing death-save rolls', () => {\n    const healer = playerProfile('healer', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = playerProfile('patient', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    let state = start([healer, target]);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(healer, target, 10), () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'heal', actor: healer.id, target: target.id, amount: 3, cost: 'none' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(state, target)).toMatchObject({ hitPoints: 3, life: 'living' });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/persistent-areas.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1868","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks area_triggers_every_step: crossing a three-square zone resolves once per entry, not once per step"},{"id":"1869","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks standing_inside_triggers_start_once: start-of-turn hooks resolve exactly once in each round"},{"id":"1870","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks emanation_uses_stale_origin: an anchored emanation follows every owner step and catches an adjacent creature"},{"id":"1871","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks emanation_origin_occupant_is_affected: an eligible creature on the emanation origin takes the effect"},{"id":"1872","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks emanation_owner_membership_follows_filter: an ally aura includes its anchor while a hostile aura excludes it"},{"id":"1873","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks save_ends_never_ends: a later successful save removes an area-applied condition"},{"id":"1874","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks membership_order_nondeterministic: overlapping areas always resolve by creation sequence"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { canonicalJson } from '../../../src/commands/canonical-json';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  effectiveSkillModifier,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport type { PersistentAreaInput } from '../../../src/combat/persistent-areas';\nimport { feetPoint } from '../../../src/combat/templates';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, feet, persistentAreaId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst force = damageType('Force');\n\nfunction fixedDamage(amount: number) {\n  return {\n    terms: [{ type: force, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount } }],\n    critical: false,\n    responses: [],\n  } as const;\n}\n\nfunction started(columns: readonly number[] = [0, 4]): EncounterState {\n  const owner = playerProfile('area-owner', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const target = monsterProfile('area-target', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const state = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [owner, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(owner, columns[0] ?? 0, 1), placedToken(target, columns[1] ?? 4, 1)],\n  });\n  return reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\nfunction baseArea(state: EncounterState, overrides: Partial<PersistentAreaInput> = {}): PersistentAreaInput {\n  const owner = state.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n  return {\n    owner,\n    origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(15, 5) },\n    shape: { kind: 'sphere', radius: feet(2) },\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', remaining: 10 },\n    targetFilter: { kind: 'all' },\n    difficultTerrain: false,\n    movable: null,\n    hooks: [],\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction createArea(state: EncounterState, area: PersistentAreaInput, rng: () => number = () => 0.5) {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'create_persistent_area', actor: area.owner, area, cost: 'none',\n  }, rng);\n}\n\nfunction hitPoints(state: EncounterState, id: string): number {\n  const subject = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === id);\n  if (subject === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing combatant ${id}.`);\n  return subject.hitPoints;\n}\n\ndescribe('persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks', () => {\n  it('area_triggers_every_step: crossing a three-square zone resolves once per entry, not once per step', () => {\n    let state = started([8, 0]);\n    const owner = state.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n    const target = state.combatants[1]!.profile.id;\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(15, 5) },\n      shape: { kind: 'sphere', radius: feet(7) },\n      hooks: [{ hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger', effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'damage', damage: fixedDamage(3) } } }],\n    })).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: target,\n      path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 3, row: 1 }, { column: 4, row: 1 }, { column: 5, row: 1 }],\n      cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(moved.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'persistent_area_triggered')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(hitPoints(moved.state, target)).toBe(27);\n  });\n\n  it('standing_inside_triggers_start_once: start-of-turn hooks resolve exactly once in each round', () => {\n    let state = started([0, 2]);\n    const owner = state.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n    const target = state.combatants[1]!.profile.id;\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(15, 5) },\n      shape: { kind: 'sphere', radius: feet(3) },\n      hooks: [{ hook: 'on_start_of_turn_inside', frequency: 'once_per_turn', effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'damage', damage: fixedDamage(2) } } }],\n    })).state;\n\n    const targetTurn = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(targetTurn.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'persistent_area_triggered')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(hitPoints(targetTurn.state, target)).toBe(28);\n    const nextOwner = reduceEncounter(targetTurn.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: target }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const nextTarget = reduceEncounter(nextOwner, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(nextTarget.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'persistent_area_triggered')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(hitPoints(nextTarget.state, target)).toBe(26);\n  });\n\n  it('emanation_uses_stale_origin: an anchored emanation follows every owner step and catches an adjacent creature', () => {\n    const owner = playerProfile('moving-aura-owner', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const beneficiary = playerProfile('moving-aura-beneficiary', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    let state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 10, rows: 3 }, combatants: [owner, beneficiary],\n      tokens: [placedToken(owner, 0, 1), placedToken(beneficiary, 4, 1)],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      owner: owner.id,\n      origin: { kind: 'anchored', combatant: owner.id },\n      shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(5) },\n      targetFilter: { kind: 'allies' },\n      hooks: [{\n        hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger',\n        effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'effect', payload: { kind: 'skill_modifier', skill: 'stealth', amount: 4 }, lifetime: { kind: 'while_inside' } } },\n      }],\n    })).state;\n    expect(effectiveSkillModifier(state, beneficiary.id, 'stealth')).toBe(0);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: owner.id,\n      path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 3, row: 1 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.origin).toEqual({ kind: 'anchored', combatant: owner.id });\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.members).toContain(beneficiary.id);\n    expect(effectiveSkillModifier(state, beneficiary.id, 'stealth')).toBe(4);\n  });\n\n  it('emanation_origin_occupant_is_affected: an eligible creature on the emanation origin takes the effect', () => {\n    const owner = playerProfile('origin-aura-owner', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 30 });\n    const hostile = monsterProfile('origin-aura-hostile', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n    let state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 3 }, combatants: [owner, hostile],\n      tokens: [placedToken(owner, 3, 1), placedToken(hostile, 0, 1)],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      owner: owner.id,\n      origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(0, 5) },\n      shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(10) },\n      targetFilter: { kind: 'enemies' },\n      hooks: [{\n        hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger',\n        effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'damage', damage: fixedDamage(5) } },\n      }],\n    })).state;\n\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.members).toContain(hostile.id);\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.members).not.toContain(owner.id);\n    expect(hitPoints(state, hostile.id)).toBe(25);\n    expect(hitPoints(state, owner.id)).toBe(30);\n  });\n\n  it('emanation_owner_membership_follows_filter: an ally aura includes its anchor while a hostile aura excludes it', () => {\n    const owner = playerProfile('filtered-aura-owner', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const hostile = monsterProfile('filtered-aura-hostile', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const initial = (): EncounterState => reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 3 }, combatants: [owner, hostile],\n      tokens: [placedToken(owner, 0, 1), placedToken(hostile, 5, 1)],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const conditionHook = {\n      hook: 'on_enter',\n      frequency: 'every_trigger',\n      effect: {\n        kind: 'automatic',\n        payload: {\n          kind: 'effect',\n          payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Frightened' },\n          lifetime: { kind: 'area_duration' },\n        },\n      },\n    } as const;\n\n    const alliedInitial = initial();\n    const allied = createArea(alliedInitial, baseArea(alliedInitial, {\n      owner: owner.id,\n      origin: { kind: 'anchored', combatant: owner.id },\n      shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(10) },\n      targetFilter: { kind: 'allies' },\n      hooks: [conditionHook],\n    })).state;\n    expect(allied.persistentAreas[0]?.members).toContain(owner.id);\n    expect(combatantConditions(allied, owner.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).toContain('Frightened');\n\n    const hostileInitial = initial();\n    const hostileOnly = createArea(hostileInitial, baseArea(hostileInitial, {\n      owner: owner.id,\n      origin: { kind: 'anchored', combatant: owner.id },\n      shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(10) },\n      targetFilter: { kind: 'enemies' },\n      hooks: [conditionHook],\n    })).state;\n    expect(hostileOnly.persistentAreas[0]?.members).not.toContain(owner.id);\n    expect(combatantConditions(hostileOnly, owner.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).not.toContain('Frightened');\n  });\n\n  it('save_ends_never_ends: a later successful save removes an area-applied condition', () => {\n    let state = started([8, 0]);\n    const owner = state.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n    const target = state.combatants[1]!.profile.id;\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      hooks: [{\n        hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger',\n        effect: {\n          kind: 'save_gated', ability: 'wisdom', dc: 10, rollMode: 'normal', onSuccess: 'none',\n          payload: { kind: 'effect', payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Frightened' }, lifetime: { kind: 'save_ends', boundary: 'end' } },\n        },\n      }],\n    })).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: target, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target).map((condition) => condition.name)).toContain('Frightened');\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: target }, () => 0.999).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target).map((condition) => condition.name)).not.toContain('Frightened');\n  });\n\n  it('membership_order_nondeterministic: overlapping areas always resolve by creation sequence', () => {\n    const initial = started([8, 0]);\n    const owner = initial.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n    const target = initial.combatants[1]!.profile.id;\n    const commands: EncounterCommand[] = [1, 2].map((amount) => ({\n      type: 'create_persistent_area', actor: owner, cost: 'none',\n      area: baseArea(initial, {\n        hooks: [{ hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger', effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'damage', damage: fixedDamage(amount) } } }],\n      }),\n    }));\n    const run = (): EncounterState => {\n      let state = initial;\n      for (const command of commands) state = reduceEncounter(state, command, () => 0.5).state;\n      state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5).state;\n      return reduceEncounter(state, {\n        type: 'move', actor: target, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n      }, () => 0.5).state;\n    };\n    const first = run();\n    const second = run();\n    expect(first.eventLog.filter((event) => event.type === 'persistent_area_triggered').map((event) => event.areaId))\n      .toEqual([persistentAreaId('area:1'), persistentAreaId('area:2')]);\n    expect(canonicalJson(second)).toBe(canonicalJson(first));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/bridge/turn-program-library.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1875","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library derives the prompt documentation and function list from the versioned registry"},{"id":"1876","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library 'focusFire' expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1877","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library 'retreatWhenBelow' expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1878","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library 'flankWith' expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1879","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library 'holdChokepoint' expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1880","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library riderOnCrit expands to the same attached fixed follow-up as its hand-written long form"},{"id":"1881","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library sandboxes helper arguments and rejects fabricated selectors and ambient globals"},{"id":"1882","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library helper_bypasses_validation rejects an invalid cell before it can become a DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1883","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library fraction_hp_not_scaled converts the 0..1 fraction to the contract percentage exactly once"},{"id":"1884","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library requires a fixed action rather than a searchable program as the rider follow-up"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { dmVisibleEncounter, projectDmView, type DmVisibleEncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { combatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { decodeDecisionProgramStructure } from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/round-plan-contract';\nimport {\n  JS_TURN_PROGRAM_GRAMMAR,\n  JsTurnProgramRuntimeError,\n  JsTurnProgramSyntaxError,\n  interpretJsTurnProgram,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/js-turn-program';\nimport {\n  TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_DOC,\n  TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_FUNCTIONS,\n  TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_VERSION,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/turn-program-library';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction projection(): DmVisibleEncounterState {\n  const monsterA = monsterProfile('library-a', { hitPoints: 40 });\n  const monsterB = monsterProfile('library-b', { hitPoints: 30 });\n  const playerA = playerProfile('library-player-a');\n  const playerB = playerProfile('library-player-b');\n  const base = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 4 },\n    combatants: [monsterA, monsterB, playerB, playerA],\n    tokens: [\n      placedToken(monsterA, 0),\n      placedToken(monsterB, 1),\n      placedToken(playerB, 3),\n      placedToken(playerA, 3, 1),\n    ],\n  });\n  const state: EncounterState = { ...base, activeCombatant: monsterA.id };\n  return dmVisibleEncounter(projectDmView(state));\n}\n\nconst ACTOR = combatantId('combatant:library-a');\nconst ALLY = combatantId('combatant:library-b');\nconst TARGET = combatantId('combatant:library-player-a');\nconst target = { kind: 'combatant' as const, combatantId: TARGET };\n\ndescribe('versioned JS turn-program pattern library', () => {\n  it('derives the prompt documentation and function list from the versioned registry', () => {\n    expect(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_VERSION).toBe('turn-program-library:v1');\n    expect(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_FUNCTIONS).toEqual([\n      'focusFire',\n      'retreatWhenBelow',\n      'flankWith',\n      'holdChokepoint',\n      'riderOnCrit',\n    ]);\n    expect(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_DOC).toContain('focusFire(targetSelector)');\n    expect(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_DOC).toContain('riderOnCrit(followUpAction)');\n    expect(JS_TURN_PROGRAM_GRAMMAR.endsWith(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_DOC)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    {\n      helper: 'focusFire',\n      source: 'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(focusFire(target));',\n      longForm: {\n        kind: 'priority',\n        choices: [\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target } },\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward', target } },\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n        ],\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      helper: 'retreatWhenBelow',\n      source: 'emit(retreatWhenBelow(0.25, {column: 0, row: 2}));',\n      longForm: {\n        kind: 'if',\n        predicate: { kind: 'hp_percent_below', combatantId: ACTOR, percent: 25 },\n        then: {\n          kind: 'priority',\n          choices: [\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'disengage' } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'retreat_toward', destination: { column: 0, row: 2 } } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'dash' } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          ],\n        },\n        else: {\n          kind: 'priority',\n          choices: [\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target: { kind: 'nearest_enemy' } } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward', target: { kind: 'nearest_enemy' } } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          ],\n        },\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      helper: 'flankWith',\n      source: 'const ally = lowestHp(alliesWithin(30)); const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(flankWith(ally, target));',\n      longForm: {\n        kind: 'if',\n        predicate: { kind: 'distance_at_most', left: ALLY, right: TARGET, feet: 5 },\n        then: {\n          kind: 'priority',\n          choices: [\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward', target } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          ],\n        },\n        else: {\n          kind: 'priority',\n          choices: [\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward', target } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          ],\n        },\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      helper: 'holdChokepoint',\n      source: 'emit(holdChokepoint({column: 2, row: 2}));',\n      longForm: {\n        kind: 'priority',\n        choices: [\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'retreat_toward', destination: { column: 2, row: 2 } } },\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'dodge' } },\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n        ],\n      },\n    },\n  ])('$helper expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram', ({ source, longForm }) => {\n    const expanded = interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR).emittedDecisionProgram;\n    expect(expanded).toEqual(longForm);\n    expect(decodeDecisionProgramStructure(expanded)).toEqual(longForm);\n  });\n\n  it('riderOnCrit expands to the same attached fixed follow-up as its hand-written long form', () => {\n    const source = 'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(attack(target, riderOnCrit(forceSave(target))));';\n    const expanded = interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR).emittedDecisionProgram;\n    const longForm = {\n      kind: 'action' as const,\n      action: { kind: 'attack' as const, target },\n      riders: [{\n        kind: 'on_critical_hit' as const,\n        followUpAction: { kind: 'force_save' as const, target },\n      }],\n    };\n\n    expect(expanded).toEqual(longForm);\n    expect(decodeDecisionProgramStructure(expanded)).toEqual(longForm);\n  });\n\n  it('sandboxes helper arguments and rejects fabricated selectors and ambient globals', () => {\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'emit(focusFire({kind: \"combatant\", combatantId: \"combatant:library-player-a\"}));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    )).toThrowError(new JsTurnProgramRuntimeError('focusFire requires a combatant reference.'));\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'emit(focusFire(globalThis));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    )).toThrowError(JsTurnProgramSyntaxError);\n  });\n\n  it('helper_bypasses_validation rejects an invalid cell before it can become a DecisionProgram', () => {\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'emit(retreatWhenBelow(0.25, {column: -1, row: 0}));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    )).toThrow('cell selector coordinates must be non-negative safe integers');\n  });\n\n  it('fraction_hp_not_scaled converts the 0..1 fraction to the contract percentage exactly once', () => {\n    const expanded = interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'emit(retreatWhenBelow(0.375, {column: 0, row: 0}));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    ).emittedDecisionProgram;\n    expect(expanded).toMatchObject({\n      predicate: { kind: 'hp_percent_below', combatantId: ACTOR, percent: 37.5 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('requires a fixed action rather than a searchable program as the rider follow-up', () => {\n    const source = 'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(attack(target, riderOnCrit(focusFire(target))));';\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR)).toThrow(\n      'riderOnCrit followUpAction must be an action.',\n    );\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/flammable-surfaces.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1885","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells bundled Web is RAW-flammable while Grease is a default-off named optional rule"},{"id":"1886","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells ignition_ignores_exposure: fire ignites the exact exposed cube but not an unexposed neighbor"},{"id":"1887","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells cold_ignites: non-fire damage in the same cell does not ignite while Fire damage does"},{"id":"1888","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells same Fire event ignites flammable overlapping areas and leaves a nonflammable area unchanged"},{"id":"1889","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells optional-rule flag off vs on: 2024 Grease stays nonflammable unless flammable_grease is enabled"},{"id":"1890","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells burning Web deals exactly 2d4 Fire damage at start of turn"},{"id":"1891","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells a banished combatant in an ignited cell takes no burning damage at start of turn"},{"id":"1892","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells burn_lingers: an ignited cube burns away after exactly one full round"},{"id":"1893","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells restraint_survives_burn: Web restraint ends when its burned cube burns away"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { PersistentAreaInput, PersistentAreaMaterial } from '../../../src/combat/persistent-areas';\nimport {\n  GREASE_MATERIAL,\n  WEB_MATERIAL,\n  persistentAreaContains,\n} from '../../../src/combat/persistent-areas';\nimport { spellDefinition } from '../../../src/combat/spells/definitions';\nimport { feetPoint } from '../../../src/combat/templates';\nimport {\n  damageType,\n  dieSides,\n  effectStackingIdentity,\n  feet,\n  type DamageType,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst NONFLAMMABLE_MATERIAL: PersistentAreaMaterial = {\n  id: 'stone-dust',\n  flammability: { kind: 'nonflammable' },\n};\n\nfunction faceOne(): number {\n  return 0;\n}\n\nfunction setup(optionalRules: readonly 'flammable_grease'[] = []) {\n  const owner = playerProfile('surface-owner', { initiativeBonus: 30, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const fireDealer = playerProfile('surface-fire-dealer', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const target = monsterProfile('surface-target', { initiativeBonus: 10, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant', optionalRules },\n    bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [owner, fireDealer, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(owner, 0, 1), placedToken(fireDealer, 1, 1), placedToken(target, 3, 1)],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, faceOne).state;\n  return { state, owner, fireDealer, target };\n}\n\nfunction webHooks(): PersistentAreaInput['hooks'] {\n  return (['on_enter', 'on_start_of_turn_inside'] as const).map((hook) => ({\n    hook,\n    frequency: 'once_per_turn' as const,\n
