effect: {\n      kind: 'save_gated' as const,\n      ability: 'dexterity' as const,\n      dc: 20,\n      rollMode: 'normal' as const,\n      onSuccess: 'none' as const,\n      payload: {\n        kind: 'effect' as const,\n        payload: { kind: 'condition' as const, condition: 'Restrained' as const },\n        lifetime: { kind: 'while_inside' as const },\n      },\n    },\n  }));\n}\n\nfunction area(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  material: PersistentAreaMaterial,\n  hooks: PersistentAreaInput['hooks'] = [],\n): PersistentAreaInput {\n  const owner = state.combatants[0]?.profile.id;\n  const target = state.combatants[2]?.profile.id;\n  if (owner === undefined || target === undefined) throw new Error('Surface fixture is incomplete.');\n  return {\n    owner,\n    origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(15, 5) },\n    shape: { kind: 'sphere', radius: feet(20) },\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', remaining: 10 },\n    targetFilter: { kind: 'selected', combatants: [target] },\n    difficultTerrain: true,\n    material,\n    hooks,\n    movable: null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction createArea(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  input: PersistentAreaInput,\n): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'create_persistent_area', actor: input.owner, area: input, cost: 'none',\n  }, faceOne).state;\n}\n\nfunction advanceToFireDealer(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  owner: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner.id }, faceOne).state;\n}\n\nfunction dealDamage(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n  target: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>,\n  type: DamageType,\n): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'force_save', actor: actor.id, target: target.id,\n    ability: 'dexterity', dc: 20, rollMode: 'normal', onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 1 } }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  }, faceOne).state;\n}\n\nfunction hitPoints(state: EncounterState, id: string): number {\n  const subject = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === id);\n  if (subject === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing combatant ${id}.`);\n  return subject.hitPoints;\n}\n\ndescribe('D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells', () => {\n  it('bundled Web is RAW-flammable while Grease is a default-off named optional rule', () => {\n    const web = spellDefinition('web');\n    const grease = spellDefinition('grease');\n    expect(web?.operation).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'persistent_area', material: { id: 'webs', flammability: { kind: 'flammable' } },\n    });\n    expect(grease?.operation).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'persistent_area', material: {\n        id: 'grease', flammability: { kind: 'optional_rule', rule: 'flammable_grease' },\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('ignition_ignores_exposure: fire ignites the exact exposed cube but not an unexposed neighbor', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    const web = state.persistentAreas[0];\n    if (web === undefined) throw new Error('Web area was not created.');\n    const exposed = state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === subject.target.id)?.position;\n    if (exposed === undefined) throw new Error('Target token was not placed.');\n    const neighbor = { column: exposed.column + 1, row: exposed.row };\n    expect(persistentAreaContains(web, neighbor, null, state)).toBe(true);\n    expect(web.burningCells.map((entry) => entry.cell)).toEqual([exposed]);\n    expect(web.burningCells.some((entry) =>\n      entry.cell.column === neighbor.column && entry.cell.row === neighbor.row)).toBe(false);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells.map((entry) => entry.cell)).toEqual([exposed]);\n  });\n\n  it('cold_ignites: non-fire damage in the same cell does not ignite while Fire damage does', () => {\n    const run = (type: 'Cold' | 'Fire'): EncounterState => {\n      const subject = setup();\n      let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n      state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n      return dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType(type));\n    };\n    expect(run('Cold').persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(run('Fire').persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toHaveLength(1);\n  });\n\n  it('same Fire event ignites flammable overlapping areas and leaves a nonflammable area unchanged', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = createArea(state, area(state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = createArea(state, area(state, NONFLAMMABLE_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    expect(state.persistentAreas.map((candidate) => candidate.burningCells.length)).toEqual([1, 1, 0]);\n  });\n\n  it('optional-rule flag off vs on: 2024 Grease stays nonflammable unless flammable_grease is enabled', () => {\n    const run = (enabled: boolean): EncounterState => {\n      const subject = setup(enabled ? ['flammable_grease'] : []);\n      let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, GREASE_MATERIAL));\n      state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n      return dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    };\n    expect(run(false).persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(run(true).persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toHaveLength(1);\n  });\n\n  it('burning Web deals exactly 2d4 Fire damage at start of turn', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    expect(hitPoints(state, subject.target.id)).toBe(29);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(hitPoints(state, subject.target.id)).toBe(27);\n  });\n\n  it('a banished combatant in an ignited cell takes no burning damage at start of turn', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'apply_effect',\n      actor: subject.fireDealer.id,\n      cost: 'none',\n      effect: {\n        targets: [subject.target.id],\n        duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n        concentration: false,\n        stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('test:burning-cell-banishment'),\n        stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n        repeatedSave: null,\n        payload: {\n          kind: 'temporary_banishment',\n          returnDamage: {\n            terms: [{\n              type: damageType('Force'),\n              dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 0 },\n            }],\n            critical: false,\n            responses: [],\n          },\n          returnPlacement: 'previous_or_nearest_unoccupied',\n        },\n      },\n    }, faceOne).state;\n    const banishedHitPoints = hitPoints(state, subject.target.id);\n    expect(state.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === subject.target.id)).toBe(false);\n\n    expect(() => {\n      state = reduceEncounter(\n        state,\n        { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id },\n        faceOne,\n      ).state;\n    }).not.toThrow();\n    expect(hitPoints(state, subject.target.id)).toBe(banishedHitPoints);\n  });\n\n  it('burn_lingers: an ignited cube burns away after exactly one full round', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    const exposed = state.persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells[0]?.cell;\n    if (exposed === undefined) throw new Error('Web cube did not ignite.');\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id }, faceOne).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burnedAwayCells).toEqual([]);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.owner.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burnedAwayCells).toEqual([exposed]);\n  });\n\n  it('restraint_survives_burn: Web restraint ends when its burned cube burns away', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL, webHooks()));\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, subject.target.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).toContain('Restrained');\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id }, faceOne).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, subject.target.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).toContain('Restrained');\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.owner.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, subject.target.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).not.toContain('Restrained');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/tools/generate-arena-basis.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1894","name":"arena basis generator parses the explicit difficulty profile and writes deterministic canonical rooms"},{"id":"1895","name":"arena basis generator rejects unknown difficulty profiles before writing"},{"id":"1896","name":"arena basis generator accepts the brutal difficulty profile"}],"source":"import { join } from 'node:path';\nimport { tmpdir } from 'node:os';\nimport { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { canonicalJson } from '../../../src/commands/canonical-json';\nimport { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';\nimport {\n  generateArenaBasis,\n  parseBasisGenerationArgs,\n} from '../../../tools/generate-arena-basis';\nimport { mkdtempSync, readFileSync } from '../../helpers/test-filesystem';\n\ndescribe('arena basis generator', () => {\n  it('parses the explicit difficulty profile and writes deterministic canonical rooms', async () => {\n    const outPath = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'dnd-hard-basis-generator-'));\n    const config = parseBasisGenerationArgs([\n      '--difficulty', 'hard',\n      '--seed', '5117001',\n      '--rooms', '2',\n      '--out', outPath,\n    ]);\n\n    expect(config).toEqual({\n      difficulty: 'hard',\n      seed: 5_117_001,\n      rooms: 2,\n      outPath,\n    });\n    await generateArenaBasis(config);\n\n    for (const seed of [5_117_001, 5_117_002]) {\n      expect(readFileSync(join(outPath, `seed-${String(seed)}.json`), 'utf8')).toBe(\n        `${canonicalJson(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'hard' }))}\\n`,\n      );\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('rejects unknown difficulty profiles before writing', () => {\n    expect(() => parseBasisGenerationArgs([\n      '--difficulty', 'nightmare',\n      '--seed', '5117001',\n      '--rooms', '12',\n      '--out', tmpdir(),\n    ])).toThrow('--difficulty must be standard, hard, or brutal.');\n  });\n\n  it('accepts the brutal difficulty profile', () => {\n    const outPath = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'dnd-brutal-basis-generator-'));\n    expect(parseBasisGenerationArgs([\n      '--difficulty', 'brutal',\n      '--seed', '6203001',\n      '--rooms', '3',\n      '--out', outPath,\n    ])).toEqual({ difficulty: 'brutal', seed: 6_203_001, rooms: 3, outPath });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/bridge/js-turn-program.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1897","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter parses the typed grammar: const, arithmetic, comparisons, logic, arrays, objects, calls, if/else, and API-array for-of"},{"id":"1898","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden while loop with a precise source error"},{"id":"1899","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden function declaration with a precise source error"},{"id":"1900","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden this with a precise source error"},{"id":"1901","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden class declaration with a precise source error"},{"id":"1902","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden prototype access with a precise source error"},{"id":"1903","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden prototype literal with a precise source error"},{"id":"1904","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden ambient global with a precise source error"},{"id":"1905","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden import with a precise source error"},{"id":"1906","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden try with a precise source error"},{"id":"1907","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden regular expression with a precise source error"},{"id":"1908","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden Date with a precise source error"},{"id":"1909","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden Math.random with a precise source error"},{"id":"1910","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden member access with a precise source error"},{"id":"1911","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden assignment with a precise source error"},{"id":"1912","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden arrow function with a precise source error"},{"id":"1913","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects for-of over a locally constructed array rather than an API-returned array"},{"id":"1914","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects an object literal that tries to impersonate a typed API DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1915","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter forbidden_construct_executes rejects while before an executable AST exists"},{"id":"1916","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter step_budget_ignored stops a costly API-array loop at the exact configured bound"},{"id":"1917","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter enforces the wall-clock budget through an injected monotonic clock"},{"id":"1918","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter same source and projection emit an identical DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1919","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter projection_order_changes_query uses combatant id as the stable equidistant tie-break"},{"id":"1920","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter emits explicit selectable programs for granted Bonus Action attacks and Action Surge"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { dmVisibleEncounter, projectDmView, type DmVisibleEncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { combatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  JS_TURN_PROGRAM_CANONICAL_EXAMPLE,\n  JsTurnProgramBudgetError,\n  JsTurnProgramSyntaxError,\n  interpretJsTurnProgram,\n  parseJsTurnProgram,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/js-turn-program';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction projection(): DmVisibleEncounterState {\n  const monsterA = monsterProfile('js-program-a', { hitPoints: 40 });\n  const monsterB = monsterProfile('js-program-b', { hitPoints: 30 });\n  const playerA = playerProfile('js-program-player-a');\n  const playerB = playerProfile('js-program-player-b');\n  const base = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [monsterA, monsterB, playerB, playerA],\n    tokens: [\n      placedToken(monsterA, 0),\n      placedToken(monsterB, 1),\n      placedToken(playerB, 3),\n      placedToken(playerA, 3, 1),\n    ],\n  });\n  const state: EncounterState = { ...base, activeCombatant: monsterA.id };\n  return dmVisibleEncounter(projectDmView(state));\n}\n\nconst ACTOR = combatantId('combatant:js-program-a');\n\ndescribe('restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter', () => {\n  it('parses the typed grammar: const, arithmetic, comparisons, logic, arrays, objects, calls, if/else, and API-array for-of', () => {\n    const source = `\n      const radius = (2 + 4) * 5;\n      const flags = [true, false, null];\n      const note = {label: \"deterministic\", radius: radius};\n      for (const ally of alliesWithin(radius)) {\n        const allyHealthy = hpPercent(ally) >= 50 && distanceTo(ally) <= radius;\n      }\n      const target = lowestHp(enemiesWithin(radius));\n      if (target !== null && !(1 > 2)) {\n        emit(priority([attack(target), forceSave(target), move(target), retreat(1, 2), dash(), disengage(), dodge(), endTurn()]));\n      } else {\n        emit(endTurn());\n      }\n    `;\n\n    const ast = parseJsTurnProgram(source);\n    const result = interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR);\n\n    expect(ast.kind).toBe('program');\n    expect(ast.statements.map((statement) => statement.kind)).toEqual([\n      'const', 'const', 'const', 'for_of', 'const', 'if',\n    ]);\n    expect(result.emittedDecisionProgram).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'priority',\n      choices: [\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target: { combatantId: 'combatant:js-program-player-a' } } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'force_save' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'retreat_toward' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { action: 'dash' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { action: 'disengage' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { action: 'dodge' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { action: 'end_turn' } },\n      ],\n    });\n    expect(result.steps).toBeGreaterThan(30);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['while loop', 'while (true) {}', 'Forbidden construct \"while loop\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['function declaration', 'function choose() {}', 'Forbidden construct \"function declaration\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['this', 'emit(this);', 'Forbidden construct \"this\" at line 1, column 6.'],\n    ['class declaration', 'class Plan {}', 'Forbidden construct \"class declaration\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['prototype access', 'const x = prototype;', 'Forbidden prototype property \"prototype\" at line 1, column 11.'],\n    ['prototype literal', 'const x = {__proto__: 1};', 'Forbidden prototype property \"__proto__\" at line 1, column 12.'],\n    ['ambient global', 'emit(globalThis);', 'Forbidden global \"globalThis\" at line 1, column 6.'],\n    ['import', 'import x from \"x\";', 'Forbidden construct \"import\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['try', 'try {} catch (error) {}', 'Forbidden construct \"try statement\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['regular expression', 'const x = /attack/;', 'Forbidden construct \"regular expression\" at line 1, column 11.'],\n    ['Date', 'emit(Date);', 'Forbidden global \"Date\" at line 1, column 6.'],\n    ['Math.random', 'emit(Math.random());', 'Forbidden global \"Math\" at line 1, column 6.'],\n    ['member access', 'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(target.id);', 'Member access is forbidden at line 1, column 43.'],\n    ['assignment', 'const target = nearestEnemy(); target = null;', 'Assignment is forbidden at line 1, column 39.'],\n    ['arrow function', 'const f = () => 1;', 'Forbidden construct \"arrow function\" at line 1, column 14.'],\n  ])('rejects forbidden %s with a precise source error', (_name, source, message) => {\n    expect(() => parseJsTurnProgram(source)).toThrowError(new JsTurnProgramSyntaxError(message));\n  });\n\n  it('rejects for-of over a locally constructed array rather than an API-returned array', () => {\n    expect(() => parseJsTurnProgram('const xs = []; for (const x of xs) { emit(endTurn()); }')).toThrow(\n      'For-of accepts only alliesWithin(...) or enemiesWithin(...)',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('rejects an object literal that tries to impersonate a typed API DecisionProgram', () => {\n    const source = 'emit({kind: \"action\", action: {kind: \"use_action\", action: \"end_turn\"}});';\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR)).toThrow(\n      'emit requires a DecisionProgram.',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('forbidden_construct_executes rejects while before an executable AST exists', () => {\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram('while (true) { emit(endTurn()); }', projection(), ACTOR)).toThrow(\n      'Forbidden construct \"while loop\"',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('step_budget_ignored stops a costly API-array loop at the exact configured bound', () => {\n    const source = `\n      for (const enemy of enemiesWithin(100)) {\n        const hp = hpPercent(enemy);\n      }\n      emit(endTurn());\n    `;\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR, { stepBudget: 5 })).toThrowError(\n      new JsTurnProgramBudgetError('JS turn-program exceeded step budget 5.'),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('enforces the wall-clock budget through an injected monotonic clock', () => {\n    let now = 0;\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram('emit(endTurn());', projection(), ACTOR, {\n      timeBudgetMs: 2,\n      now: () => {\n        now += 2;\n        return now;\n      },\n    })).toThrowError(new JsTurnProgramBudgetError('JS turn-program exceeded time budget 2ms.'));\n  });\n\n  it('same source and projection emit an identical DecisionProgram', () => {\n    const first = interpretJsTurnProgram(JS_TURN_PROGRAM_CANONICAL_EXAMPLE, projection(), ACTOR);\n    const second = interpretJsTurnProgram(JS_TURN_PROGRAM_CANONICAL_EXAMPLE, projection(), ACTOR);\n    expect(JSON.stringify(first.emittedDecisionProgram)).toBe(JSON.stringify(second.emittedDecisionProgram));\n  });\n\n  it('projection_order_changes_query uses combatant id as the stable equidistant tie-break', () => {\n    const result = interpretJsTurnProgram('const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(attack(target));', projection(), ACTOR);\n    expect(result.emittedDecisionProgram).toMatchObject({\n      action: { target: { combatantId: 'combatant:js-program-player-a' } },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('emits explicit selectable programs for granted Bonus Action attacks and Action Surge', () => {\n    const result = interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(priority(bonusAttack(target), actionSurge(), attack(target)));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    );\n    expect(result.emittedDecisionProgram).toEqual({\n      kind: 'priority',\n      choices: [\n        {\n          kind: 'action',\n          action: {\n            kind: 'bonus_attack',\n            target: { kind: 'combatant', combatantId: 'combatant:js-program-player-a' },\n          },\n        },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'action_surge' } },\n        {\n          kind: 'action',\n          action: {\n            kind: 'attack',\n            target: { kind: 'combatant', combatantId: 'combatant:js-program-player-a' },\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/initiative-modes.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1921","name":"typed encounter initiative modes defaults new encounters to the owner-ruled shared enemy block"},{"id":"1922","name":"typed encounter initiative modes pins the complete first-round order for per_combatant"},{"id":"1923","name":"typed encounter initiative modes pins the complete first-round order for shared_enemy"},{"id":"1924","name":"typed encounter initiative modes pins the complete first-round order for side_alternating"},{"id":"1925","name":"typed encounter initiative modes shared_block_splits keeps every enemy activation in one initiative slot"},{"id":"1926","name":"typed encounter initiative modes block_order_nondeterministic keeps within-block ordering stable across replay seeds"},{"id":"1927","name":"typed encounter initiative modes allows a PC Opportunity Attack to interrupt movement inside the shared enemy block"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  AlgorithmController,\n  ControllerRegistry,\n  type StandingReactionPolicy,\n} from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport {\n  createEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n  type InitiativeMode,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, type CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nfunction sequenceRng(values: readonly number[]): () => number {\n  let index = 0;\n  return () => {\n    const value = values[index];\n    if (value === undefined) throw new Error('Initiative fixture exhausted its RNG values.');\n    index += 1;\n    return value;\n  };\n}\n\nfunction modeFixture(mode?: InitiativeMode): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly ids: Readonly<Record<'pcFast' | 'pcSlow' | 'monsterFast' | 'monsterMid' | 'monsterSlow', CombatantId>>;\n} {\n  const pcFast = playerProfile('mode-pc-fast', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n  const monsterSlow = monsterProfile('mode-monster-slow', { initiativeBonus: 1 });\n  const pcSlow = playerProfile('mode-pc-slow', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n  const monsterFast = monsterProfile('mode-monster-fast', { initiativeBonus: 3 });\n  const monsterMid = monsterProfile('mode-monster-mid', { initiativeBonus: 2 });\n  const combatants = [pcFast, monsterSlow, pcSlow, monsterFast, monsterMid];\n  return {\n    state: createEncounter({\n      ...(mode === undefined ? {} : { config: { initiativeMode: mode } }),\n      bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n      combatants,\n      tokens: combatants.map((profile, index) => placedToken(profile, index * 2)),\n    }),\n    ids: {\n      pcFast: pcFast.id,\n      pcSlow: pcSlow.id,\n      monsterFast: monsterFast.id,\n      monsterMid: monsterMid.id,\n      monsterSlow: monsterSlow.id,\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nasync function firstRoundOrder(\n  mode: InitiativeMode,\n): Promise<{ readonly order: readonly CombatantId[]; readonly state: EncounterState }> {\n  const fixture = modeFixture(mode);\n  const registry = new ControllerRegistry(fixture.state.combatants.map((subject) => ({\n    combatantId: subject.profile.id,\n    controller: new AlgorithmController(),\n  })));\n  const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n    fixture.state,\n    registry,\n    sequenceRng([0.9, 0.7, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2]),\n  );\n  const rolled = await coordinator.step();\n  if (rolled.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(rolled.reason);\n  while (\n    coordinator.state().eventLog.filter(\n      (event) => event.type === 'turn_started' && event.round === 1,\n    ).length < fixture.state.combatants.length\n  ) {\n    const result = await coordinator.step();\n    if (result.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(result.reason);\n  }\n  return {\n    order: coordinator.state().eventLog.flatMap((event) =>\n      event.type === 'turn_started' && event.round === 1 ? [event.combatant] : []),\n    state: coordinator.state(),\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('typed encounter initiative modes', () => {\n  it('defaults new encounters to the owner-ruled shared enemy block', () => {\n    expect(modeFixture().state.config).toEqual({ initiativeMode: 'shared_enemy' });\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [\n      'per_combatant',\n      ['pcFast', 'monsterSlow', 'pcSlow', 'monsterFast', 'monsterMid'],\n    ],\n    [\n      'shared_enemy',\n      ['pcFast', 'monsterFast', 'monsterMid', 'monsterSlow', 'pcSlow'],\n    ],\n    [\n      'side_alternating',\n      ['pcFast', 'pcSlow', 'monsterFast', 'monsterMid', 'monsterSlow'],\n    ],\n  ] as const)('pins the complete first-round order for %s', async (mode, names) => {\n    const fixture = modeFixture(mode);\n    const result = await firstRoundOrder(mode);\n    expect(result.order).toEqual(names.map((name) => fixture.ids[name]));\n  });\n\n  it('shared_block_splits keeps every enemy activation in one initiative slot', async () => {\n    const fixture = modeFixture('shared_enemy');\n    const result = await firstRoundOrder('shared_enemy');\n    const monsterIds = [\n      fixture.ids.monsterFast,\n      fixture.ids.monsterMid,\n      fixture.ids.monsterSlow,\n    ];\n    const monsterIndexes = monsterIds.map((id) => result.order.indexOf(id));\n    expect(monsterIndexes).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);\n    expect(new Set(\n      result.state.initiative\n        .filter((entry) => monsterIds.includes(entry.combatant))\n        .map((entry) => entry.slot),\n    ).size).toBe(1);\n    const ordered = result.state.eventLog.find((event) => event.type === 'initiative_ordered');\n    expect(ordered).toMatchObject({ slots: expect.arrayContaining([monsterIds]) });\n  });\n\n  it('block_order_nondeterministic keeps within-block ordering stable across replay seeds', async () => {\n    const orders = await Promise.all([\n      firstRoundOrder('shared_enemy'),\n      (async () => {\n        const fixture = modeFixture('shared_enemy');\n        const registry = new ControllerRegistry(fixture.state.combatants.map((subject) => ({\n          combatantId: subject.profile.id,\n          controller: new AlgorithmController(),\n        })));\n        const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n          fixture.state,\n          registry,\n          sequenceRng([0.05, 0.95, 0.15, 0.4]),\n        );\n        await coordinator.step();\n        return { state: coordinator.state() };\n      })(),\n    ]);\n    const withinBlock = (state: EncounterState): readonly CombatantId[] => {\n      const block = state.eventLog.find((event) => event.type === 'initiative_block_rolled');\n      if (block === undefined || block.type !== 'initiative_block_rolled') {\n        throw new Error('Shared encounter did not emit its block roll.');\n      }\n      return block.combatants;\n    };\n    expect(withinBlock(orders[0].state)).toEqual(withinBlock(orders[1].state));\n  });\n\n  it('allows a PC Opportunity Attack to interrupt movement inside the shared enemy block', async () => {\n    const mover = monsterProfile('block-mover', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 20 });\n    const nextMonster = monsterProfile('block-next', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const reactor = playerProfile('block-reactor', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const state = createEncounter({\n      config: { initiativeMode: 'shared_enemy' },\n      bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [mover, nextMonster, reactor],\n      tokens: [placedToken(mover, 1), placedToken(nextMonster, 5), placedToken(reactor, 0)],\n    });\n    const registry = new ControllerRegistry(state.combatants.map((subject) => ({\n      combatantId: subject.profile.id,\n      controller: new AlgorithmController(),\n    })));\n    const move: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'move' }> = {\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: mover.id,\n      path: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }],\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    };\n    const opportunityAttack: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'opportunity_attack' }> = {\n      type: 'opportunity_attack',\n      actor: reactor.id,\n      target: mover.id,\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      rollMode: 'normal',\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n      targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{\n          type: damageType('Force'),\n          dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 },\n        }],\n        critical: false,\n        responses: [],\n      },\n    };\n    const policies = new Map<CombatantId, StandingReactionPolicy>([\n      [reactor.id, { opportunityAttack: 'use' }],\n    ]);\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(state, registry, sequenceRng([0.1, 0.9, 0.5]), {\n      turnLegalActions: (current, actor) => ({\n        actions: actor === mover.id && current.combatants.find(\n          (subject) => subject.profile.id === mover.id,\n        )?.turn.movement.spent === 0\n          ? [move]\n          : [{ type: 'end_turn', actor }],\n      }),\n      reactionLegalActions: () => [opportunityAttack],\n      standingReactionPolicies: policies,\n    });\n\n    await coordinator.step();\n    const movement = await coordinator.step();\n    if (movement.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(movement.reason);\n    expect(movement.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([\n      'resource_spent',\n      'damage_applied',\n      'attack_resolved',\n      'movement_completed',\n    ]);\n    await coordinator.step();\n    expect(coordinator.state().activeCombatant).toBe(nextMonster.id);\n    const firstRoundStarts = coordinator.state().eventLog.flatMap((event) =>\n      event.type === 'turn_started' && event.round === 1 ? [event.combatant] : []);\n    expect(firstRoundStarts).toEqual([mover.id, nextMonster.id]);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/controllers.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1928","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection evaluates standing policy {\"opportunityAttack\":\"use\"} as use"},{"id":"1929","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection evaluates standing policy {\"opportunityAttack\":\"decline\"} as decline"},{"id":"1930","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection evaluates standing policy null as prompt"},{"id":"1931","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection AlgorithmController returns the same decision for the same visible request"},{"id":"1932","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection path_not_clipped: clips a movement candidate to the actor remaining movement budget"},{"id":"1933","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection dash_budget_ignored: Dash extends the movement-candidate clipping budget by the actor Speed"},{"id":"1934","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection AgentController refuses a response tied to a superseded request id"},{"id":"1935","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection coordinator refuses a stale encounter revision without applying its action"},{"id":"1936","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection M13-AGENT-CHANGES-ACTOR refuses a response whose action belongs to another combatant"},{"id":"1937","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection controller swap aborts the old prompt and reissues at the action boundary"},{"id":"1938","name":"reaction policy windows and local turn coordination standing use resolves an Opportunity Attack without a HumanController prompt"},{"id":"1939","name":"reaction policy windows and local turn coordination standing decline records the refusal and moves without a HumanController prompt"},{"id":"1940","name":"reaction policy windows and local turn coordination ambiguous reaction creates a durable HumanController prompt instead of auto-declining"},{"id":"1941","name":"reaction policy windows and local turn coordination same seed and controller inputs produce the same complete event stream"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  AgentController,\n  AlgorithmController,\n  ControllerRegistry,\n  HumanController,\n  StaleControllerResponseError,\n  evaluateOpportunityAttackPolicy,\n  type Controller,\n  type ControllerRequest,\n  type StandingReactionPolicy,\n} from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, type CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { projectPlayerView } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nfunction startedPair() {\n  const active = playerProfile('active-controller', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const other = monsterProfile('other-controller', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [active, other],\n    tokens: [placedToken(active, 0), placedToken(other, 5)],\n  });\n  return {\n    active,\n    other,\n    state: reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction endTurnRequest() {\n  const fixture = startedPair();\n  const request: ControllerRequest = {\n    kind: 'turn',\n    requestId: 'request:1',\n    encounterRevision: fixture.state.revision,\n    actorId: fixture.active.id,\n    visibleState: projectPlayerView(fixture.state, {\n      seatId: String(fixture.active.id),\n      combatantId: fixture.active.id,\n    }),\n    legalActions: {\n      actions: [{ type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.active.id }],\n    },\n  };\n  return { ...fixture, request };\n}\n\ndescribe('one Controller contract and stale response rejection', () => {\n  it.each([\n    [{ opportunityAttack: 'use' }, 'use'],\n    [{ opportunityAttack: 'decline' }, 'decline'],\n    [null, 'prompt'],\n  ] as const)('evaluates standing policy %j as %s', (policy, expected) => {\n    expect(evaluateOpportunityAttackPolicy(policy)).toBe(expected);\n  });\n\n  it('AlgorithmController returns the same decision for the same visible request', async () => {\n    const fixture = endTurnRequest();\n    const controller: Controller = new AlgorithmController();\n    const first = await controller.choose(fixture.request, new AbortController().signal);\n    const second = await controller.choose(fixture.request, new AbortController().signal);\n    expect(first).toEqual(second);\n  });\n\n  it('path_not_clipped: clips a movement candidate to the actor remaining movement budget', async () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('path-budget-controller', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = monsterProfile('path-budget-target', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const initial = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 14, rows: 10 },\n      combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0, 5), placedToken(target, 13, 5)],\n    });\n    const state = reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const fullPath = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({ column: index + 1, row: 5 }));\n    const request: ControllerRequest = {\n      kind: 'turn',\n      requestId: 'request:path-budget',\n      encounterRevision: state.revision,\n      actorId: actor.id,\n      visibleState: projectPlayerView(state, { seatId: String(actor.id), combatantId: actor.id }),\n      legalActions: { actions: [{ type: 'move', actor: actor.id, path: fullPath, cause: 'voluntary' }] },\n    };\n\n    const decision = await new AlgorithmController().choose(request, new AbortController().signal);\n\n    expect(decision.action).toEqual({\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: actor.id,\n      path: fullPath.slice(0, 6),\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('dash_budget_ignored: Dash extends the movement-candidate clipping budget by the actor Speed', async () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('dash-budget-controller', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = monsterProfile('dash-budget-target', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const initial = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 14, rows: 10 },\n      combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0, 5), placedToken(target, 13, 5)],\n    });\n    const started = reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const state = reduceEncounter(started, { type: 'dash', actor: actor.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const fullPath = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({ column: index + 1, row: 5 }));\n    const request: ControllerRequest = {\n      kind: 'turn',\n      requestId: 'request:dash-budget',\n      encounterRevision: state.revision,\n      actorId: actor.id,\n      visibleState: projectPlayerView(state, { seatId: String(actor.id), combatantId: actor.id }),\n      legalActions: { actions: [{ type: 'move', actor: actor.id, path: fullPath, cause: 'voluntary' }] },\n    };\n\n    const decision = await new AlgorithmController().choose(request, new AbortController().signal);\n\n    expect(decision.action).toEqual({\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: actor.id,\n      path: fullPath,\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('AgentController refuses a response tied to a superseded request id', async () => {\n    const fixture = endTurnRequest();\n    const controller: Controller = new AgentController({\n      exchange: async (request) => ({\n        protocolVersion: 1,\n        requestId: `${request.requestId}:stale`,\n        encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n        action: request.legalActions.actions[0],\n      }),\n    });\n    await expect(\n      controller.choose(fixture.request, new AbortController().signal),\n    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(StaleControllerResponseError);\n  });\n\n  it('coordinator refuses a stale encounter revision without applying its action', async () => {\n    const fixture = startedPair();\n    const staleAgent = new AgentController({\n      exchange: async (request) => ({\n        protocolVersion: 1,\n        requestId: request.requestId,\n        encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision - 1,\n        action: request.legalActions.actions[0],\n      }),\n    });\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n      fixture.state,\n      new ControllerRegistry([\n        { combatantId: fixture.active.id, controller: staleAgent },\n        { combatantId: fixture.other.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n      ]),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    const result = await coordinator.step();\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'refused', state: fixture.state });\n    expect(coordinator.state()).toBe(fixture.state);\n  });\n\n  it('M13-AGENT-CHANGES-ACTOR refuses a response whose action belongs to another combatant', async () => {\n    const fixture = startedPair();\n    const wrongActor = new AgentController({\n      exchange: async (request) => ({\n        protocolVersion: 1,\n        requestId: request.requestId,\n        encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n        action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.other.id },\n      }),\n    });\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n      fixture.state,\n      new ControllerRegistry([\n        { combatantId: fixture.active.id, controller: wrongActor },\n        { combatantId: fixture.other.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n      ]),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    await expect(coordinator.step()).resolves.toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'refused',\n      state: fixture.state,\n    });\n    expect(coordinator.state()).toBe(fixture.state);\n  });\n\n  it('controller swap aborts the old prompt and reissues at the action boundary', async () => {\n    const fixture = startedPair();\n    const oldHuman = new HumanController();\n    const replacement = new HumanController();\n    const registry = new ControllerRegistry([\n      { combatantId: fixture.active.id, controller: oldHuman },\n      { combatantId: fixture.other.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n    ]);\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(fixture.state, registry, () => 0.5);\n    const step = coordinator.step();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const oldRequest = oldHuman.pendingRequest();\n    if (oldRequest === null) throw new Error('Old controller did not receive its request.');\n\n    coordinator.replaceController(fixture.active.id, replacement);\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const newRequest = replacement.pendingRequest();\n    if (newRequest === null) throw new Error('Replacement controller did not receive a request.');\n\n    expect(newRequest.requestId).not.toBe(oldRequest.requestId);\n    expect(() => oldHuman.submit({\n      requestId: oldRequest.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: oldRequest.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.active.id },\n    })).toThrow(StaleControllerResponseError);\n\n    replacement.submit({\n      requestId: newRequest.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: newRequest.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.active.id },\n    });\n    await expect(step).resolves.toMatchObject({ kind: 'applied' });\n    expect(coordinator.state().revision).toBe(fixture.state.revision + 1);\n  });\n});\n\nfunction reactionFixture(policy: 'use' | 'decline' | null) {\n  const mover = monsterProfile('reaction-mover', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 20 });\n  const reactor = playerProfile('reaction-pc', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const state = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [mover, reactor],\n    tokens: [placedToken(mover, 1), placedToken(reactor, 0)],\n  });\n  const reactorHuman = new HumanController();\n  const registry = new ControllerRegistry([\n    { combatantId: mover.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n    { combatantId: reactor.id, controller: reactorHuman },\n  ]);\n  const move: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'move' }> = {\n    type: 'move',\n    actor: mover.id,\n    path: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }],\n    cause: 'voluntary',\n  };\n  const opportunityAttack: Extract<\n    EncounterCommand,\n    { readonly type: 'opportunity_attack' }\n  > = {\n    type: 'opportunity_attack',\n    actor: reactor.id,\n    target: mover.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{\n        type: damageType('Force'),\n        dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 },\n      }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n  const policies = new Map<CombatantId, StandingReactionPolicy>();\n  if (policy !== null) policies.set(reactor.id, { opportunityAttack: policy });\n  const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(state, registry, () => 0.5, {\n    turnLegalActions: (_current, actor) => ({\n      actions: actor === mover.id ? [move, { type: 'end_turn', actor }] : [{ type: 'end_turn', actor }],\n    }),\n    reactionLegalActions: () => [opportunityAttack],\n    standingReactionPolicies: policies,\n  });\n  return { coordinator, mover, reactor, reactorHuman };\n}\n\ndescribe('reaction policy windows and local turn coordination', () => {\n  it('standing use resolves an Opportunity Attack without a HumanController prompt', async () => {\n    const fixture = reactionFixture('use');\n    await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    const result = await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    expect(fixture.reactorHuman.pendingRequest()).toBeNull();\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'applied' });\n    if (result.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(result.reason);\n    expect(result.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([\n      'resource_spent',\n      'damage_applied',\n      'attack_resolved',\n      'movement_completed',\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('standing decline records the refusal and moves without a HumanController prompt', async () => {\n    const fixture = reactionFixture('decline');\n    await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    const result = await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    expect(fixture.reactorHuman.pendingRequest()).toBeNull();\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'applied' });\n    if (result.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(result.reason);\n    expect(result.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([\n      'reaction_declined',\n      'movement_completed',\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('ambiguous reaction creates a durable HumanController prompt instead of auto-declining', async () => {\n    const fixture = reactionFixture(null);\n    await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    const pendingStep = fixture.coordinator.step();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const request = fixture.reactorHuman.pendingRequest();\n    if (request === null || request.kind !== 'reaction') {\n      throw new Error('Ambiguous policy did not create the reaction prompt.');\n    }\n    expect(request.legalActions.actions.map((action) => action.type)).toEqual([\n      'opportunity_attack',\n      'decline_reaction',\n    ]);\n    fixture.reactorHuman.submit({\n      requestId: request.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'decline_reaction', actor: fixture.reactor.id, mover: fixture.mover.id },\n    });\n    const result = await pendingStep;\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'applied' });\n    expect(fixture.reactorHuman.pendingRequest()).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('same seed and controller inputs produce the same complete event stream', async () => {\n    async function run(seed: number) {\n      const left = playerProfile('deterministic-left', { initiativeBonus: 1 });\n      const right = monsterProfile('deterministic-right', { initiativeBonus: 1 });\n      const state = createEncounter({\n        bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n        combatants: [left, right],\n        tokens: [placedToken(left, 0), placedToken(right, 3)],\n      });\n      const registry = new ControllerRegistry([\n        { combatantId: left.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n        { combatantId: right.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n      ]);\n      const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(state, registry, mulberry32(seed));\n      for (let step = 0; step < 7; step += 1) await coordinator.step();\n      return coordinator.state().eventLog;\n    }\n\n    expect(await run(4242)).toEqual(await run(4242));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/search-memory.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1942","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory pins the last-known position when invisibility makes a target unseen"},{"id":"1943","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory expands the suspicion region by hand-computed grid cells each round"},{"id":"1944","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory forces unseen-target disadvantage when a monster attacks the occupied suspected square"},{"id":"1945","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory automatically misses with disadvantage when the remembered square is empty"},{"id":"1946","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory clears expired memory at the typed round boundary"},{"id":"1947","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory records heavy obscurement as a separate unseen transition cause"},{"id":"1948","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory records a successful Hide as the active search-memory cause"},{"id":"1949","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory replays the same seed and command transcript to identical search events"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { canonicalJson } from '../../../src/commands/canonical-json';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, effectStackingIdentity } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst fixedD20 = (face: number) => () => (face - 0.5) / 20;\n\nfunction requiredSearchMemories(state: EncounterState) {\n  if (state.searchMemories === undefined) throw new Error('Expected persisted D420 search memory.');\n  return state.searchMemories;\n}\n\nfunction invisibleSelf(actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>): EncounterCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'apply_effect',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    cost: 'none',\n    effect: {\n      targets: [actor.id],\n      duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n      concentration: false,\n      stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('d420:test-invisible'),\n      stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n      repeatedSave: null,\n      payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Invisible' },\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction invisibleEncounter(): {\n  readonly pc: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>;\n  readonly monster: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n} {\n  const pc = playerProfile('search-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const monster = monsterProfile('searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  let state = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 },\n    combatants: [pc, monster],\n    tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2, 2), placedToken(monster, 0, 2)],\n  });\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, invisibleSelf(pc), fixedD20(10)).state;\n  return { pc, monster, state };\n}\n\nfunction endActiveTurn(state: EncounterState): EncounterState {\n  if (state.activeCombatant === null) throw new Error('The fixture has no active turn.');\n  return reduceEncounter(\n    state,\n    { type: 'end_turn', actor: state.activeCombatant },\n    fixedD20(10),\n  ).state;\n}\n\nfunction damage(amount: number) {\n  return {\n    terms: [{\n      type: damageType('Force'),\n      dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount },\n    }],\n    critical: false,\n    responses: [],\n  } as const;\n}\n\ndescribe('D420 persistent monster-side search memory', () => {\n  it('pins the last-known position when invisibility makes a target unseen', () => {\n    const { pc, monster, state } = invisibleEncounter();\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      policy: 'search-memory-v1',\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'invisibility',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      lostAtRound: 1,\n      lastExpandedRound: 1,\n      expires: { kind: 'start_of_round', round: 4 },\n      suspicion: {\n        kind: 'grid_radius',\n        center: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n        radius: 0,\n        cells: [{ column: 2, row: 2 }],\n      },\n    })]);\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'search_memory_recorded',\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'invisibility',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n    }));\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.legalOptions.map((option) => option.kind)).toEqual([\n      'move_and_search',\n      'ready_action',\n      'attack_suspected_square',\n      'area_effect_over_region',\n    ]);\n    const serialized = JSON.stringify(state);\n    const roundTripped = JSON.parse(serialized) as unknown as EncounterState;\n    expect(JSON.stringify(roundTripped)).toBe(serialized);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(roundTripped)).toEqual(requiredSearchMemories(state));\n  });\n\n  it('expands the suspicion region by hand-computed grid cells each round', () => {\n    let { state } = invisibleEncounter();\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n\n    expect(state.round).toBe(2);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion).toEqual({\n      kind: 'grid_radius',\n      center: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      radius: 5,\n      cells: [\n        { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 3, row: 1 },\n        { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 }, { column: 3, row: 2 },\n        { column: 1, row: 3 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }, { column: 3, row: 3 },\n      ],\n    });\n\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    expect(state.round).toBe(3);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.radius).toBe(10);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.cells).toHaveLength(25);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.cells).toEqual(\n      Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_rowValue, row) =>\n        Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_columnValue, column) => ({ column, row }))).flat(),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('forces unseen-target disadvantage when a monster attacks the occupied suspected square', () => {\n    const fixture = invisibleEncounter();\n    const state = endActiveTurn(fixture.state);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack_suspected_square',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      damage: damage(0),\n    }, fixedD20(10));\n\n    const attack = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved');\n    const suspected = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'suspected_square_attacked');\n    expect(attack?.type === 'attack_resolved' ? attack.attack.roll : null).toEqual({\n      mode: 'disadvantage',\n      faces: [10, 10],\n      chosen: 10,\n    });\n    expect(suspected).toMatchObject({\n      type: 'suspected_square_attacked',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      outcome: 'target_present',\n      roll: { mode: 'disadvantage', faces: [10, 10], chosen: 10 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('automatically misses with disadvantage when the remembered square is empty', () => {\n    const fixture = invisibleEncounter();\n    let state = reduceEncounter(fixture.state, {\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: fixture.pc.id,\n      path: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }],\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack_suspected_square',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      damage: damage(10),\n    }, fixedD20(10));\n\n    expect(result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'suspected_square_attacked')).toMatchObject({\n      type: 'suspected_square_attacked',\n      outcome: 'empty',\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      roll: { mode: 'disadvantage', faces: [10, 10], chosen: 10 },\n    });\n    expect(result.events.some((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied')).toBe(false);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(result.state)[0]?.lastKnownPosition).toEqual({ column: 2, row: 2 });\n  });\n\n  it('clears expired memory at the typed round boundary', () => {\n    let { state } = invisibleEncounter();\n    while (state.round < 4) state = endActiveTurn(state);\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'search_memory_cleared',\n      reason: 'expired',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('records heavy obscurement as a separate unseen transition cause', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('obscured-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('obscurement-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2), placedToken(monster, 0)],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'world_operation',\n      actor: null,\n      cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'set_obscurement',\n        region: { id: 'd420-heavy', cells: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }] },\n        obscurement: 'heavy',\n      },\n    }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'obscurement',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n    })]);\n  });\n\n  it('records a successful Hide as the active search-memory cause', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('hidden-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('hide-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2), placedToken(monster, 0)],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'world_operation',\n      actor: null,\n      cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'set_obscurement',\n        region: { id: 'd420-hide-cover', cells: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }] },\n        obscurement: 'heavy',\n      },\n    }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'hide', actor: pc.id }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'hide_resolved',\n      combatant: pc.id,\n      outcome: 'hidden',\n    }));\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'hiding',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n    })]);\n  });\n\n  it('replays the same seed and command transcript to identical search events', () => {\n    const run = () => {\n      const pc = playerProfile('deterministic-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n      const monster = monsterProfile('deterministic-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n      const rng = mulberry32(0xD420);\n      let state = createEncounter({\n        bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 },\n        combatants: [pc, monster],\n        tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2, 2), placedToken(monster, 0, 2)],\n      });\n      const transcript: readonly EncounterCommand[] = [\n        { type: 'roll_initiative' },\n        invisibleSelf(pc),\n        { type: 'end_turn', actor: pc.id },\n        { type: 'end_turn', actor: monster.id },\n      ];\n      for (const command of transcript) state = reduceEncounter(state, command, rng).state;\n      return state;\n    };\n\n    const first = run();\n    const replayed = run();\n    expect(canonicalJson(replayed.eventLog)).toBe(canonicalJson(first.eventLog));\n    expect(canonicalJson(replayed.searchMemories)).toBe(canonicalJson(first.searchMemories));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/integration/vtt/monster-on-hit.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1950","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer charge_precondition_unmet: offers the declared base attack without its charge rider"},{"id":"1951","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer squeeze_survives_release: bear grapple carries its DC, ticks at target start, and escape ends grapple plus squeeze"},{"id":"1952","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer applies a real raptor Blinded rider only after its declared DC 15 save fails, then expires at target turn end"},{"id":"1953","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer a real spider Web failure restrains, then Venom Bite stacks Piercing and Poison damage with its Poisoned rider"},{"id":"1954","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer rider_applies_on_miss: the same bear, raptor, and spider attacks deal no damage and apply no effects when they miss"},{"id":"1955","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer declared_effect_skipped: a real raises_as_zombie declaration refuses loudly until its lifecycle lands"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { combatToken, monsterCombatantProfile, type CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand, EncounterEvent } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport {\n  monsterAttackCommand,\n  monsterSavingThrowCommand,\n} from '../../../src/combat/monster-commands';\nimport type {\n  MonsterAction,\n  MonsterAttackAction,\n  MonsterSavingThrowAction,\n  MonsterStatblock,\n} from '../../../src/combat/statblock';\nimport {\n  HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER,\n  type HomebrewBeastFamily,\n} from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/homebrew-beast-families';\nimport { STARTER_MONSTER_ROSTER } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/roster';\nimport { regretTurnLegalActions } from '../../../src/vtt/regret/legal-actions';\nimport { playerProfile } from '../../unit/combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction beast(family: HomebrewBeastFamily, challengeRating: 3) {\n  const row = HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER.find((candidate) =>\n    candidate.design.family === family && candidate.design.challengeRating === challengeRating);\n  if (row === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing ${family} CR ${String(challengeRating)} row.`);\n  return row;\n}\n\nfunction actions(statblock: MonsterStatblock): readonly MonsterAction[] {\n  if (statblock.sourceDetails.actions.kind === 'absent') throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no actions.`);\n  return statblock.sourceDetails.actions.value;\n}\n\nfunction attack(statblock: MonsterStatblock, id: string): MonsterAttackAction {\n  const action = actions(statblock).find((candidate): candidate is MonsterAttackAction =>\n    candidate.kind === 'attack' && candidate.id === id);\n  if (action === undefined) throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no attack ${id}.`);\n  return action;\n}\n\nfunction savingThrowAction(statblock: MonsterStatblock, id: string): MonsterSavingThrowAction {\n  const action = actions(statblock).find((candidate): candidate is MonsterSavingThrowAction =>\n    candidate.kind === 'saving_throw' && candidate.id === id);\n  if (action === undefined) throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no saving-throw action ${id}.`);\n  return action;\n}\n\nfunction knownTarget(key: string): CombatantProfile {\n  const target = playerProfile(key, { hitPoints: 250, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  return {\n    ...target,\n    rules: { ...target.rules, sizeCategory: 'Medium', creatureType: 'Humanoid' },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction started(statblock: MonsterStatblock, target = knownTarget('monster-rider-target')): {\n  readonly actor: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly target: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n} {\n  const actor = monsterCombatantProfile(statblock, {\n    combatantId: `combatant:${statblock.id}:on-hit`,\n    tokenId: `token:${statblock.id}:on-hit`,\n  });\n  const created = createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' },\n    bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [actor, target],\n    tokens: [combatToken(actor, { column: 0, row: 0 }), combatToken(target, { column: 1, row: 0 })],\n  });\n  return {\n    actor,\n    target,\n    state: reduceEncounter(created, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction hitPoints(state: EncounterState, target: CombatantProfile): number {\n  const subject = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === target.id);\n  if (subject === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing target ${target.id}.`);\n  return subject.hitPoints;\n}\n\nfunction attackEvent(events: readonly EncounterEvent[]) {\n  const event = events.find((candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'attack_resolved' }> =>\n    candidate.type === 'attack_resolved');\n  if (event === undefined) throw new Error('Attack did not resolve.');\n  return event;\n}\n\ndescribe('monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer', () => {\n  it('charge_precondition_unmet: offers the declared base attack without its charge rider', () => {\n    // Charge applies only after straight movement immediately before the hit:\n    // docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:22805-22809.\n    const row = beast('pterosaur', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('charge-domain-target'));\n    const declared = attack(row.statblock, 'raking-pass');\n    expect(declared.damage).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      trigger: expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'charge', minimumStraightFeet: 20 }),\n    }));\n    expect(declared.onHit).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'condition', condition: 'Prone', trigger: expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'charge' }),\n    }));\n\n    const command = regretTurnLegalActions(subject.state, subject.actor.id).actions.find(\n      (candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> =>\n        candidate.type === 'attack' && candidate.attackId === 'raking-pass',\n    );\n    if (command === undefined) throw new Error('The pterosaur base attack is missing from the legal domain.');\n    expect(command.damage.terms).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toEqual([]);\n\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(attackEvent(hit.events)).toMatchObject({\n      actor: subject.actor.id,\n      target: subject.target.id,\n      damage: expect.objectContaining({ terms: [expect.objectContaining({ type: 'Piercing' })] }),\n    });\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual(\n      expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Prone' }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('squeeze_survives_release: bear grapple carries its DC, ticks at target start, and escape ends grapple plus squeeze', () => {\n    const row = beast('ursine', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('bear-grapple-target'));\n    const command = monsterAttackCommand(\n      attack(row.statblock, 'bear-hug'),\n      subject.actor.id,\n      subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toMatchObject([\n      { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Grappled', escapeDc: 15, duration: 'until_escape' },\n      { kind: 'condition_bound_ongoing_damage', boundCondition: 'Grappled' },\n    ]);\n\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({\n      name: 'Grappled', source: subject.actor.id,\n    });\n    const grapple = hit.state.effects.find((effect) =>\n      effect.payload.kind === 'condition' && effect.payload.condition === 'Grappled');\n    const squeeze = hit.state.effects.find((effect) => effect.payload.kind === 'ongoing_damage');\n    expect(grapple?.escapeCheck).toEqual({ ability: 'strength', skill: 'athletics', dc: 15 });\n    expect(squeeze?.parentEffectId).toBe(grapple?.id);\n\n    const afterHitPoints = hitPoints(hit.state, subject.target);\n    const targetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      hit.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    const squeezeDamage = targetStart.events.find((event) =>\n      event.type === 'damage_applied' && event.target === subject.target.id);\n    expect(squeezeDamage).toMatchObject({ source: subject.actor.id, amount: 7 });\n    expect(hitPoints(targetStart.state, subject.target)).toBe(afterHitPoints - 7);\n\n    if (grapple === undefined) throw new Error('Grapple effect was not created.');\n    const escaped = reduceEncounter(targetStart.state, {\n      type: 'roll_ability_check',\n      actor: subject.target.id,\n      ability: 'strength',\n      skill: 'athletics',\n      bonus: 100,\n      dc: 15,\n      rollMode: 'normal',\n      cost: 'action',\n      escapeEffectId: grapple.id,\n    }, () => 0);\n    expect(escaped.state.effects.some((effect) =>\n      effect.id === grapple.id || effect.parentEffectId === grapple.id)).toBe(false);\n    expect(combatantConditions(escaped.state, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual(\n      expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Grappled' }),\n    );\n\n    const afterEscapeHitPoints = hitPoints(escaped.state, subject.target);\n    const nextBearTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      escaped.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const nextTargetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      nextBearTurn,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    expect(hitPoints(nextTargetStart.state, subject.target)).toBe(afterEscapeHitPoints);\n    expect(nextTargetStart.events.some((event) =>\n      event.type === 'damage_applied' && event.target === subject.target.id)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('applies a real raptor Blinded rider only after its declared DC 15 save fails, then expires at target turn end', () => {\n    const row = beast('raptor', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('blinded-rider-target'));\n    const command = monsterAttackCommand(\n      attack(row.statblock, 'talon-rake'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'condition', condition: 'Blinded',\n      savingThrow: { ability: 'constitution', dc: 15 },\n      duration: 'until_end_of_target_next_turn',\n    }));\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(hit.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'save_resolved', target: subject.target.id,\n      ability: 'constitution', dc: 15,\n      save: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'failure' }),\n    }));\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n\n    const targetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      hit.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(targetStart, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n    const targetEnd = reduceEncounter(\n      targetStart, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(targetEnd, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n  });\n\n  it('a real spider Web failure restrains, then Venom Bite stacks Piercing and Poison damage with its Poisoned rider', () => {\n    const row = beast('arachnid', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('spider-rider-target'));\n    const web = monsterSavingThrowCommand(\n      savingThrowAction(row.statblock, 'web'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(web.monsterFailureEffects).toMatchObject([\n      { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Restrained', escapeDc: 15, duration: 'until_escape' },\n    ]);\n    const webbed = reduceEncounter(subject.state, web, () => 0);\n    expect(webbed.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'save_resolved', dc: 15, save: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'failure' }),\n    }));\n    expect(combatantConditions(webbed.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Restrained' });\n\n    const targetTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      webbed.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const nextSpiderTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      targetTurn, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const beforeBite = hitPoints(nextSpiderTurn, subject.target);\n    const bitten = reduceEncounter(\n      nextSpiderTurn,\n      monsterAttackCommand(attack(row.statblock, 'venom-bite'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    const resolved = attackEvent(bitten.events);\n    expect(resolved.damage?.terms.map((term) => term.type)).toEqual(['Piercing', 'Poison']);\n    expect(hitPoints(bitten.state, subject.target)).toBe(beforeBite - (resolved.damage?.total ?? 0));\n    expect(combatantConditions(bitten.state, subject.target.id)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      { name: 'Restrained' }, { name: 'Poisoned' },\n    ]));\n  });\n\n  it('rider_applies_on_miss: the same bear, raptor, and spider attacks deal no damage and apply no effects when they miss', () => {\n    for (const [family, actionId] of [\n      ['ursine', 'bear-hug'],\n      ['raptor', 'talon-rake'],\n      ['arachnid', 'venom-bite'],\n    ] as const) {\n      const row = beast(family, 3);\n      const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget(`${family}-miss-target`));\n      const before = hitPoints(subject.state, subject.target);\n      const missed = reduceEncounter(\n        subject.state,\n        monsterAttackCommand(attack(row.statblock, actionId), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n        () => 0,\n      );\n      expect(attackEvent(missed.events).attack.outcome, family).toBe('miss');\n      expect(hitPoints(missed.state, subject.target), family).toBe(before);\n      expect(missed.state.effects, family).toEqual([]);\n      expect(combatantConditions(missed.state, subject.target.id), family).toEqual([]);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('declared_effect_skipped: a real raises_as_zombie declaration refuses loudly until its lifecycle lands', () => {\n    const row = STARTER_MONSTER_ROSTER.find((candidate) => candidate.id === 'statblock:wight');\n    if (row === undefined) throw new Error('Missing Wight row.');\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('zombie-raise-target'));\n    const lifeDrain = savingThrowAction(row.statblock, 'life-drain');\n    expect(lifeDrain.failure.effects.map((effect) => effect.kind)).toEqual([\n      'hit_point_maximum_reduction', 'raises_as_zombie',\n    ]);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(\n      subject.state,\n      monsterSavingThrowCommand(lifeDrain, subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n      () => 0,\n    )).toThrow('raises_as_zombie monster effect has no landed delayed out-of-combat lifecycle');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/stable-dom-render.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1956","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps a pending tray option connected and clickable across live publishes"},{"id":"1957","name":"stable VTT control rendering does not orphan a pressed tray option when a preview rerenders before click"},{"id":"1958","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps controller controls connected while adding a deferred roster member"},{"id":"1959","name":"stable VTT control rendering timeline_rewind_control_replaced: keeps the live rewind button connected while the timeline republishes"},{"id":"1960","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps the encounter pause acknowledgement connected while its state changes"},{"id":"1961","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps a boundary-refusal surface connected while its message republishes"},{"id":"1962","name":"stable VTT control rendering rejects a keyed control whose unkeyed wrapper would still replace it"},{"id":"1963","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps every short-rest control connected through its keyed form and labels"},{"id":"1964","name":"stable VTT control rendering rejects colliding logical identities before mutating the live tree"},{"id":"1965","name":"stable VTT control rendering encodes every key
