projectPlayerView(state, {\n      seatId: 'seat:west',\n      combatantId: pc.profile.id,\n    });\n    const revealed = projectPlayerView({\n      ...state,\n      foggedCells: [{ column: 4, row: 0 }],\n    }, {\n      seatId: 'seat:west',\n      combatantId: pc.profile.id,\n    });\n\n    expect(fogged.cells).toContainEqual({ column: 2, row: 0 });\n    expect(fogged.cells).not.toContainEqual({ column: 3, row: 0 });\n    expect(fogged.combatants.map((entry) => entry.name)).not.toContain('fogged');\n    expect(revealed.cells).toContainEqual({ column: 3, row: 0 });\n    expect(revealed.combatants.map((entry) => entry.name)).toContain('fogged');\n  });\n\n  it('omits hidden death-save results, fog facts, and DM-only fields from player objects while exposing a redacted result', () => {\n    const state = hiddenDeathSaveState();\n    const pc = state.combatants.find((subject) => subject.profile.kind === 'player_character');\n    if (pc === undefined) throw new Error('Visibility fixture has no player seat.');\n    const player = projectPlayerView(state, {\n      seatId: 'seat:west',\n      combatantId: pc.profile.id,\n    });\n    const dm = dmVisibleEncounter(projectDmView(state));\n    const serializedPlayer = JSON.stringify(player);\n\n    expect(serializedPlayer).not.toContain('hidden mechanism');\n    expect(serializedPlayer).not.toContain('foggedCells');\n    expect(player.recentEvents.find((event) => event.type === 'death_save_resolved')).toMatchObject({\n      rollVisibility: 'dm_only',\n      failures: 1,\n      lifeState: 'dying',\n    });\n    expect(serializedPlayer).not.toContain('\"roll\":9');\n    expect(dm.dmOnly.notes).toContain('The east square contains a hidden mechanism.');\n    expect(dm.recentEvents.find((event) => event.type === 'death_save_resolved')).toMatchObject({\n      roll: 9,\n      failures: 1,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('gates owned details per seat and produces distinguishing views over the same state', () => {\n    const west = playerProfile('west-seat');\n    const east = playerProfile('east-seat');\n    const state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 1 },\n      foggedCells: [{ column: 4, row: 0 }],\n      combatants: [west, east],\n      tokens: [placedToken(west, 0), placedToken(east, 4)],\n    });\n\n    const westView = projectPlayerView(state, {\n      seatId: 'seat:west',\n      combatantId: west.id,\n    });\n    const eastView = projectPlayerView(state, {\n      seatId: 'seat:east',\n      combatantId: east.id,\n    });\n\n    expect(westView.combatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([west.id]);\n    expect(eastView.combatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([west.id, east.id]);\n    expect(westView.ownedCombatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([west.id]);\n    expect(eastView.ownedCombatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([east.id]);\n    expect(westView.seat).toMatchObject({ seatId: 'seat:west', combatantId: west.id });\n    expect(eastView.seat).toMatchObject({ seatId: 'seat:east', combatantId: east.id });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/reaction-guidance.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2092","name":"D401 reaction guidance leaves the DM-attended tray path unchanged even when sticky guidance says take"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { guidedPendingReactionResolution } from '../../../src/vtt/reaction-guidance';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction pendingReaction(): EncounterState {\n  const mover = playerProfile('guidance-mover', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const reactor = monsterProfile('guidance-reactor', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const started = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 2 }, combatants: [mover, reactor],\n    tokens: [placedToken(mover, 1), placedToken(reactor, 0)],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n  return reduceEncounter(started, {\n    type: 'move', actor: mover.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n  }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\ndescribe('D401 reaction guidance', () => {\n  it('leaves the DM-attended tray path unchanged even when sticky guidance says take', () => {\n    const state = pendingReaction();\n    const decision = state.pendingDecisions.find((entry) => entry.kind === 'reaction_offer');\n    if (decision?.kind !== 'reaction_offer') throw new Error('Expected a pending Reaction offer.');\n\n    expect(guidedPendingReactionResolution(\n      state, decision, 'agent', { kind: 'dm_attended' },\n      { sideWide: { opportunity_attack: 'take' }, actors: [] },\n    )).toBeNull();\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/closed-predicates.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2093","name":"closed VTT predicates classifies agent command type \"attack\""},{"id":"2094","name":"closed VTT predicates ['world_operation', false],\n    ['', false],\n    [42, false],\n  ] as const)('classifies agent command type %j', (value, expected) => {\n    expect(isAgentEncounterCommandType(value)).toBe(expected);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['magic-missile', true],\n    ['hold-monster', true],\n    ['chronomancy-burst', false],\n    ['', false],\n  ] as describe('engine movement and opportunity-cost intel', () => {
  it('does not repeat the frozen Room-8 four-actor zero-feet Dash plan', () => {
    const state = room8State();
    const failedRound = JSON.parse(inputs.fixtures.readText(
      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/failing-round.SIMULATED.json',
    )) as readonly FailedRoundEntry[];
    const dashZeroActorIds = failedRound.filter((entry) =>
      entry.resolutionSummary.movementFeet === 0 &&
      entry.resolutionSummary.actionSlots.some((slot) => slot.kind === 'dash'))
      .map((entry) => combatantId(entry.actorId));
    expect(dashZeroActorIds).toHaveLength(4);

    const runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(state, {
      requestedActorIds: dashZeroActorIds,
      revision: 203,
      room: 8,
      offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
    });
    const capsule = runtime.feed.current();
    const context = record(runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.get_turn_context', {
      run_id: capsule.runId,
      expected_revision: capsule.revision,
      scope: 'round',
      granularity: 'full',
      maximum_options_per_actor: 20,
    }));
    const actors = context['actors'];
    if (!Array.isArray(actors)) throw new TypeError('Room-8 actor contexts are absent.');
    expect(actors).toHaveLength(4);
    const frontier = record(context['team_plan_frontier']);
    const frontierCandidates = frontier['candidates'];
    if (!Array.isArray(frontierCandidates)) throw new TypeError('Room-8 team frontier is absent.');
    expect(frontierCandidates.map((candidate) => record(candidate)['candidate_id']))
      .toEqual(['focus_fire', 'basic_advance']);
    const play = record(runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
      play_name: 'basic_advance',
    }));
    const proposals = play['proposals'];
    if (!Array.isArray(proposals)) throw new TypeError('Room-8 play proposals are absent.');

    for (const actorId of dashZeroActorIds) {
      const options = availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT, 203);
      expect(options.some((option) => option.actionSlots.some((slot) =>
        slot.use.kind === 'attack' || slot.use.kind === 'multiattack'))).toBe(false);
    }
    const guardAttackArrival = [
      [combatantId('combatant:generated-5117008-monster-2'), 35],
      [combatantId('combatant:generated-5117008-monster-4'), 35],
      [combatantId('combatant:generated-5117008-monster-5'), 40],
    ] as const;
    for (const [actorId, expectedMovementFeet] of guardAttackArrival) {
      const movement = OFFER_ENVIRONMENT.queries.movementOptions(state, actorId, CLERIC, 'spear');
      expect(movement?.earliestAttackTurn).toMatchObject({
        status: 'resolved', movementCost: expectedMovementFeet, turns: 1,
      });
    }

    const selected = proposals.map((value) => {
      const proposal = record(value);

function requiredValue(argv: readonly string[], index: number, option: string): string {
  const value = argv[index + 1];
  if (value === undefined || value.startsWith('--')) throw new TypeError(`${option} requires a value.`);
  return value;
}

function safeInteger(value: string, option: string, minimum: number): number {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < minimum) {
    throw new TypeError(`${option} must be a safe integer greater than or equal to ${String(minimum)}.`);
  }
  return parsed;
}

function parseOptions(argv: readonly string[]): {
  readonly flags: ReadonlySet<string>;
  readonly values: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
} {
  const args = argv[0] === '--' ? argv.slice(1) : argv;
  const flags = new Set<string>();
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  const knownFlags = new Set(['--verify-only']);
  const knownValues = new Set([
    '--difficulty', '--seed', '--rooms', '--out', '--terrain-profile', '--protocol',
    '--party-pack-dir', '--manifest', '--basis-dir', '--basis-manifest',
    '--manifest-sha256', '--expect-rooms',
  ]);
  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
    const option = args[index];
    if (option === undefined) throw new TypeError('Basis-generator option is missing.');
    if (knownFlags.has(option)) {
      flags.add(option);
      continue;
    }
    if (!knownValues.has(option)) throw new TypeError(`Unknown basis-generator option ${option}.`);
    values.set(option, requiredValue(args, index, option));
    index += 1;
  }
  return { flags, values };
}

function heldoutProtocol(value: string | undefined): HeldoutOrdinaryProtocol | null {
  return HELDOUT_ORDINARY_PROTOCOLS.includes(value as HeldoutOrdinaryProtocol)
    ? value as HeldoutOrdinaryProtocol
    : null;
}

function rejectUnexpectedOptions(
  parsed: ReturnType<typeof parseOptions>,
  allowedValues: ReadonlySet<string>,
  allowedFlags: ReadonlySet<string>,
): void {
  const unexpected = [
    ...[...parsed.values.keys()].filter((option) => !allowedValues.has(option)),
    ...[...parsed.flags].filter((option) => !allowedFlags.has(option)),
  ];
  if (unexpected.length > 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`Options are not valid for this basis mode: ${unexpected.join(', ')}.`);
  }
}

export function parseBasisGenerationArgs(argv: readonly string[]): BasisGenerationConfig {
  const parsed = parseOptions(argv);
  const protocol = heldoutProtocol(parsed.values.get('--protocol'));
  if (parsed.flags.has('--verify-only')) {
    rejectUnexpectedOptions(parsed, new Set([
      '--protocol', '--basis-dir', '--basis-manifest', '--manifest-sha256', '--expect-rooms',
    ]), new Set(['--verify-only']));
    if (protocol === null) {
      throw new TypeError('--protocol must be heldout-ordinary-v1 or heldout-development-v1.');
    }
    const basisPath = parsed.values.get('--basis-dir');
    const manifestPath = parsed.values.get('--basis-manifest');
    const manifestSha256 = parsed.values.get('--manifest-sha256');
    if (basisPath === undefined || manifestPath === undefined || manifestSha256 === undefined) {
      throw new TypeError('--verify-only requires --basis-dir, --basis-manifest, and --manifest-sha256.');
    }
    return {
      verifyOnly: true,
      protocol,
      basisPath: resolve(basisPath),
      manifestPath: resolve(manifestPath),
      manifestSha256,
      expectRooms: safeInteger(parsed.values.get('--expect-rooms') ?? '', '--expect-rooms', 1),
    };
  }
  if (protocol !== null) {
    rejectUnexpectedOptions(parsed, new Set([
      '--protocol', '--seed', '--rooms', '--party-pack-dir', '--out', '--manifest',
    ]), new Set());
    const out = parsed.values.get('--out');
    const partyPackPath = parsed.values.get('--party-pack-dir');
    const manifestPath = parsed.values.get('--manifest');
    if (out === undefined || partyPackPath === undefined || manifestPath === undefined) {
      throw new TypeError('Held-out generation requires --out, --party-pack-dir, and --manifest.');
    }
    return {
      protocol,
      seed: safeInteger(parsed.values.get('--seed') ?? '', '--seed', 0),
      rooms: safeInteger(parsed.values.get('--rooms') ?? '', '--rooms', 1),
      partyPackPath: resolve(partyPackPath),
      partyPackPath: resolve(partyPackPath),
      outPath: resolve(out),
      manifestPath: resolve(manifestPath),
    };
  }
  if (parsed.values.has('--protocol')) {
    throw new TypeError('--protocol must be heldout-ordinary-v1 or heldout-development-v1.');
  }
  rejectUnexpectedOptions(parsed, new Set([
    '--difficulty', '--seed', '--rooms', '--out', '--terrain-profile',
  ]), new Set());
  const difficulty = parsed.values.get('--difficulty');
  if (!ROOM_DIFFICULTY_PROFILES.includes(difficulty as RoomDifficultyProfile)) {
    throw new TypeError('--difficulty must be standard, hard, or brutal.');
  }
  const out = parsed.values.get('--out');
  if (out === undefined) throw new TypeError('--out is required.');
  const terrainProfile = parsed.values.get('--terrain-profile');
  if (terrainProfile !== undefined && !ROOM_TERRAIN_PROFILES.includes(
    terrainProfile as RoomTerrainProfile,
  )) {
    throw new TypeError('--terrain-profile must be los_cover_v1.');
  }
  return {
    difficulty: difficulty as RoomDifficultyProfile,
    seed: safeInteger(parsed.values.get('--seed') ?? '', '--seed', 0),
    rooms: safeInteger(parsed.values.get('--rooms') ?? '', '--rooms', 1),
    outPath: resolve(out),
    ...(terrainProfile === undefined ? {} : { terrainProfile: terrainProfile as RoomTerrainProfile }),
  };
}

export function heldoutBasisSchedule(protocol: HeldoutOrdinaryProtocol, ordinal: number) {
  const localOrdinal = ordinal % 24;
  const level = (3 + localOrdinal % 4) as HeldoutPartyLevel;
  const targetXp: Readonly<Record<HeldoutPartyLevel, HeldoutTargetXp>> = {
    3: 900, 4: 1_500, 5: 3_000, 6: 4_000,
  };
  const slices = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F'] as const;
  const partition: HeldoutPartition | undefined = protocol === 'heldout-development-v1'
    ? 'development'
    : slices[Math.floor(ordinal / 24)];
  if (partition === undefined) throw new RangeError('Held-out reserve supports six 24-room slices.');
  return {
    partition,
    level,
    targetXp: targetXp[level],
    terrainProfile: Math.floor(localOrdinal / 4) % 2 === 0
      ? 'los_cover_v1' as const
      : null,
  };
}

export function basisRepositoryRevision(): string {
  return execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
}

async function generateLegacyBasis(config: LegacyBasisGenerationConfig): Promise<null> {
  await mkdir(config.outPath, { recursive: true });
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: config.rooms }, async (_unused, index) => {
    const seed = config.seed + index;
    const generated = generateRoom(seed, {
      difficulty: config.difficulty,
      ...(config.terrainProfile === undefined ? {} : { terrainProfile: config.terrainProfile }),
    });
    const room = decodeArenaBasisEnvelopeV1(generated, { mode: 'legacy_basis' });
    await writeFile(
      resolve(config.outPath, `seed-${String(seed)}.json`),
      `${canonicalJson(room)}\n`,
      'utf8',
    );
  }));
  return null;
}

function monsterProfile(
  statblock: typeof SCOUT | typeof SPY | typeof PRIEST | typeof BROWN_BEAR | typeof DIRE_WOLF,
  key: string,
  initiativeBonus = 100,
): CombatantProfile {
  const profile = monsterCombatantProfile(statblock, {
    combatantId: `combatant:${key}`,
    tokenId: `token:${key}`,
  });
  return { ...profile, rules: { ...profile.rules, initiativeBonus } };
}

function encounter(
  monsters: readonly { readonly profile: CombatantProfile; readonly column: number; readonly row: number }[],
  targetColumn: number,
  worldObjects: readonly WorldObject[] = [],
): EncounterState {
  const target = playerProfile('target', { hitPoints: 200, initiativeBonus: -100 });
  return freshMonsterPlanningState(createEncounter({
    bounds: { columns: 40, rows: 10 },
    combatants: [...monsters.map((entry) => entry.profile), target],
    tokens: [
      ...monsters.map((entry) => placedToken(entry.profile, entry.column, entry.row)),
      placedToken(target, targetColumn, 2),
    ],
    worldObjects,
  }));
}

function proposalFor(state: EncounterState, option: EngineOfferableOption): EngineTurnProposal {

    expectedRevision: option.revision,
    primaryOptionId: option.optionId,
    fallbackOptionId: null,
    reason: 'Exercise the composite proposal fixture.',
    overrideJustification: null,
  };
}

shapes have named reasons"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  availableFormActions,\n  canCombatantSee,\n  createEncounter,\n  EquipmentRuleError,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport {\n  FORM_REPLACEMENT_RETAINED_STATISTICS,\n  type BranchSpellOperation,\n  type SpellCastCommand,\n} from '../../../src/combat/spells/types';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, itemId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  importedMonsterAttackCommand,\n  loadContentPack,\n  OBJECT_TO_CREATURE_REFUSAL,\n  TRUE_POLYMORPH_PERMANENCE_REFUSAL,\n  type LoadedContentPack,\n} from '../../../src/content/content-pack';\nimport { placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst { readText: readFileSync } = declareTestInputs({\n  fixtures: ['tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json'],\n}).fixtures;\n\ninterface MutableFormsPack {\n  packId: string;\n  spells: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  items: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  monsters: Array<{\n    recordId: string;\n    name: string;\n    statblock: Record<string, unknown>;\n    actions: unknown[];\n  }>;\n  [key: string]: unknown;\n}\n\nconst FORM_ITEM = itemId('greenforge:shape-knife');\n\nfunction sourcePack(): MutableFormsPack {\n  const source = JSON.parse(readFileSync('tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json', 'utf8')) as MutableFormsPack;\n  source.packId = 'forms-fixture';\n  const monster = source.monsters[0];\n  if (monster === undefined) throw new Error('Forms fixture has no monster statblock.');\n  monster.statblock.speedFeet = 40;\n  monster.statblock.senses = [\n    { kind: 'normal_sight' },\n    { kind: 'blindsight', rangeFeet: 30 },\n  ];\n  source.items = [{\n    sourceId: 'greenforge', recordId: 'shape-knife', name: 'Shape Knife',\n    materials: [{ kind: 'other', name: 'bone' }],\n    equip: { kind: 'held', handCapacity: 1, droppable: true },\n  }];\n  return source;\n}\n\nfunction packMonsterOperation(\n  equipmentDisposition: 'merged_into_form' | 'dropped_at_origin' = 'merged_into_form',\n): Extract<BranchSpellOperation, { readonly kind: 'form_replacement' }> {\n  return {\n    kind: 'form_replacement',\n    form: { kind: 'pack_monster', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote' },\n    retainedStatistics: FORM_REPLACEMENT_RETAINED_STATISTICS,\n    hitPoints: 'temporary_form_pool',\n    equipmentDisposition,\n    actionAccess: 'form_statblock_only',\n    spellcasting: 'prohibited',\n    lifecycle: { concentration: true, durationRounds: 10, expiresAt: 'source_start' },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction statOverrideOperation(): Extract<BranchSpellOperation, { readonly kind: 'form_replacement' }> {\n  return {\n    ...packMonsterOperation('dropped_at_origin'),\n    form: {\n      kind: 'stat_override',\n      stats: {\n        id: 'mist-hound', name: 'Mist Hound', armorClass: 13, hitPointMaximum: 7,\n        speedFeet: 45, initiativeBonus: 3,\n        savingThrowBonuses: {\n          strength: 2, dexterity: 3, constitution: 1,\n          intelligence: -2, wisdom: 2, charisma: -1,\n        },\n        attacksPerAction: 1, reachFeet: 5,\n        damageResponses: [{ type: 'Cold', response: 'resistant' }],\n        conditionImmunities: ['Prone'],\n        senses: [{ kind: 'normal_sight' }, { kind: 'truesight', rangeFeet: 20 }],\n        actions: [{\n          kind: 'attack', id: 'mist-bite', name: 'Mist Bite', attackBonus: 5,\n          delivery: { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: 5 },\n          damage: [{\n            average: 5, dice: { count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 1 }, type: 'Cold',\n            trigger: { kind: 'always' },\n          }],\n          attackRollAdvantage: null, onHit: [],\n        }],\n      },\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction formSpell(source: MutableFormsPack, operation: unknown, recordId = 'assume-brassleaf'): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const template = source.spells[0];\n  if (template === undefined) throw new Error('Forms fixture has no spell template.');\n  return {\n    ...template,\n    recordId,\n    name: recordId,\n    level: 1,\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', rounds: 10 },\n    concentration: true,\n    targeting: { kind: 'single', rangeFeet: 30, willing: true },\n    operation,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction loadedFormsPack(operation: unknown = packMonsterOperation()): LoadedContentPack {\n  const source = sourcePack();\n  source.spells = [formSpell(source, operation)];\n  const result = loadContentPack(source);\n  if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Forms pack refused: ${result.refusal.reason}`);\n  expect(result.content.diagnostics).toEqual([]);\n  return result.content;\n}\n\ninterface FormsEncounter {\n  readonly content: LoadedContentPack;\n  readonly caster: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly target: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly enemy: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n}\n\nfunction started(operation: unknown = packMonsterOperation()): FormsEncounter {\n  const content = loadedFormsPack(operation);\n  const caster = playerProfile('forms-caster', {\n    initiativeBonus: 20, spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 4 }],\n  });\n  const target = playerProfile('forms-target', {\n    hitPoints: 20, initiativeBonus: 10, spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }],\n  });\n  const enemy = playerProfile('forms-enemy', { hitPoints: 30, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 10, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [caster, target, enemy],\n    tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(target, 1), placedToken(enemy, 2)],\n    contentPacks: [content],\n    equipment: [{\n      combatant: target.id,\n      hands: { kind: 'one_handed', items: [FORM_ITEM] },\n      worn: [], carried: [],\n    }],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  return { content, caster, target, enemy, state };\n}\n\nfunction cast(subject: FormsEncounter): EncounterState {\n  const command: SpellCastCommand = {\n    type: 'cast_spell', actor: subject.caster.id, spellId: 'greenforge:assume-brassleaf',\n    slotLevel: 1, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 6, saveDc: 14,\n    spellcastingModifier: 3, targets: [subject.target.id], area: null,\n    weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n  };\n  return reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0).state;\n}\n\nfunction fixedDamage(subject: FormsEncounter, state: EncounterState, amount: number): ReturnType<typeof reduceEncounter> {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'force_save', actor: subject.caster.id, target: subject.target.id,\n    ability: 'dexterity', dc: 30, rollMode: 'normal',\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: amount } }],\n      critical: false, responses: [],\n    },\n    onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n  }, () => 0);\n}\n\nfunction targetState(state: EncounterState, target: CombatantProfile) {\n  const found = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === target.id);\n  if (found === undefined) throw new Error('Forms target is absent from encounter state.');\n  return found;\n}\n\ndescribe('D348.1 imported form and stat replacement', () => {\n  it('form_assumed_and_stats_replaced: pack statblock supplies form HP, stats, speed, senses, and actions while identity and original HP persist', () => {\n    // Replaced statistics and retained continuity: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5952-5963.\n    const subject = started();\n    const before = targetState(subject.state, subject.target);\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    const after = targetState(transformed, subject.target);\n\n    expect(after.form).toMatchObject({\n      formId: 'greenforge:brassleaf-mote', formName: 'Brassleaf Mote',\n      hitPoints: 9, hitPointMaximum: 9,\n      retainedStatistics: FORM_REPLACEMENT_RETAINED_STATISTICS,\n      equipmentDisposition: 'merged_into_form', spellcasting: 'prohibited',\n    });\n    expect(after.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(after.profile.name).toBe(before.profile.name);\n    expect(after.profile.rules).toMatchObject({ armorClass: 12, speed: 40, initiativeBonus: 1 });\n    expect(availableFormActions(transformed, subject.target.id)?.map(({ id }) => id))\n      .toEqual(['attack:brassleaf-tap']);\n\n    const enemyCell = transformed.tokens.find(({ combatantId }) => combatantId === subject.enemy.id)?.position;\n    if (enemyCell === undefined) throw new Error('Forms enemy has no token.');\n    const dark = {\n      ...transformed,\n      environment: {\n        ...transformed.environment,\n        lightRegions: [{ id: 'form-sense-darkness', cells: [enemyCell], level: 'darkness' as const }],\n      },\n    };\n    const originalDark = { ...subject.state, environment: dark.environment };\n    expect(canCombatantSee(originalDark, subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id)).toBe(false);\n    expect(canCombatantSee(dark, subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('carryover_lost and carryover_boundary_exact_vs_one_over: exactly the remaining form HP reverts without original damage; one over carries exactly one', () => {\n    // Form THP ends the spell: spell-descriptions.txt:5958-5963. Leftover damage\n    // carries to actual HP: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:1126-1131.\n    const exactSubject = started();\n    const exact = fixedDamage(exactSubject, cast(exactSubject), 9);\n    const exactTarget = targetState(exact.state, exactSubject.target);\n    expect(exactTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(exactTarget.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(exact.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'effect_ended', reason: 'form_hit_points_depleted',\n    }));\n\n    const overSubject = started();\n    const over = fixedDamage(overSubject, cast(overSubject), 10);\n    const overTarget = targetState(over.state, overSubject.target);\n    expect(overTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(overTarget.hitPoints).toBe(19);\n  });\n\n  it('original_hp_touched_in_form and revert_keeps_form_stats: partial form damage drains only the form pool and effect-end reversion differs from zero-HP reversion', () => {\n    const subject = started();\n    const partial = fixedDamage(subject, cast(subject), 4).state;\n    expect(targetState(partial, subject.target)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 20,\n      form: { hitPoints: 5, hitPointMaximum: 9 },\n    });\n\n    const ended = reduceEncounter(partial, {\n      type: 'end_concentration', actor: subject.caster.id,\n    }, () => 0);\n    const endedTarget = targetState(ended.state, subject.target);\n    expect(endedTarget.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(endedTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(endedTarget.profile.rules).toMatchObject({ armorClass: 14, speed: 30 });\n    expect(ended.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'effect_ended', reason: 'concentration_ended',\n    }));\n    expect(ended.events.some((event) =>\n      event.type === 'effect_ended' && event.reason === 'form_hit_points_depleted')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('form_actions_and_casting_restriction: only an unchanged statblock attack is legal and spellcasting is refused', () => {\n    // Form anatomy and casting restriction: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5965-5967.\n    const subject = started();\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n      type: 'cast_spell', actor: subject.target.id, spellId: 'greenforge:assume-brassleaf',\n      slotLevel: 1, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 5, saveDc: 13,\n      spellcastingModifier: 2, targets: [subject.target.id], area: null,\n      weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n    }, () => 0)).toThrow('cannot cast spells in its current form');\n\n    let targetTurn = reduceEncounter(transformed, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(targetTurn, {\n      type: 'attack', actor: subject.target.id, target: subject.enemy.id,\n      attackBonus: 4, criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal',\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Bludgeoning'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5)).toThrow('must use an attack from form');\n\n    const monster = subject.content.monsters.find(({ recordId }) => recordId === 'brassleaf-mote');\n    if (monster === undefined) throw new Error('Loaded form monster is missing.');\n    targetTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      targetTurn,\n      importedMonsterAttackCommand(monster, 'attack:brassleaf-tap', subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id),\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(targetState(targetTurn, subject.enemy).hitPoints).toBeLessThan(30);\n  });\n\n  it('merged_equipment_is_unavailable: worn and carried shape with the form and cannot be interacted with', () => {\n    // Polymorph gear melds and provides no benefit: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5971-5973.\n    const subject = started();\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(transformed.equipment?.find(({ combatant }) => combatant === subject.target.id)?.hands)\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'one_handed', items: [FORM_ITEM] });\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n      type: 'drop_item', actor: subject.target.id, item: FORM_ITEM, interaction: 'free',\n    }, () => 0)).toThrow(EquipmentRuleError);\n    try {\n      reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n        type: 'drop_item', actor: subject.target.id, item: FORM_ITEM, interaction: 'free',\n      }, () => 0);\n      expect.fail('Merged form equipment unexpectedly remained interactable.');\n    } catch (error) {\n      expect(error).toMatchObject({ code: 'form_equipment_unavailable' });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('declared_stat_override_and_drop: a pack can declare the replacement block and drop equipment at the origin', () => {\n    const subject = started(statOverrideOperation());\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(targetState(transformed, subject.target)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 20,\n      form: { formId: 'mist-hound', hitPoints: 7, equipmentDisposition: 'dropped_at_origin' },\n      profile: { rules: { armorClass: 13, speed: 45 } },\n    });\n    expect(transformed.equipment?.find(({ combatant }) => combatant === subject.target.id)?.hands)\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'empty' });\n    expect(transformed.groundItems).toContainEqual({ item: FORM_ITEM, position: { column: 1, row: 0 } });\n    expect(transformed.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'item_dropped', item: FORM_ITEM, cause: 'form_replacement',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('unknown_form_id_transforms: rejects only the missing-id form record and loads the rest of the pack', () => {\n    const source = sourcePack();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    const missing = {\n      ...packMonsterOperation(),\n      form: { kind: 'pack_monster', monsterId: 'absent-form' },\n    };\n    source.spells = [healthy, formSpell(source, missing, 'missing-form')];\n    const loaded = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(loaded.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Missing form record unexpectedly refused the pack envelope.');\n    expect(loaded.content.spells.map(({ recordId }) => recordId)).toEqual(['prism-pebble']);\n    expect(loaded.content.monsters.map(({ recordId }) => recordId)).toEqual(['brassleaf-mote']);\n    expect(loaded.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'missing_form_reference', recordId: 'missing-form',\n      monsterId: 'greenforge:absent-form',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('true_polymorph_and_object_transformation_refusals: unsupported permanence and object-to-creature shapes have named reasons', () => {\n    const source = sourcePack();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    source.spells = [\n      healthy,\n      formSpell(source, { kind: 'true_polymorph_permanence' }, 'permanent-form'),\n      formSpell(source, { kind: 'object_to_creature_transformation' }, 'object-creature'),\n    ];\n    const loaded = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(loaded.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Named form refusals unexpectedly refused the pack envelope.');\n    expect(loaded.content.spells.map(({ recordId }) => recordId)).toEqual(['prism-pebble']);\n    expect(loaded.content.diagnostics).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      expect.objectContaining({ reason: TRUE_POLYMORPH_PERMANENCE_REFUSAL, recordId: 'permanent-form' }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ reason: OBJECT_TO_CREATURE_REFUSAL, recordId: 'object-creature' }),\n    ]));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/turn-exhaustion-coordinator.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1732","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator authorizes an initial declared fallback and journals the selected fallback"},{"id":"1733","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator dispatches exactly one proposal correction and accepts its complete proposal"},{"id":"1734","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator marks deterministic controller output auto-resolved after the correction returns no proposal"},{"id":"1735","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator pauses for DM adjudication instead of skipping when the deterministic controller fails"},{"id":"1736","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator reconstructs a browser resume mid-chain without dispatching a second correction"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport {\n  agentSessionId,\n  encounterBranchId,\n  encounterSessionId,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { AgentSessionLifecycle } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-session-lifecycle';\nimport type { RoundTurnProposalEnvelope } from '../../../src/vtt/engine-envelopes';\nimport { engineActionId, engineOptionId } from '../../../src/vtt/turn-proposal';\nimport {\n  createEngineStateCapsule,\n  projectEngineDmProjection,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/engine-state-capsule';\nimport { engineActionRegistry } from '../../../src/vtt/engine-query-port';\nimport { projectDmBoard } from '../../../src/vtt/encounter-projections';\nimport { referenceEncounterSetup } from '../../../src/vtt/reference-encounter';\nimport {\n  EncounterSessionJournal,\n  MemoryBrowserSessionStore,\n  MemoryMirrorSink,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/session-persistence';\nimport {\n  MAX_PROPOSAL_CORRECTIONS,\n  TurnExhaustionCoordinator,\n  type AutoResolvedProposalMark,\n  type DeterministicProposalResolution,\n  type ProposalFallbackResult,\n  type TurnExhaustionCorrectionRuntime,\n  type TurnExhaustionHost,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/turn-exhaustion-coordinator';\nimport { SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter } from '../../fixtures/simulated-agent-session-adapter';\n\nconst INITIAL_COORDINATOR_STATE = {\n  requestSequence: 1,\n  pendingRequest: null,\n  pendingCommand: null,\n  continuation: { kind: 'idle' as const },\n  pause: null,\n};\n\nfunction fixture() {\n  const state = createEncounter(referenceEncounterSetup());\n  const actor = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.kind === 'monster')?.profile.id;\n  if (actor === undefined) throw new Error('Exhaustion fixture needs a monster.');\n  const sessionId = encounterSessionId('session:turn-exhaustion');\n  const branchId = encounterBranchId('branch:turn-exhaustion');\n  const store = new MemoryBrowserSessionStore();\n  const journal = EncounterSessionJournal.create({\n    sessionId,\n    branchId,\n    encounterState: state,\n    coordinatorState: INITIAL_COORDINATOR_STATE,\n    controllers: [],\n    rng: mulberry32(398_399),\n    store,\n    mirror: new MemoryMirrorSink(),\n  });\n  journal.startAgentSession({\n    cli: 'codex',\n    sessionId: agentSessionId('agent-session:turn-exhaustion'),\n    adapterVersion: 4,\n  });\n  const projection = projectDmBoard({\n    view: { audience: 'dm', state },\n    coordinator: INITIAL_COORDINATOR_STATE,\n    controllers: [],\n    history: journal.history(),\n  });\n  const capsule = createEngineStateCapsule({\n    runId: sessionId,\n    branchId,\n    revision: 3,\n    generatedAt: '2026-08-27T18:00:00.000Z',\n    request: {\n      requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n      phase: 'correction',\n      correctionNumber: MAX_PROPOSAL_CORRECTIONS,\n      actors: [actor],\n    },\n    projection: projectEngineDmProjection(projection, engineActionRegistry(state), 1),\n  });\n  return { actor, branchId, capsule, journal, sessionId, state, store };\n}\n\nfunction proposal(\n  f: ReturnType<typeof fixture>,\n  phase: 'initial' | 'correction',\n  selectedBranch: 'primary' | 'fallback',\n  proposalId = `proposal:${phase}`,\n): RoundTurnProposalEnvelope {\n  const primaryOption = {\n    optionId: engineOptionId(`option:${phase}:primary`), actorId: f.actor, revision: f.state.revision,\n    label: 'Dodge',\n    movement: { preference: { willingness: 'none' as const, maximumFeet: 0, opportunityRisk: 'avoid' as const }, engagement: { stance: 'hold_position' as const } },\n    actionSlots: [{ slot: 'main' as const, use: { kind: 'dodge' as const } }], resourceCostLabels: [],\n  };\n  const fallbackOption = selectedBranch === 'fallback'\n    ? { ...primaryOption, optionId: engineOptionId(`option:${phase}:fallback`), label: 'End Turn', actionSlots: [{ slot: 'main' as const, use: { kind: 'end_turn' as const } }] }\n    : null;\n  const selectedOption = fallbackOption ?? primaryOption;\n  const turnProposal = {\n    actorId: f.actor, expectedRevision: f.state.revision, primaryOptionId: primaryOption.optionId,\n    fallbackOptionId: fallbackOption?.optionId ?? null, overrideJustification: null,\n  };\n  return {\n    kind: 'round_turn_proposal',\n    proposalId,\n    runId: f.sessionId,\n    branchId: f.branchId,\n    requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n    expectedRevision: phase === 'initial' ? 2 : f.capsule.revision,\n    stateDigest: f.capsule.digest,\n    stateHandle: 'engine-state:test',\n    phase,\n    idempotencyKey: `idempotency:${phase}:0001`,\n    reactionGuidance: null,\n    resolutions: [{\n      proposal: turnProposal,\n      option: selectedOption,\n      primaryOption,\n      fallbackOption,\n      mechanics: {\n        actorId: f.actor, optionId: selectedOption.optionId, movementCostFeet: 0, path: [],\n        finalPosition: { column: 0, row: 0 },\n        actionSlots: [{ slot: 'main', kind: selectedBranch === 'fallback' ? 'end_turn' : 'dodge', actionId: engineActionId(selectedBranch === 'fallback' ? 'end_turn' : 'dodge'), spellId: null, targetIds: [], objectId: null }],\n      },\n      selectedBranch,\n      resolutionDigest: 'a'.repeat(64),\n      summary: 'The monster dodges.',\n    }],\n  };\n}\n\nfunction runtime(\n  f: ReturnType<typeof fixture>,\n  adapter: SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter,\n  queued: RoundTurnProposalEnvelope[],\n  activated: { value: number },\n): TurnExhaustionCorrectionRuntime {\n  return {\n    capsule: f.capsule,\n    rules: { get: () => null },\n    turnContext: { request: { phase: 'correction', correction_number: 1 } },\n    lifecycle: new AgentSessionLifecycle(f.journal, adapter, 4),\n    invocation: {\n      runId: f.sessionId,\n      prompt: 'must be replaced',\n      model: 'SIMULATED-model',\n      reasoningEffort: 'SIMULATED-effort',\n      launcherToken: 'SIMULATED-launcher-token',\n      timeoutMs: null,\n    },\n    signal: new AbortController().signal,\n    activateCapsule: () => { activated.value += 1; },\n    takeProposal: () => queued.shift() ?? null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction host(input: {\n  readonly authorization?: 'authorized' | 'invalidated' | 'invalid';\n  readonly deterministic?: DeterministicProposalResolution | null;\n  readonly marks?: AutoResolvedProposalMark[];\n  readonly adjudications?: string[];\n} = {}): TurnExhaustionHost {\n  return {\n    authorize: async () => input.authorization ?? 'authorized',\n    resolveDeterministically: async (actorId) => input.deterministic === undefined\n      ? { actorId, expectedRevision: 3, resolutionDigest: 'b'.repeat(64) }\n      : input.deterministic,\n    applyAutoResolved: async (_resolution, mark) => { input.marks?.push(mark); },\n    pauseForDmAdjudication: ({ actorId }) => { input.adjudications?.push(actorId); },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction exhausted(f: ReturnType<typeof fixture>, fallbackResult: ProposalFallbackResult = 'invalid') {\n  return {\n    kind: 'exhausted' as const,\n    requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n    initialProposalId: 'proposal:initial-attempt',\n    actorFailures: [{ actorId: f.actor, fallbackResult }],\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('host turn exhaustion coordinator', () => {\n  it('authorizes an initial declared fallback and journals the selected fallback', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: [] });\n    const coordinator = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    await expect(coordinator.coordinate({\n      initial: { kind: 'proposal', proposal: proposal(f, 'initial', 'fallback') },\n      correction: runtime(f, adapter, [], { value: 0 }),\n      host: host(),\n    })).resolves.toEqual({ kind: 'authorized', proposalId: 'proposal:initial', phase: 'initial' });\n\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations).toHaveLength(0);\n    expect(f.journal.history().map((entry) => entry.transition.kind)).toContain('proposal_fallback_resolved');\n  });\n\n  it('dispatches exactly one proposal correction and accepts its complete proposal', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const queued: RoundTurnProposalEnvelope[] = [];\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({\n      startIds: [],\n      onResume: () => { queued.push(proposal(f, 'correction', 'primary')); },\n    });\n    const activated = { value: 0 };\n    const coordinator = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    await expect(coordinator.coordinate({\n      initial: exhausted(f),\n      correction: runtime(f, adapter, queued, activated),\n      host: host(),\n    })).resolves.toEqual({ kind: 'authorized', proposalId: 'proposal:correction', phase: 'correction' });\n\n    expect(activated.value).toBe(1);\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations[0]?.invocation.prompt).toContain('Correct the complete refused proposal request once.');\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations[0]?.invocation.prompt).toContain('fallback_option_id must be null');\n    expect(f.journal.history().map((entry) => entry.transition.kind)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      'proposal_correction_requested',\n      'agent_session_dispatched',\n      'proposal_correction_resolved',\n    ]));\n  });\n\n  it('marks deterministic controller output auto-resolved after the correction returns no proposal', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: [] });\n    const marks: AutoResolvedProposalMark[] = [];\n    const coordinator = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    await expect(coordinator.coordinate({\n      initial: exhausted(f, 'absent'),\n      correction: runtime(f, adapter, [], { value: 0 }),\n      host: host({ marks }),\n    })).resolves.toEqual({ kind: 'auto_resolved', actorIds: [f.actor] });\n\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(marks).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      actorId: f.actor,\n      fallbackResult: 'absent',\n      correctionResult: 'no_response',\n      controllerResolutionDigest: 'b'.repeat(64),\n    })]);\n    expect(coordinator.reconstruct('request:exhaustion')).toEqual({\n      requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n      stage: 'auto_resolved',\n      correctionNumber: 1,\n      autoResolvedActorIds: [f.actor],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('pauses for DM adjudication instead of skipping when the deterministic controller fails', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const adjudications: string[] = [];\n    const coordinator = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    await expect(coordinator.coordinate({\n      initial: exhausted(f),\n      correction: runtime(f, new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: [] }), [], { value: 0 }),\n      host: host({ deterministic: null, adjudications }),\n    })).resolves.toEqual({ kind: 'awaiting_dm_adjudication', actorId: f.actor });\n\n    expect(adjudications).toEqual([f.actor]);\n    expect(f.journal.history().map((entry) => entry.transition.kind)).toContain('proposal_auto_resolution_failed');\n  });\n\n  it('reconstructs a browser resume mid-chain without dispatching a second correction', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    f.journal.recordHostTransition({\n      kind: 'proposal_correction_requested',\n      requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n      initialProposalId: 'proposal:initial-attempt',\n      correctionNumber: 1,\n      actorFailures: [{ actorId: f.actor, fallbackResult: 'invalid' }],\n    });\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: [] });\n    const marks: AutoResolvedProposalMark[] = [];\n    const resumed = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    expect(resumed.reconstruct('request:exhaustion')?.stage).toBe('correction_requested');\n    await resumed.coordinate({\n      initial: exhausted(f),\n      correction: runtime(f, adapter, [], { value: 0 }),\n      host: host({ marks }),\n    });\n\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations).toHaveLength(0);\n    expect(f.journal.history().filter((entry) =>\n      entry.transition.kind === 'proposal_correction_requested')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(marks).toHaveLength(1);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/controller-assignment.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1737","name":"DM controller assignment assigns an algorithm controller durably and drives its turn without a human prompt"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  ControllerAssignmentError,\n  DmEncounterHost,\n  type DmEncounterHostSnapshot,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-encounter-host';\nimport { REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID } from '../../../src/vtt/reference-encounter';\nimport { MemoryBrowserSessionStore } from '../../../src/vtt/session-persistence';\n\nasync function settle(): Promise<void> {\n  await Promise.resolve();\n  await Promise.resolve();\n}\n\nfunction waitForSnapshot(\n  host: DmEncounterHost,\n  predicate: (snapshot: DmEncounterHostSnapshot) => boolean,\n): Promise<DmEncounterHostSnapshot> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {\n      unsubscribe();\n      reject(new Error('Timed out waiting for the controller assignment outcome.'));\n    }, 1_000);\n    const unsubscribe = host.subscribe((snapshot) => {\n      if (!predicate(snapshot)) return;\n      clearTimeout(timeout);\n      unsubscribe();\n      resolve(snapshot);\n    });\n  });\n}\n\ndescribe('DM controller assignment', () => {\n  it('assigns an algorithm controller durably and drives its turn without a human prompt', async () => {\n    const host = new DmEncounterHost(\n      'session:controller-assignment-algorithm',\n      new MemoryBrowserSessionStore(),\n    );\n\n    void host.start();\n    await settle();\n    expect(host.snapshot().dm.pendingRequest?.actorId).toBe(REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID);\n    expect(() => host.replaceController(REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID, 'algorithm')).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<ControllerAssignmentError>>({\n        name: 'ControllerAssignmentError',\n        code: 'action_boundary_required',\n      }),\n    );\n\n    host.interrupt();\n    await settle();\n    host.replaceController(REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID, 'algorithm');\n\n    expect(host.snapshot().dm.controllers).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      combatantId: REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID,\n      kind: 'algorithm',\n    }));\n\n    const revisionBeforeResume = host.snapshot().dm.encounter.revision;\n    host.resume();\n    const driven = await waitForSnapshot(\n      host,\n      (snapshot) => snapshot.dm.encounter.revision > revisionBeforeResume,\n    );\n\n    expect(driven.dm.pendingRequest?.actorId).not.toBe(REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID);\n    host.close();\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/summons.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1738","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summon_skips_initiative: loads the pack statblock and inserts each upcast summon on the summoner count immediately after them"},{"id":"1739","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summon_count_boundary_and_placement_edge: exact count and 30-foot edge place; one over and an illegal cell refuse atomically"},{"id":"1740","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summon_survives_effect_end and despawn_leaves_corpse: concentration end removes a living summon and a dead summon corpse token"},{"id":"1741","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities despawn_before_active_preserves_turn_identity_and_advances_to_the_next_combatant"},{"id":"1742","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities distinguishing_despawn_vs_death_and_enemy_target: a summon is allied to its summoner, hostile to the enemy, and remains targetable after taking lethal damage"},{"id":"1743","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities unknown_monster_id_summons: rejects only a summon spell whose monster id is absent and loads the rest of the pack"},{"id":"1744","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summon_import_count_boundary: accepts 100 and rejects 101 without dropping healthy monster records"},{"id":"1745","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities on_kill_spawn_refusal: names the excluded on-kill spawning shape instead of treating it as this summon operation"},{"id":"1746","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summoner_controller_seam: the summoned turn is requested from the exact controller that cast the spell"}],"source":"import { readFileSync } from '../../helpers/test-filesystem';\nimport { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { Controller, ControllerDecision, ControllerRequest } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { ControllerRegistry } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport {\n  combatantsAreAllies,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  SUMMON_INITIATIVE_RULE,\n  TargetSelectionRuleError,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { SpellCastCommand } from '../../../src/combat/spells/types';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, type CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { loadContentPack, type LoadedContentPack } from '../../../src/content/content-pack';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ninterface MutablePackFixture {\n  spells: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  monsters: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  [key: string]: unknown;\n}\n\nconst summonOperation = (\n  count: { readonly kind: 'fixed'; readonly count: number } | {\n    readonly kind: 'slot_scaled'; readonly base: number; readonly additionalPerSlot: number;\n  } = { kind: 'fixed', count: 1 },\n) => ({\n  kind: 'summon', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote',\n  count: count.kind === 'fixed' ? count : { ...count, limit: 'exact' },\n  placementRangeFeet: 30,\n  lifecycle: { concentration: true, durationRounds: 10, expiresAt: 'source_start' },\n});\n\nfunction fixture(): MutablePackFixture {\n  return JSON.parse(readFileSync('tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json', 'utf8')) as MutablePackFixture;\n}\n\nfunction packWithOperation(operation: unknown): ReturnType<typeof loadContentPack> {\n  const source = fixture();\n  const template = source.spells[0];\n  if (template === undefined) throw new Error('Summon fixture spell template is missing.');\n  source.spells = [{\n    ...template,\n    recordId: 'call-brassleaf',\n    name: 'Call Brassleaf',\n    level: 2,\n    range: { kind: 'feet', feet: 30 },\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', rounds: 10 },\n    concentration: true,\n    targeting: { kind: 'utility', rangeFeet: 30 },\n    operation,\n  }];\n  return loadContentPack(source);\n}\n\nfunction loadedPack(operation: unknown = summonOperation()): LoadedContentPack {\n  const result = packWithOperation(operation);\n  if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Summon pack refused: ${result.refusal.reason}`);\n  expect(result.content.diagnostics).toEqual([]);\n  return result.content;\n}\n\nfunction summonCommand(\n  caster: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n  destinations: NonNullable<SpellCastCommand['summonDestinations']>,\n  slotLevel = 2,\n): SpellCastCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'cast_spell', actor: caster.id, spellId: 'greenforge:call-brassleaf',\n    slotLevel, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 7, attackBonus: 7, saveDc: 15,\n    spellcastingModifier: 4, targets: [], area: null, summonDestinations: destinations,\n    weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction started(\n  content: LoadedContentPack,\n  spellSlots: readonly { readonly level: 2 | 3; readonly maximum: number }[] = [{ level: 2, maximum: 2 }],\n): { readonly caster: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>; readonly enemy: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>; readonly state: EncounterState } {\n  const caster = playerProfile('summoner', { initiativeBonus: 20, spellSlots });\n  const enemy = monsterProfile('summon-enemy', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [caster, enemy], tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(enemy, 10)],\n    contentPacks: [content],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  return { caster, enemy, state };\n}\n\nfunction summonedId(state: EncounterState): CombatantId {\n  const id = state.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? [])[0];\n  if (id === undefined) throw new Error('Expected an effect-owned summoned combatant.');\n  return id;\n}\n\ndescribe('D348.1 imported summoned entities', () => {\n  it('summon_skips_initiative: loads the pack statblock and inserts each upcast summon on the summoner count immediately after them', () => {\n    // Giant Insect shares the caster's count and acts immediately after them:\n    // docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:3714-3716.\n    expect(SUMMON_INITIATIVE_RULE).toBe('summoner_count_immediately_after');\n    const content = loadedPack(summonOperation({ kind: 'slot_scaled', base: 1, additionalPerSlot: 1 }));\n    const fixtureState = started(content, [{ level: 3, maximum: 1 }]);\n    const cast = reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ], 3), () => 0).state;\n    const summons = cast.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? []);\n\n    expect(summons).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(cast.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([\n      fixtureState.caster.id, ...summons, fixtureState.enemy.id,\n    ]);\n    expect(cast.initiative.slice(0, 3).map((entry) => ({ total: entry.total, slot: entry.slot })))\n      .toEqual([{ total: 21, slot: 0 }, { total: 21, slot: 0 }, { total: 21, slot: 0 }]);\n    for (const id of summons) {\n      const summon = cast.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === id);\n      expect(summon).toMatchObject({\n        hitPoints: 9,\n        profile: {\n          name: 'Brassleaf Mote', statblockId: 'greenforge:brassleaf-mote',\n          rules: { armorClass: 12, speed: 30 },\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('summon_count_boundary_and_placement_edge: exact count and 30-foot edge place; one over and an illegal cell refuse atomically', () => {\n    const content = loadedPack(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 2 }));\n    const fixtureState = started(content);\n    const exact = reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0);\n    expect(exact.state.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? [])).toHaveLength(2);\n\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 }, { column: 4, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0)).toThrow(TargetSelectionRuleError);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 7, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0)).toThrow('summon destination is out of range');\n    expect(fixtureState.state.combatants).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n\n  it('summon_survives_effect_end and despawn_leaves_corpse: concentration end removes a living summon and a dead summon corpse token', () => {\n    const fixtureState = started(loadedPack());\n    const cast = reduceEncounter(\n      fixtureState.state,\n      summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(cast);\n    const dead = reduceEncounter(cast, {\n      type: 'adjudicate', target: summon, subject: 'lethal test damage', reasoning: 'fixture',\n      consequence: { kind: 'hit_point_delta', amount: -9 },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(dead.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)?.life).toBe('dead');\n    expect(dead.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(true);\n    const despawned = reduceEncounter(dead, { type: 'end_concentration', actor: fixtureState.caster.id }, () => 0);\n    expect(despawned.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'summoned_combatant_despawned', combatant: summon,\n    }));\n    expect(despawned.state.combatants.some((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)).toBe(false);\n    expect(despawned.state.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('despawn_before_active_preserves_turn_identity_and_advances_to_the_next_combatant', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('shift-summoner', {\n      initiativeBonus: 20,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 2, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const activeEnemy = monsterProfile('shift-active-enemy', { initiativeBonus: 0, hitPoints: 30 });\n    const nextEnemy = monsterProfile('shift-next-enemy', { initiativeBonus: -10, hitPoints: 30 });\n    let state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [caster, activeEnemy, nextEnemy],\n      tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(activeEnemy, 10), placedToken(nextEnemy, 11)],\n      contentPacks: [loadedPack()],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      summonCommand(caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(state);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: summon }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(activeEnemy.id);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'force_save', actor: activeEnemy.id, target: caster.id,\n      ability: 'dexterity', dc: 30, rollMode: 'normal',\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 1 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n      onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n    }, () => 0).state;\n\n    expect(state.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([\n      caster.id, activeEnemy.id, nextEnemy.id,\n    ]);\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(activeEnemy.id);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: activeEnemy.id }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(nextEnemy.id);\n  });\n\n  it('distinguishing_despawn_vs_death_and_enemy_target: a summon is allied to its summoner, hostile to the enemy, and remains targetable after taking lethal damage', () => {\n    const fixtureState = started(loadedPack());\n    let state = reduceEncounter(\n      fixtureState.state,\n      summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(state);\n    expect(combatantsAreAllies(state, fixtureState.caster.id, summon)).toBe(true);\n    expect(combatantsAreAllies(state, fixtureState.enemy.id, summon)).toBe(false);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixtureState.caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: summon }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack', actor: fixtureState.enemy.id, target: summon, attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal', attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 9 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)?.life).toBe('dead');\n    expect(state.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('unknown_monster_id_summons: rejects only a summon spell whose monster id is absent and loads the rest of the pack', () => {\n    const source = fixture();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    source.spells = [healthy, {\n      ...healthy, recordId: 'missing-summon', name: 'Missing Summon', level: 2,\n      targeting: { kind: 'utility', rangeFeet: 30 },\n      operation: { ...summonOperation(), monsterId: 'absent-monster' },\n    }];\n    const result = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(result.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Record-isolated load unexpectedly refused the pack.');\n    expect(result.content.spells.map((spell) => spell.recordId)).toEqual(['prism-pebble']);\n    expect(result.content.monsters.map((monster) => monster.recordId)).toEqual(['brassleaf-mote']);\n    expect(result.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'missing_monster_reference', recordId: 'missing-summon',\n      monsterId: 'greenforge:absent-monster',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('summon_import_count_boundary: accepts 100 and rejects 101 without dropping healthy monster records', () => {\n    expect(packWithOperation(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 100 })).status).toBe('loaded');\n    const over = packWithOperation(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 101 }));\n    expect(over.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (over.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('One malformed spell should not refuse its pack.');\n    expect(over.content.spells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(over.content.monsters).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(over.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ reason: 'malformed_record' }));\n  });\n\n  it('on_kill_spawn_refusal: names the excluded on-kill spawning shape instead of treating it as this summon operation', () => {\n    const result = packWithOperation({\n      kind: 'on_kill_spawn', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote', trigger: 'creature_killed',\n    });\n    expect(result.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Excluded operation should reject its record only.');\n    expect(result.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'on-kill-spawn-not-modelled', recordId: 'call-brassleaf',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('summoner_controller_seam: the summoned turn is requested from the exact controller that cast the spell', async () => {\n    class RecordingController implements Controller {\n      readonly actors: CombatantId[] = [];\n      choose(request: ControllerRequest): Promise<ControllerDecision> {\n        this.actors.push(request.actorId);\n        const action = request.legalActions.actions[0];\n        if (action === undefined) throw new Error('Recording controller received no legal action.');\n        return Promise.resolve({\n          requestId: request.requestId,\n          encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n          action,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const fixtureState = started(loadedPack());\n    const summonerController = new RecordingController();\n    const enemyController = new RecordingController();\n    const registry = new ControllerRegistry([\n      { combatantId: fixtureState.caster.id, controller: summonerController, controllerId: 'controller:summoner' },\n      { combatantId: fixtureState.enemy.id, controller: enemyController, controllerId: 'controller:enemy' },\n    ]);\n    const cast = summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]);\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(fixtureState.state, registry, () => 0, {\n      turnLegalActions: (state, actor) => ({ actions:\n        actor === fixtureState.caster.id && state.effects.length === 0\n          ? [cast]\n          : [{ type: 'end_turn', actor }],\n      }),\n    });\n\n    expect((await coordinator.step()).kind).toBe('applied');\n    expect((await coordinator.step()).kind).toBe('applied');\n    const summon = summonedId(coordinator.state());\n    expect((await coordinator.step()).kind).toBe('applied');\n    expect(summonerController.actors).toEqual([fixtureState.caster.id, fixtureState.caster.id, summon]);\n    expect(registry.identities().find((identity) => identity.combatantId === summon)?.controllerId)\n      .toBe('controller:summoner');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/wild-shape.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1747","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay derives known-form counts, use counts, rest recovery, and rounded duration from the Druid level tables"},{"id":"1748","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay cr_cap_exact_and_one_step_beyond: accepts CR 1/2 at level 4 and gives the one-step-higher CR 1 refusal a named gate"},{"id":"1749","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay movement_gates_named: refuses a Fly Speed form one level below the level-8 gate"},{"id":"1750","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay allows a CR-eligible Fly Speed form starting at level 8"},{"id":"1751","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay allows a CR-eligible swim-speed form at level 2"},{"id":"1752","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay unknown_form_allowed: refuses a bundled Beast that is not on the character sheet"},{"id":"1753","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay mental_stats_replaced: two physical lenses differ and change attack outcomes while true-form mental scores and spell save DC stay fixed"},{"id":"1754","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay excess_damage_dropped: exact form-pool depletion reverts with zero excess and one point beyond damages the true form by exactly one"},{"id":"1755","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay duration_exact_expiry: remains shaped immediately before its expiry round and reverts at the exact boundary"},{"id":"1756","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay concentration_dropped_on_shift: concentration, conditions, pending decisions, and policies survive shape and duration reversion"},{"id":"1757","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay voluntary reversion is a Bonus Action and all three SRD equipment choices remain explicit"},{"id":"1758","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay death_saves_use_true_form: lethal excess reverts first, then starts the PC true form dying"},{"id":"1759","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay known-form construction includes homebrew families but requires the exact sheet count and unique bundled Beasts"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  effectiveCombatRules,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n  type PendingDecision,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { monsterAttackCommand } from '../../../src/combat/monster-commands';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, effectStackingIdentity, statblockId, type StatblockId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  WildShapeRuleError,\n  createWildShapeCharacterSheet,\n  recoverWildShapeUses,\n  wildShapeDurationRounds,\n  wildShapeForm,\n  wildShapeKnownFormMaximum,\n  wildShapeUseMaximum,\n} from '../../../src/combat/wild-shape';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst WOLF = statblockId('statblock:wolf');\nconst BOAR = statblockId('statblock:boar');\nconst BLACK_BEAR = statblockId('statblock:black-bear');\nconst CROCODILE = statblockId('statblock:crocodile');\nconst DIRE_WOLF = statblockId('statblock:dire-wolf');\nconst BLOOD_HAWK = statblockId('statblock:blood-hawk');\nconst BRUSH_BEAR = statblockId('statblock:homebrew-beast/brush-bear');\nconst THREADLING = statblockId('statblock:homebrew-beast/threadling-weaver');\nconst RIDGE_RUNNER = statblockId('statblock:homebrew-beast/ridge-runner');\nconst REEF_PROWLER = statblockId('statblock:homebrew-beast/reef-prowler');\n\nconst LEVEL_TWO_FORMS = [WOLF, BOAR, BRUSH_BEAR, THREADLING] as const;\nconst LEVEL_FOUR_FORMS = [WOLF, BOAR, BLACK_BEAR, CROCODILE, DIRE_WOLF, BRUSH_BEAR] as const;\nconst LEVEL_EIGHT_FORMS = [\n  WOLF, BOAR, BLACK_BEAR, CROCODILE, DIRE_WOLF, BLOOD_HAWK, BRUSH_BEAR, RIDGE_RUNNER,\n] as const;\n\nfunction druidProfile(\n  key: string,\n  level: 2 | 4 | 7 | 8,\n  knownForms: readonly StatblockId[],\n  hitPoints = 20,\n): Extract<CombatantProfile, { readonly kind: 'player_character' }> {\n  const profile = playerProfile(key, { hitPoints, initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  if (profile.kind !== 'player_character') throw new Error('Druid fixture is not a player character.');\n  return {\n    ...profile,\n    wildShape: createWildShapeCharacterSheet(level, knownForms),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction started(\n  level: 2 | 4 | 7 | 8 = 2,\n  knownForms: readonly StatblockId[] = LEVEL_TWO_FORMS,\n  hitPoints = 20,\n) {\n  const druid = druidProfile('wild-druid', level, knownForms, hitPoints);\n  const enemyBase = monsterProfile('wild-enemy', { hitPoints: 40, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const enemy = { ...enemyBase, rules: { ...enemyBase.rules, sizeCategory: 'Medium' as const } };\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [druid, enemy],\n    tokens: [placedToken(druid, 0), placedToken(enemy, 1)],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  return { druid, enemy, state };\n}\n\nfunction subject(state: EncounterState, profile: CombatantProfile) {\n  const found = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === profile.id);\n  if (found === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing combatant ${profile.id}.`);\n  return found;\n}\n\nfunction shape(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  druid: Extract<CombatantProfile, { readonly kind: 'player_character' }>,\n  formId: StatblockId,\n  equipmentDisposition: 'dropped_at_origin' | 'merged_into_form' | 'worn_if_practical' = 'merged_into_form',\n) {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'assume_wild_shape', actor: druid.id, formId, equipmentDisposition,\n  }, () => 0);\n}\n\nfunction fixedDamage(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  source: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  amount: number,\n) {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'force_save', actor: source.id, target: target.id,\n    ability: 'dexterity', dc: 99, rollMode: 'normal',\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: amount } }],\n      critical: false, responses: [],\n    },\n    onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n  }, () => 0);\n}\n\nfunction firstAttack(formId: StatblockId) {\n  const form = wildShapeForm(formId);\n  if (form === null || form.sourceDetails.actions.kind !== 'present') {\n    throw new Error(`Wild Shape attack fixture ${formId} is missing.`);\n  }\n  const attack = form.sourceDetails.actions.value.find((action) => action.kind === 'attack');\n  if (attack === undefined || attack.kind !== 'attack') throw new Error(`Wild Shape form ${formId} has no attack.`);\n  return attack;\n}\n\ndescribe('2024 Wild Shape overlay', () => {\n  it('derives known-form counts, use counts, rest recovery, and rounded duration from the Druid level tables', () => {\n    // Uses and known forms: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2533-2552,2580-2611.\n    // Duration and general rounding: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2571-2579,320-325.\n    expect(([2, 4, 8] as const).map((level) => wildShapeKnownFormMaximum(level))).toEqual([4, 6, 8]);\n    expect(([2, 6, 17] as const).map((level) => wildShapeUseMaximum(level))).toEqual([2, 3, 4]);\n    expect(wildShapeDurationRounds(5)).toBe(1_200);\n    expect(recoverWildShapeUses({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 3, remaining: 0 }, 'short_rest'))\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 3, remaining: 1 });\n    expect(recoverWildShapeUses({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 3, remaining: 1 }, 'long_rest'))\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 3, remaining: 3 });\n  });\n\n  it('cr_cap_exact_and_one_step_beyond: accepts CR 1/2 at level 4 and gives the one-step-higher CR 1 refusal a named gate', () => {\n    // Beast Shapes thresholds: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2587-2611.\n    const exact = started(4, LEVEL_FOUR_FORMS);\n    expect(subject(shape(exact.state, exact.druid, BLACK_BEAR).state, exact.druid).wildShape?.formId)\n      .toBe(BLACK_BEAR);\n\n    const beyond = started(4, LEVEL_FOUR_FORMS);\n    expect(() => shape(beyond.state, beyond.druid, DIRE_WOLF)).toThrow(WildShapeRuleError);\n    try {\n      shape(beyond.state, beyond.druid, DIRE_WOLF);\n      expect.fail('A CR 1 form unexpectedly crossed the level-4 gate.');\n    } catch (error) {\n      expect(error).toMatchObject({\n        code: 'challenge_rating_gate',\n        gate: { kind: 'challenge_rating', maximum: '1/2', actual: 1 },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('movement_gates_named: refuses a Fly Speed form one level below the level-8 gate', () => {\n    // Fly gate: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2598-2599,2604-2611.\n    const flying = started(7, [WOLF, BOAR, BLACK_BEAR, BLOOD_HAWK, DIRE_WOLF, BRUSH_BEAR]);\n    expect(() => shape(flying.state, flying.druid, BLOOD_HAWK)).toThrowError(expect.objectContaining({\n      code: 'fly_speed_gate', gate: { kind: 'fly_speed', minimumDruidLevel: 8 },\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('allows a CR-eligible Fly Speed form starting at level 8', () => {\n    // Fly permission boundary: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2598-2599,2604-2611.\n    const flying = started(8, LEVEL_EIGHT_FORMS);\n    const result = shape(flying.state, flying.druid, BLOOD_HAWK);\n    expect(subject(result.state, flying.druid).wildShape?.formId).toBe(BLOOD_HAWK);\n  });\n\n  it('allows a CR-eligible swim-speed form at level 2', () => {\n    // The Beast Shapes table gates only Fly Speed: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2604-2611.\n    const swimming = started(2, [WOLF, BOAR, REEF_PROWLER, THREADLING]);\n    const result = shape(swimming.state, swimming.druid, REEF_PROWLER);\n    expect(subject(result.state, swimming.druid).wildShape?.formId).toBe(REEF_PROWLER);\n  });\n\n  it('unknown_form_allowed: refuses a bundled Beast that is not on the character sheet', () => {\n    // The form must be learned: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2571-2576,2587-2594.\n    const fixture = started();\n    expect(() => shape(fixture.state, fixture.druid, RIDGE_RUNNER)).toThrowError(expect.objectContaining({\n      code: 'form_not_known', gate: null,\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('mental_stats_replaced: two physical lenses differ and change attack outcomes while true-form mental scores and spell save DC stay fixed', () => {\n    // Retained mental scores and replaced game statistics: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2619-2634.\n    const wolfFixture = started();\n    const boarFixture = started();\n    const wolfState = shape(wolfFixture.state, wolfFixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const boarState = shape(boarFixture.state, boarFixture.druid, BOAR).state;\n    const trueRules = wolfFixture.druid.rules;\n    const wolfRules = effectiveCombatRules(wolfState, wolfFixture.druid.id);\n    const boarRules = effectiveCombatRules(boarState, boarFixture.druid.id);\n    expect(wolfRules.abilityScores).toMatchObject({ intelligence: 10, wisdom: 18, charisma: 10 });\n    expect(boarRules.abilityScores).toMatchObject({ intelligence: 10, wisdom: 18, charisma: 10 });\n    expect(wolfRules.abilityScores?.strength).not.toBe(boarRules.abilityScores?.strength);\n    const spellSaveDc = (rules: typeof trueRules) => 8 + (rules.proficiencyBonus ?? 0) +\n      Math.floor(((rules.abilityScores?.wisdom ?? 10) - 10) / 2);\n    expect([spellSaveDc(trueRules), spellSaveDc(wolfRules), spellSaveDc(boarRules)]).toEqual([14, 14, 14]);\n\n    const wolfAttack = reduceEncounter(\n      wolfState,\n      monsterAttackCommand(firstAttack(WOLF), wolfFixture.druid.id, wolfFixture.enemy.id),\n      () => 0.35,\n    );\n    const boarAttack = reduceEncounter(\n      boarState,\n      monsterAttackCommand(firstAttack(BOAR), boarFixture.druid.id, boarFixture.enemy.id),\n      () => 0.35,\n    );\n    expect(wolfAttack.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'attack_resolved', attack: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'hit' }),\n    }));\n    expect(boarAttack.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'attack_resolved', attack: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'miss' }),\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('excess_damage_dropped: exact form-pool depletion reverts with zero excess and one point beyond damages the true form by exactly one', () => {\n    const exactFixture = started();\n    const exactShaped = shape(exactFixture.state, exactFixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const exactPool = (subject(exactShaped, exactFixture.druid).wildShape?.physical.hitPoints ?? 0) +\n      subject(exactShaped, exactFixture.druid).temporaryHitPoints;\n    const exact = fixedDamage(exactShaped, exactFixture.druid, exactFixture.druid, exactPool);\n    expect(subject(exact.state, exactFixture.druid).hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(subject(exact.state, exactFixture.druid).wildShape).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(exact.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'wild_shape_reverted', reason: 'form_hit_points_depleted', excessDamage: 0,\n    }));\n\n    const overFixture = started();\n    const overShaped = shape(overFixture.state, overFixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const overPool = (subject(overShaped, overFixture.druid).wildShape?.physical.hitPoints ?? 0) +\n      subject(overShaped, overFixture.druid).temporaryHitPoints;\n    const over =
