monster-side search memory records a successful Hide as the active search-memory cause"},{"id":"1949","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory replays the same seed and command transcript to identical search events"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { canonicalJson } from '../../../src/commands/canonical-json';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, effectStackingIdentity } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst fixedD20 = (face: number) => () => (face - 0.5) / 20;\n\nfunction requiredSearchMemories(state: EncounterState) {\n  if (state.searchMemories === undefined) throw new Error('Expected persisted D420 search memory.');\n  return state.searchMemories;\n}\n\nfunction invisibleSelf(actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>): EncounterCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'apply_effect',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    cost: 'none',\n    effect: {\n      targets: [actor.id],\n      duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n      concentration: false,\n      stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('d420:test-invisible'),\n      stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n      repeatedSave: null,\n      payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Invisible' },\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction invisibleEncounter(): {\n  readonly pc: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>;\n  readonly monster: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n} {\n  const pc = playerProfile('search-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const monster = monsterProfile('searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  let state = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 },\n    combatants: [pc, monster],\n    tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2, 2), placedToken(monster, 0, 2)],\n  });\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, invisibleSelf(pc), fixedD20(10)).state;\n  return { pc, monster, state };\n}\n\nfunction endActiveTurn(state: EncounterState): EncounterState {\n  if (state.activeCombatant === null) throw new Error('The fixture has no active turn.');\n  return reduceEncounter(\n    state,\n    { type: 'end_turn', actor: state.activeCombatant },\n    fixedD20(10),\n  ).state;\n}\n\nfunction damage(amount: number) {\n  return {\n    terms: [{\n      type: damageType('Force'),\n      dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount },\n    }],\n    critical: false,\n    responses: [],\n  } as const;\n}\n\ndescribe('D420 persistent monster-side search memory', () => {\n  it('pins the last-known position when invisibility makes a target unseen', () => {\n    const { pc, monster, state } = invisibleEncounter();\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      policy: 'search-memory-v1',\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'invisibility',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      lostAtRound: 1,\n      lastExpandedRound: 1,\n      expires: { kind: 'start_of_round', round: 4 },\n      suspicion: {\n        kind: 'grid_radius',\n        center: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n        radius: 0,\n        cells: [{ column: 2, row: 2 }],\n      },\n    })]);\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'search_memory_recorded',\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'invisibility',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n    }));\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.legalOptions.map((option) => option.kind)).toEqual([\n      'move_and_search',\n      'ready_action',\n      'attack_suspected_square',\n      'area_effect_over_region',\n    ]);\n    const serialized = JSON.stringify(state);\n    const roundTripped = JSON.parse(serialized) as unknown as EncounterState;\n    expect(JSON.stringify(roundTripped)).toBe(serialized);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(roundTripped)).toEqual(requiredSearchMemories(state));\n  });\n\n  it('expands the suspicion region by hand-computed grid cells each round', () => {\n    let { state } = invisibleEncounter();\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n\n    expect(state.round).toBe(2);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion).toEqual({\n      kind: 'grid_radius',\n      center: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      radius: 5,\n      cells: [\n        { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 3, row: 1 },\n        { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 }, { column: 3, row: 2 },\n        { column: 1, row: 3 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }, { column: 3, row: 3 },\n      ],\n    });\n\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    expect(state.round).toBe(3);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.radius).toBe(10);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.cells).toHaveLength(25);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.cells).toEqual(\n      Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_rowValue, row) =>\n        Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_columnValue, column) => ({ column, row }))).flat(),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('forces unseen-target disadvantage when a monster attacks the occupied suspected square', () => {\n    const fixture = invisibleEncounter();\n    const state = endActiveTurn(fixture.state);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack_suspected_square',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      damage: damage(0),\n    }, fixedD20(10));\n\n    const attack = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved');\n    const suspected = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'suspected_square_attacked');\n    expect(attack?.type === 'attack_resolved' ? attack.attack.roll : null).toEqual({\n      mode: 'disadvantage',\n      faces: [10, 10],\n      chosen: 10,\n    });\n    expect(suspected).toMatchObject({\n      type: 'suspected_square_attacked',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      outcome: 'target_present',\n      roll: { mode: 'disadvantage', faces: [10, 10], chosen: 10 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('automatically misses with disadvantage when the remembered square is empty', () => {\n    const fixture = invisibleEncounter();\n    let state = reduceEncounter(fixture.state, {\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: fixture.pc.id,\n      path: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }],\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack_suspected_square',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      damage: damage(10),\n    }, fixedD20(10));\n\n    expect(result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'suspected_square_attacked')).toMatchObject({\n      type: 'suspected_square_attacked',\n      outcome: 'empty',\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      roll: { mode: 'disadvantage', faces: [10, 10], chosen: 10 },\n    });\n    expect(result.events.some((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied')).toBe(false);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(result.state)[0]?.lastKnownPosition).toEqual({ column: 2, row: 2 });\n  });\n\n  it('clears expired memory at the typed round boundary', () => {\n    let { state } = invisibleEncounter();\n    while (state.round < 4) state = endActiveTurn(state);\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'search_memory_cleared',\n      reason: 'expired',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('records heavy obscurement as a separate unseen transition cause', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('obscured-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('obscurement-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2), placedToken(monster, 0)],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'world_operation',\n      actor: null,\n      cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'set_obscurement',\n        region: { id: 'd420-heavy', cells: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }] },\n        obscurement: 'heavy',\n      },\n    }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'obscurement',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n    })]);\n  });\n\n  it('records a successful Hide as the active search-memory cause', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('hidden-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('hide-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2), placedToken(monster, 0)],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'world_operation',\n      actor: null,\n      cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'set_obscurement',\n        region: { id: 'd420-hide-cover', cells: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }] },\n        obscurement: 'heavy',\n      },\n    }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'hide', actor: pc.id }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'hide_resolved',\n      combatant: pc.id,\n      outcome: 'hidden',\n    }));\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'hiding',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n    })]);\n  });\n\n  it('replays the same seed and command transcript to identical search events', () => {\n    const run = () => {\n      const pc = playerProfile('deterministic-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n      const monster = monsterProfile('deterministic-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n      const rng = mulberry32(0xD420);\n      let state = createEncounter({\n        bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 },\n        combatants: [pc, monster],\n        tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2, 2), placedToken(monster, 0, 2)],\n      });\n      const transcript: readonly EncounterCommand[] = [\n        { type: 'roll_initiative' },\n        invisibleSelf(pc),\n        { type: 'end_turn', actor: pc.id },\n        { type: 'end_turn', actor: monster.id },\n      ];\n      for (const command of transcript) state = reduceEncounter(state, command, rng).state;\n      return state;\n    };\n\n    const first = run();\n    const replayed = run();\n    expect(canonicalJson(replayed.eventLog)).toBe(canonicalJson(first.eventLog));\n    expect(canonicalJson(replayed.searchMemories)).toBe(canonicalJson(first.searchMemories));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/integration/vtt/monster-on-hit.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1950","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer charge_precondition_unmet: offers the declared base attack without its charge rider"},{"id":"1951","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer squeeze_survives_release: bear grapple carries its DC, ticks at target start, and escape ends grapple plus squeeze"},{"id":"1952","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer applies a real raptor Blinded rider only after its declared DC 15 save fails, then expires at target turn end"},{"id":"1953","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer a real spider Web failure restrains, then Venom Bite stacks Piercing and Poison damage with its Poisoned rider"},{"id":"1954","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer rider_applies_on_miss: the same bear, raptor, and spider attacks deal no damage and apply no effects when they miss"},{"id":"1955","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer declared_effect_skipped: a real raises_as_zombie declaration refuses loudly until its lifecycle lands"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { combatToken, monsterCombatantProfile, type CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand, EncounterEvent } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport {\n  monsterAttackCommand,\n  monsterSavingThrowCommand,\n} from '../../../src/combat/monster-commands';\nimport type {\n  MonsterAction,\n  MonsterAttackAction,\n  MonsterSavingThrowAction,\n  MonsterStatblock,\n} from '../../../src/combat/statblock';\nimport {\n  HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER,\n  type HomebrewBeastFamily,\n} from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/homebrew-beast-families';\nimport { STARTER_MONSTER_ROSTER } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/roster';\nimport { regretTurnLegalActions } from '../../../src/vtt/regret/legal-actions';\nimport { playerProfile } from '../../unit/combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction beast(family: HomebrewBeastFamily, challengeRating: 3) {\n  const row = HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER.find((candidate) =>\n    candidate.design.family === family && candidate.design.challengeRating === challengeRating);\n  if (row === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing ${family} CR ${String(challengeRating)} row.`);\n  return row;\n}\n\nfunction actions(statblock: MonsterStatblock): readonly MonsterAction[] {\n  if (statblock.sourceDetails.actions.kind === 'absent') throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no actions.`);\n  return statblock.sourceDetails.actions.value;\n}\n\nfunction attack(statblock: MonsterStatblock, id: string): MonsterAttackAction {\n  const action = actions(statblock).find((candidate): candidate is MonsterAttackAction =>\n    candidate.kind === 'attack' && candidate.id === id);\n  if (action === undefined) throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no attack ${id}.`);\n  return action;\n}\n\nfunction savingThrowAction(statblock: MonsterStatblock, id: string): MonsterSavingThrowAction {\n  const action = actions(statblock).find((candidate): candidate is MonsterSavingThrowAction =>\n    candidate.kind === 'saving_throw' && candidate.id === id);\n  if (action === undefined) throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no saving-throw action ${id}.`);\n  return action;\n}\n\nfunction knownTarget(key: string): CombatantProfile {\n  const target = playerProfile(key, { hitPoints: 250, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  return {\n    ...target,\n    rules: { ...target.rules, sizeCategory: 'Medium', creatureType: 'Humanoid' },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction started(statblock: MonsterStatblock, target = knownTarget('monster-rider-target')): {\n  readonly actor: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly target: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n} {\n  const actor = monsterCombatantProfile(statblock, {\n    combatantId: `combatant:${statblock.id}:on-hit`,\n    tokenId: `token:${statblock.id}:on-hit`,\n  });\n  const created = createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' },\n    bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [actor, target],\n    tokens: [combatToken(actor, { column: 0, row: 0 }), combatToken(target, { column: 1, row: 0 })],\n  });\n  return {\n    actor,\n    target,\n    state: reduceEncounter(created, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction hitPoints(state: EncounterState, target: CombatantProfile): number {\n  const subject = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === target.id);\n  if (subject === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing target ${target.id}.`);\n  return subject.hitPoints;\n}\n\nfunction attackEvent(events: readonly EncounterEvent[]) {\n  const event = events.find((candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'attack_resolved' }> =>\n    candidate.type === 'attack_resolved');\n  if (event === undefined) throw new Error('Attack did not resolve.');\n  return event;\n}\n\ndescribe('monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer', () => {\n  it('charge_precondition_unmet: offers the declared base attack without its charge rider', () => {\n    // Charge applies only after straight movement immediately before the hit:\n    // docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:22805-22809.\n    const row = beast('pterosaur', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('charge-domain-target'));\n    const declared = attack(row.statblock, 'raking-pass');\n    expect(declared.damage).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      trigger: expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'charge', minimumStraightFeet: 20 }),\n    }));\n    expect(declared.onHit).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'condition', condition: 'Prone', trigger: expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'charge' }),\n    }));\n\n    const command = regretTurnLegalActions(subject.state, subject.actor.id).actions.find(\n      (candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> =>\n        candidate.type === 'attack' && candidate.attackId === 'raking-pass',\n    );\n    if (command === undefined) throw new Error('The pterosaur base attack is missing from the legal domain.');\n    expect(command.damage.terms).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toEqual([]);\n\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(attackEvent(hit.events)).toMatchObject({\n      actor: subject.actor.id,\n      target: subject.target.id,\n      damage: expect.objectContaining({ terms: [expect.objectContaining({ type: 'Piercing' })] }),\n    });\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual(\n      expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Prone' }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('squeeze_survives_release: bear grapple carries its DC, ticks at target start, and escape ends grapple plus squeeze', () => {\n    const row = beast('ursine', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('bear-grapple-target'));\n    const command = monsterAttackCommand(\n      attack(row.statblock, 'bear-hug'),\n      subject.actor.id,\n      subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toMatchObject([\n      { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Grappled', escapeDc: 15, duration: 'until_escape' },\n      { kind: 'condition_bound_ongoing_damage', boundCondition: 'Grappled' },\n    ]);\n\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({\n      name: 'Grappled', source: subject.actor.id,\n    });\n    const grapple = hit.state.effects.find((effect) =>\n      effect.payload.kind === 'condition' && effect.payload.condition === 'Grappled');\n    const squeeze = hit.state.effects.find((effect) => effect.payload.kind === 'ongoing_damage');\n    expect(grapple?.escapeCheck).toEqual({ ability: 'strength', skill: 'athletics', dc: 15 });\n    expect(squeeze?.parentEffectId).toBe(grapple?.id);\n\n    const afterHitPoints = hitPoints(hit.state, subject.target);\n    const targetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      hit.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    const squeezeDamage = targetStart.events.find((event) =>\n      event.type === 'damage_applied' && event.target === subject.target.id);\n    expect(squeezeDamage).toMatchObject({ source: subject.actor.id, amount: 7 });\n    expect(hitPoints(targetStart.state, subject.target)).toBe(afterHitPoints - 7);\n\n    if (grapple === undefined) throw new Error('Grapple effect was not created.');\n    const escaped = reduceEncounter(targetStart.state, {\n      type: 'roll_ability_check',\n      actor: subject.target.id,\n      ability: 'strength',\n      skill: 'athletics',\n      bonus: 100,\n      dc: 15,\n      rollMode: 'normal',\n      cost: 'action',\n      escapeEffectId: grapple.id,\n    }, () => 0);\n    expect(escaped.state.effects.some((effect) =>\n      effect.id === grapple.id || effect.parentEffectId === grapple.id)).toBe(false);\n    expect(combatantConditions(escaped.state, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual(\n      expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Grappled' }),\n    );\n\n    const afterEscapeHitPoints = hitPoints(escaped.state, subject.target);\n    const nextBearTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      escaped.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const nextTargetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      nextBearTurn,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    expect(hitPoints(nextTargetStart.state, subject.target)).toBe(afterEscapeHitPoints);\n    expect(nextTargetStart.events.some((event) =>\n      event.type === 'damage_applied' && event.target === subject.target.id)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('applies a real raptor Blinded rider only after its declared DC 15 save fails, then expires at target turn end', () => {\n    const row = beast('raptor', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('blinded-rider-target'));\n    const command = monsterAttackCommand(\n      attack(row.statblock, 'talon-rake'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'condition', condition: 'Blinded',\n      savingThrow: { ability: 'constitution', dc: 15 },\n      duration: 'until_end_of_target_next_turn',\n    }));\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(hit.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'save_resolved', target: subject.target.id,\n      ability: 'constitution', dc: 15,\n      save: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'failure' }),\n    }));\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n\n    const targetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      hit.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(targetStart, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n    const targetEnd = reduceEncounter(\n      targetStart, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(targetEnd, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n  });\n\n  it('a real spider Web failure restrains, then Venom Bite stacks Piercing and Poison damage with its Poisoned rider', () => {\n    const row = beast('arachnid', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('spider-rider-target'));\n    const web = monsterSavingThrowCommand(\n      savingThrowAction(row.statblock, 'web'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(web.monsterFailureEffects).toMatchObject([\n      { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Restrained', escapeDc: 15, duration: 'until_escape' },\n    ]);\n    const webbed = reduceEncounter(subject.state, web, () => 0);\n    expect(webbed.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'save_resolved', dc: 15, save: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'failure' }),\n    }));\n    expect(combatantConditions(webbed.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Restrained' });\n\n    const targetTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      webbed.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const nextSpiderTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      targetTurn, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const beforeBite = hitPoints(nextSpiderTurn, subject.target);\n    const bitten = reduceEncounter(\n      nextSpiderTurn,\n      monsterAttackCommand(attack(row.statblock, 'venom-bite'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    const resolved = attackEvent(bitten.events);\n    expect(resolved.damage?.terms.map((term) => term.type)).toEqual(['Piercing', 'Poison']);\n    expect(hitPoints(bitten.state, subject.target)).toBe(beforeBite - (resolved.damage?.total ?? 0));\n    expect(combatantConditions(bitten.state, subject.target.id)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      { name: 'Restrained' }, { name: 'Poisoned' },\n    ]));\n  });\n\n  it('rider_applies_on_miss: the same bear, raptor, and spider attacks deal no damage and apply no effects when they miss', () => {\n    for (const [family, actionId] of [\n      ['ursine', 'bear-hug'],\n      ['raptor', 'talon-rake'],\n      ['arachnid', 'venom-bite'],\n    ] as const) {\n      const row = beast(family, 3);\n      const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget(`${family}-miss-target`));\n      const before = hitPoints(subject.state, subject.target);\n      const missed = reduceEncounter(\n        subject.state,\n        monsterAttackCommand(attack(row.statblock, actionId), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n        () => 0,\n      );\n      expect(attackEvent(missed.events).attack.outcome, family).toBe('miss');\n      expect(hitPoints(missed.state, subject.target), family).toBe(before);\n      expect(missed.state.effects, family).toEqual([]);\n      expect(combatantConditions(missed.state, subject.target.id), family).toEqual([]);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('declared_effect_skipped: a real raises_as_zombie declaration refuses loudly until its lifecycle lands', () => {\n    const row = STARTER_MONSTER_ROSTER.find((candidate) => candidate.id === 'statblock:wight');\n    if (row === undefined) throw new Error('Missing Wight row.');\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('zombie-raise-target'));\n    const lifeDrain = savingThrowAction(row.statblock, 'life-drain');\n    expect(lifeDrain.failure.effects.map((effect) => effect.kind)).toEqual([\n      'hit_point_maximum_reduction', 'raises_as_zombie',\n    ]);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(\n      subject.state,\n      monsterSavingThrowCommand(lifeDrain, subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n      () => 0,\n    )).toThrow('raises_as_zombie monster effect has no landed delayed out-of-combat lifecycle');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/stable-dom-render.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1956","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps a pending tray option connected and clickable across live publishes"},{"id":"1957","name":"stable VTT control rendering does not orphan a pressed tray option when a preview rerenders before click"},{"id":"1958","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps controller controls connected while adding a deferred roster member"},{"id":"1959","name":"stable VTT control rendering timeline_rewind_control_replaced: keeps the live rewind button connected while the timeline republishes"},{"id":"1960","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps the encounter pause acknowledgement connected while its state changes"},{"id":"1961","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps a boundary-refusal surface connected while its message republishes"},{"id":"1962","name":"stable VTT control rendering rejects a keyed control whose unkeyed wrapper would still replace it"},{"id":"1963","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps every short-rest control connected through its keyed form and labels"},{"id":"1964","name":"stable VTT control rendering rejects colliding logical identities before mutating the live tree"},{"id":"1965","name":"stable VTT control rendering encodes every key segment and reports the rejected identity verbatim"},{"id":"1966","name":"stable VTT control rendering uses native attribute names when available and synchronizes additions, changes, and removals"},{"id":"1967","name":"stable VTT control rendering ignores non-string fallback attribute keys"},{"id":"1968","name":"stable VTT control rendering treats an unavailable fallback attribute collection as empty"},{"id":"1969","name":"stable VTT control rendering copies mutable state only when that property exists on both relevant controls"},{"id":"1970","name":"stable VTT control rendering ignores child-shaped non-elements instead of trying to reconcile them"},{"id":"1971","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed button as interactive"},{"id":"1972","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed input as interactive"},{"id":"1973","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed select as interactive"},{"id":"1974","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed textarea as interactive"},{"id":"1975","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed summary as interactive"},{"id":"1976","name":"stable VTT control rendering distinguishes linked anchors and tabindex controls from inert lookalikes"},{"id":"1977","name":"stable VTT control rendering reports a duplicate in the live tree before applying the draft"},{"id":"1978","name":"stable VTT control rendering reorders retained nodes, inserts a new node, and removes stale and tag-mismatched nodes"},{"id":"1979","name":"stable VTT control rendering removes a trailing stale node that never occupies a desired index"}],"source":"import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  StableInteractivePathError,\n  StableRenderKeyCollisionError,\n  StableRenderKeyFormatError,\n  reconcileStableRenderedChildren,\n  stableRenderKey,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/stable-dom-render';\nimport {\n  installInteractiveDocument,\n  interactiveElement,\n} from '../../fixtures/interactive-dom';\n\ndescribe('stable VTT control rendering', () => {\n  let restoreDocument: () => void;\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => restoreDocument());\n\n  it('keeps a pending tray option connected and clickable across live publishes', () => {\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const liveTray = document.createElement('section');\n    liveTray.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray');\n    const liveRow = document.createElement('article');\n    liveRow.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7');\n    const liveButton = document.createElement('button');\n    liveButton.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey(\n      'dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7', 'option', 'accept',\n    );\n    const clicked = vi.fn();\n    liveButton.addEventListener('click', clicked);\n    liveRow.append(liveButton);\n    liveTray.append(liveRow);\n    live.append(liveTray);\n    document.body.append(live);\n\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const nextTray = document.createElement('section');\n    nextTray.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray');\n    const nextRow = document.createElement('article');\n    nextRow.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7');\n    const nextButton = document.createElement('button');\n    nextButton.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey(\n      'dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7', 'option', 'accept',\n    );\n    nextButton.textContent = 'Make Opportunity Attack for Vane Spear';\n    nextRow.append(nextButton);\n    nextTray.append(nextRow);\n    draft.append(nextTray);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    const rendered = interactiveElement(live).querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey(\n        'dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7', 'option', 'accept',\n      )}\"]`,\n    );\n    expect(rendered).toBe(interactiveElement(liveButton));\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveButton).isConnected).toBe(true);\n    interactiveElement(liveButton).click();\n    expect(clicked).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n  });\n\n  it('does not orphan a pressed tray option when a preview rerenders before click', () => {\n    const tray = (button: HTMLElement): HTMLElement => {\n      const section = document.createElement('section');\n      section.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'pending-request');\n      section.append(button);\n      return section;\n    };\n    const actionKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'pending-request', 'turn-7', 'move-4-3');\n    const clicked = vi.fn();\n    const liveButton = document.createElement('button');\n    liveButton.dataset.renderKey = actionKey;\n    liveButton.addEventListener('click', clicked);\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const liveBoard = document.createElement('div');\n const pressedTarget = interactiveElement(liveButton);\n    const remove = pressedTarget.remove.bind(pressedTarget);\n    vi.spyOn(pressedTarget, 'remove').mockImplementation(() => {\n      if expect(clicked).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n  });\n\n  it('keeps controller controls connected while adding a deferred roster member', () => {\n    const assignment = (\n      combatantId: string,\n expect(interactiveElement(liveStatus).textContent).toBe('Encounter running');\n  });\n\n  it('keeps a boundary-refusal surface connected while its message republishes', () => {\n    const refusal = });\n\n  it('encodes every key segment and reports the rejected identity verbatim', () => {\n    expect(stableRenderKey('dm controls', 'turn/7', 'option:accept')).toBe(\n name: 'StableRenderKeyFormatError',\n        code: 'invalid_stable_render_key',\n        key: 'dm::accept',\n        message: 'Stable render key dm::accept must contain a namespace and logical malformed.dataset.renderKey = 'missing-namespace';\n    draft.append(malformed);\n    expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableRenderKeyFormatError>>({\n        key: 'missing-namespace',\n      }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('uses native attribute names when available and synchronizes ): Map<string, string> => {\n      const values = new Map(Object.entries(initial));\n      Object.defineProperty(element, 'attributes', { configurable: true, value: {} });\n      Reflect.set(element, value: string) => values.set(name, value));\n      Reflect.set(element, 'removeAttribute', (name: string) => {\n        removed.push(name);\n        values.delete(name);\n      });\n      return );\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('distinguishes linked anchors and tabindex controls from inert lookalikes', () => {\n    const reconcileOne = (element: HTMLElement): void => {\n      const live = hrefDiv.setAttribute('href', '/not-a-link');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(hrefDiv)).not.toThrow();\n    const tabStop = document.createElement('div');\n    tabStop.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');\n element.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', identity);\n      return element;\n    };\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const first = keyed('div', 'first');\n    const expect(insertBefore).toHaveBeenCalledWith(interactiveElement(inserted), null);\n  });\n\n  it('removes a trailing stale node that never occupies a desired index', () => {\n    const key = syntheticSpellPage } from '../../fixtures/scrape/synthetic-pages';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ninterface SyntheticSpellInput {\n  readonly title: string;\n  readonly descriptor: string;\n  readonly castingTime: string;\n  readonly range: string;\n  readonly components: string;\n  readonly duration: string;\n  readonly body: readonly string[];\n  readonly tags: readonly string[];\n}\n\nconst ATTACK_DESCRIPTION =\n  'Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within range. On a hit, that creature takes 2d6 Fire damage.';\nconst SAVE_DESCRIPTION =\n  'One creature within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, that creature takes 3d4 Thunder damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.';\n\nfunction syntheticInput(overrides: Partial<SyntheticSpellInput> = {}): SyntheticSpellInput {\n  return {\n    title: 'Ember Needle',\n    descriptor: 'Level 1 Evocation (Wizard)',\n    castingTime: 'Action',\n    range: '60 feet',\n    components: 'V, S',\n    duration: 'Instantaneous',\n    body: [ATTACK_DESCRIPTION],\n    tags: ['evocation', 'wizard'],\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction parsedPage(overrides: Partial<SyntheticSpellInput> = {}): BuiltPage {\n  const input = syntheticInput(overrides);\n  const parsed = parseSpellPage(syntheticSpellPage({\n    ...input,\n    source: \"Cartographer's Almanac\",\n  }), { edition: '2024', slug: `spell:${input.title.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-')}` });\n  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(parsed.reason);\n  return {\n    url: `http://example.invalid/spell:${input.title.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-')}`,\n    record: parsed.value.record,\n    description: parsed.value.description,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction expectReason(page: BuiltPage, reason: ContentPackUnemittedReason): void {\n  expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(page.record, page.description)).toEqual({\n    status: 'unemitted',\n    reason,\n  });\n}\n\nconst ATTACK_PAGE = parsedPage();\nconst SAVE_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Hollow Pulse',\n  descriptor: 'Level 2 Evocation (Cleric)',\n  body: [SAVE_DESCRIPTION],\n  tags: ['cleric', 'evocation'],\n});\nconst AMBIGUOUS_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Barbed Ember Needle',\n  body: [`${ATTACK_DESCRIPTION} The target also glows until dawn.`],\n});\nconst UNMAPPED_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Quiet Compass',\n  descriptor: 'Level 1 Divination (Wizard)',\n  body: ['A tiny invented compass points toward the last doorway you touched.'],\n  tags: ['divination', 'wizard'],\n});\nconst OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Patient Ember Needle',\n  castingTime: '1 minute',\n});\nconst SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET = [\n  ATTACK_PAGE,\n  SAVE_PAGE,\n  AMBIGUOUS_PAGE,\n  UNMAPPED_PAGE,\n  OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE,\n] as const;\n\nfunction doneQueue(\n  pages: readonly BuiltPage[],\n  extraUrls: readonly string[] = [],\n): QueueItem[] {\n  return [...pages.map((page) => page.url), ...extraUrls].map((url) => ({\n    url,\n    lastmod: null,\n    state: 'done',\n    reason: null,\n  }));\n}\n\ndescribe('scraper content-pack emission', () => {\n  it('reports every synthetic page as emitted or unemitted with one reason enum', () => {\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({\n      pages: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n      queue: doneQueue(SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET),\n      parseFailures: [],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    });\n\n    expect(output.report).toEqual({\n      provenance: SCRAPE_SENTINEL,\n      pagesSeen: 5,\n      partial: false,\n      skippedQueueItems: [],\n      emitted: 2,\n      unemitted: 3,\n      unemittedByReason: {\n        'ambiguous-parameters': 1,\n        'out-of-combat': 1,\n        'parse-failure': 0,\n        'unmapped-vocabulary': 1,\n      },\n      unemittedPages: [\n        {\n          url: AMBIGUOUS_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: AMBIGUOUS_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'ambiguous-parameters',\n        },\n        {\n          url: UNMAPPED_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: UNMAPPED_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'unmapped-vocabulary',\n        },\n        {\n          url: OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'out-of-combat',\n        },\n      ].sort((left, right) => left.url.localeCompare(right.url)),\n    });\n    expect(loadContentPackBytes(output.packBytes).status).toBe('loaded');\n    expect(output.pack.namespaces).toEqual(['scraped.wikidot']);\n    expect(output.packBytes).toContain(SCRAPE_SENTINEL);\n  });\n\n  it('is byte-identical across repeated builds and independent of input order', () => {\n    const input = {\n      pages: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n      queue: doneQueue(\n        SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n        ['http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished'],\n      ),\n      parseFailures: [{ url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished', reason: 'synthetic parse miss' }],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    } as const;\n    const first = buildContentPackDocuments(input);\n    const second = buildContentPackDocuments(input);\n    const reversed = buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, pages: [...input.pages].reverse() });\n\n    expect(second.packBytes).toBe(first.packBytes);\n    expect(second.reportBytes).toBe(first.reportBytes);\n    expect(reversed.packBytes).toBe(first.packBytes);\n    expect(reversed.reportBytes).toBe(first.reportBytes);\n    expect(first.report.unemittedByReason['parse-failure']).toBe(1);\n    expect(first.report.unemittedPages).toContainEqual({\n      url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished',\n      recordId: null,\n      reason: 'parse-failure',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('partial_emission_silent: refuses pending work and reports it when partial emission is explicit', () => {\n    const pending: QueueItem = {\n      url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:not-fetched',\n      lastmod: null,\n      state: 'pending',\n      reason: 'awaiting fetch',\n    };\n    const input = {\n      pages: [ATTACK_PAGE],\n      queue: [...doneQueue([ATTACK_PAGE]), pending],\n      parseFailures: [],\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    } as const;\n\n    expect(() => buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, allowPartial: false }))\n      .toThrow(/pending\\s+http:\\/\\/example\\.invalid\\/spell:not-fetched/u);\n\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, allowPartial: true });\n    expect(output.report.partial).toBe(true);\n    expect(output.report.skippedQueueItems).toEqual([{\n      url: pending.url,\n      state: 'pending',\n      reason: 'awaiting fetch',\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('roundtrip_not_executed: imports and executes an emitted operation in an encounter', () => {\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({\n      pages: [ATTACK_PAGE],\n      queue: doneQueue([ATTACK_PAGE]),\n      parseFailures: [],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    });\n    const loaded = loadContentPackBytes(output.packBytes);\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(loaded.refusal.reason);\n\n    const caster = playerProfile('scrape-pack-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 20,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('scrape-pack-target', {\n      initiativeBonus: -20,\n      hitPoints: 20,\n    });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [caster, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(target, 1)],\n      contentPacks: [loaded.content],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'cast_spell',\n      actor: caster.id,\n      spellId: 'scraped.wikidot:scraped-ember-needle',\n      slotLevel: 1,\n      castAsRitual: false,\n      casterLevel: 3,\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      saveDc: 13,\n      spellcastingModifier: 3,\n      targets: [target.id],\n      area: null,\n      weaponAttack: null,\n      selectedOption: null,\n    }, () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(result.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'spell_cast',\n      spellId: 'scraped.wikidot:scraped-ember-needle',\n    }));\n    expect(result.state.combatants.find(({ profile }) => profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(12);\n  });\n\n  it('approximate_mapping_accepted: refuses an otherwise exact operation with one extra rider clause', () => {\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: `${ATTACK_PAGE.description} The target also glows until dawn.` },\n      'ambiguous-parameters',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('refusal_reason_collapsed: preserves each specific refusal reason', () => {\n    const ambiguous = { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: `${ATTACK_PAGE.description} It also moves.` };\n    const unmapped = { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: 'A harmless invented marker appears nearby.' };\n    const outOfCombat = {\n      ...ATTACK_PAGE,\n      record: { ...ATTACK_PAGE.record, castingTime: '1 minute' },\n    };\n    expectReason(ambiguous, 'ambiguous-parameters');\n    expectReason(unmapped, 'unmapped-vocabulary');\n    expectReason(outOfCombat, 'out-of-combat');\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['casting time', { castingTime: '1 minute' }, 'out-of-combat'],\n    ['unknown casting vocabulary', { castingTime: 'Swift Action' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['material consumption', { components: 'V, S, M (an invented copper spiral)' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['unknown component', { components: 'V, X' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['duplicate component', { components: 'V, V' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['empty components', { components: '' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['unstructured range', { range: 'about 60 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['pluralized one-foot range', { range: '1 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['non-instantaneous duration', { duration: '1 round' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['concentration', { concentration: true }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing casting time', { castingTime: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing range', { range: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing components', { components: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing duration', { duration: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['invalid record id', { identityKey: 'Not An Identifier' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n  ] as const)(\n    'distinguishing metadata input: %s differs only in the deciding field',\n    (_label, change, reason) => {\n      expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n      expectReason({ ...ATTACK_PAGE, record: { ...ATTACK_PAGE.record, ...change } }, reason);\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('distinguishes attack and save vocabulary from unknown or incomplete vocabulary', () => {\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(SAVE_PAGE.record, SAVE_PAGE.description)).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'emitted',\n      spell: { operation: { kind: 'save_damage', ability: 'dexterity', onSuccess: 'half' } },\n    });\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: ATTACK_PAGE.description.replace('Fire damage', 'Dream damage') },\n      'unmapped-vocabulary',\n    );\n    expectReason(\n      { ...SAVE_PAGE, description: SAVE_PAGE.description.replace('Dexterity', 'Luck') },\n      'unmapped-vocabulary',\n    );\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: ATTACK_PAGE.description.replace('On a hit,', 'Later,') },\n      'ambiguous-parameters',\n    );\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: 'A harmless invented marker appears nearby.' },\n      'unmapped-vocabulary',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['range minimum below', { range: '0 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['range minimum at', { range: '1 foot' }, 'emitted'],\n    ['range maximum at', { range: '100000 feet' }, 'emitted'],\n    ['range maximum above', { range: '100001 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['level minimum below', { level: 0 }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['level minimum at', { level: 1 }, 'emitted'],\n    ['level maximum at', { level: 9 }, 'emitted'],\n    ['level maximum above', { level: 10 }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n  ] as const)('numeric metadata boundary: %s', (_label, change, expected) => {\n    const result = mapParsedSpellToContentPack(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE.record, ...change },\n      ATTACK_PAGE.description,\n    );\n    if (expected === 'emitted') {\n      expect(result.status).toBe('emitted');\n    } else {\n      expect(result).toEqual({ status: 'unemitted', reason: expected });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['dice count minimum below', '0d6', 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['dice count minimum at', '1d6', 'emitted'],\n    ['dice count maximum at', '100d6', 'emitted'],\n    ['dice count maximum above', '101d6', 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['die sides minimum below', '2d1', 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['die sides minimum at', '2d2', 'emitted'],\n    ['die sides maximum at', '2d100', 'emitted'],\n    ['die sides maximum above', '2d101', 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n  ] as const)('numeric operation boundary: %s', (_label, dice, expected) => {\n    const description = ATTACK_PAGE.description.replace('2d6', dice);\n    const result = mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, description);\n    if (expected === 'emitted') {\n      expect(result.status).toBe('emitted');\n    } else {\n      expect(result).toEqual({ status: 'unemitted', reason: expected });\n    }\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/recovery-capability.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2018","name":"recovery-capability-v1 proves an in-range loaded healer with a remaining slot before the dying target turn"},{"id":"2019","name":"recovery-capability-v1 qualifies Cure Wounds by available movement when it starts out of range"},{"id":"2020","name":"recovery-capability-v1 does not treat healing as revival for a dead target"},{"id":"2021","name":"recovery-capability-v1 returns a typed unresolved result when the loaded party is unavailable"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { combatToken } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { projectEncounterTimeline, type TimelineBoundary } from '../../../src/vtt/session-timeline';\nimport {\n  loadExternalPartyPack,\n  type LoadedPartyMember,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/party-pack';\nimport {\n  recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary,\n  RECOVERY_CAPABILITY_POLICY,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/intel/recovery-capability';\n\nfunction loadedParty(spells: readonly string[]): readonly LoadedPartyMember[] {\n  const loaded = loadExternalPartyPack({\n    schemaVersion: 2,\n    partyId: 'party:recovery-capability',\n    allowPartial: false,\n    members: [\n      {\n        combatantId: 'combatant:recovery-healer',\n        tokenId: 'token:recovery-healer',\n        characterId: 1,\n        classes: [{ classId: 'Cleric', level: 5 }],\n        abilities: { strength: 10, dexterity: 10, constitution: 14, intelligence: 10, wisdom: 16, charisma: 10 },\n        armorClass: 16,\n        hitPointMaximum: 35,\n        sizeCategory: 'Medium',\n        walkingSpeedFeet: 30,\n        initiativeBonus: 10,\n        savingThrowBonuses: { strength: 0, dexterity: 0, constitution: 2, intelligence: 0, wisdom: 5, charisma: 0 },\n        attacksPerAction: 1,\n        attacks: [{\n          attackId: 'attack:recovery-healer', kind: 'melee', attackBonus: 5, criticalFloor: 20,\n          reachFeet: 5, rangeFeet: 5,\n          damage: [{ damageTypeId: 'Bludgeoning', count: 1, sides: 6, modifier: 2 }],\n        }],\n        startingConditions: [],\n        spellcasting: [{\n          ability: 'wisdom', spellSaveDc: 13, spellAttackBonus: 5,\n          preparedSpellIds: spells,\n          knownSpellIds: [],\n        }],\n        sharedSpellSlots: [\n          { level: 1, count: 2, recharge: 'long_rest' },\n          { level: 3, count: 1, recharge: 'long_rest' },\n        ],\n      },\n      {\n        combatantId: 'combatant:recovery-target',\n        tokenId: 'token:recovery-target',\n        characterId: 2,\n        classes: [{ classId: 'Fighter', level: 5 }],\n        abilities: { strength: 16, dexterity: 10, constitution: 14, intelligence: 10, wisdom: 10, charisma: 10 },\n        armorClass: 16,\n        hitPointMaximum: 44,\n        sizeCategory: 'Medium',\n        walkingSpeedFeet: 30,\n        initiativeBonus: 0,\n        savingThrowBonuses: { strength: 5, dexterity: 0, constitution: 2, intelligence: 0, wisdom: 0, charisma: 0 },\n        attacksPerAction: 2,\n        attacks: [{\n          attackId: 'attack:recovery-target', kind: 'melee', attackBonus: 5, criticalFloor: 20,\n          reachFeet: 5, rangeFeet: 5,\n          damage: [{ damageTypeId: 'Slashing', count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 3 }],\n        }],\n        startingConditions: [],\n      },\n      {\n        combatantId: 'combatant:recovery-observer',\n        tokenId: 'token:recovery-observer',\n        characterId: 3,\n        classes: [{ classId: 'Rogue', level: 5 }],\n        abilities: { strength: 10, dexterity: 16, constitution: 12, intelligence: 10, wisdom: 10, charisma: 10 },\n        armorClass: 14,\n        hitPointMaximum: 32,\n        sizeCategory: 'Medium',\n        walkingSpeedFeet: 30,\n        initiativeBonus: -1,\n        savingThrowBonuses: { strength: 0, dexterity: 5, constitution: 1, intelligence: 0, wisdom: 0, charisma: 0 },\n        attacksPerAction: 1,\n        attacks: [{\n          attackId: 'attack:recovery-observer', kind: 'melee', attackBonus: 5, criticalFloor: 20,\n          reachFeet: 5, rangeFeet: 5,\n          damage: [{ damageTypeId: 'Piercing', count: 1, sides: 6, modifier: 3 }],\n        }],\n        startingConditions: [],\n      },\n    ],\n  });\n  expect(loaded.status).toBe('loaded');\n  if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Party refused: ${loaded.refusal.reason}`);\n  return loaded.party.members;\n}\n\nfunction encounter(\n  members: readonly LoadedPartyMember[],\n  targetColumn: number,\n  life: 'dying' | 'dead' = 'dying',\n): EncounterState {\n  const healer = members[0];\n  const target = members[1];\n  if (healer === undefined || target === undefined) throw new Error('Fixture party is incomplete.');\n  const started = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 20, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [healer.profile, target.profile],\n    tokens: [\n      combatToken(healer.profile, { column: 0, row: 0 }),\n      combatToken(target.profile, { column: targetColumn, row: 0 }),\n    ],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n  return {\n    ...started,\n    combatants: started.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n      combatant.profile.id !== target.profile.id\n        ? combatant\n        : {\n            ...combatant,\n            hitPoints: 0,\n            life,\n            deathSaves: life === 'dying' ? { successes: 0, failures: 1 } : null,\n            deathAt: life === 'dead' ? { round: 1, initiativeIndex: 1 } : null,\n          }),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction targetStart(state: EncounterState, target: LoadedPartyMember): TimelineBoundary {\n  return { round: 1, combatant: target.profile.id, boundary: 'start' };\n}\n\ndescribe('recovery-capability-v1', () => {\n  it('proves an in-range loaded healer with a remaining slot before the dying target turn', () => {\n    const members = loadedParty(['healing-word']);\n    const target = members[1];\n    if (target === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const state = encounter(members, 6);\n    const result = recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      state, projectEncounterTimeline(state, []), members, target.profile.id, targetStart(state, target),\n    );\n\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ policy: RECOVERY_CAPABILITY_POLICY, status: 'resolved' });\n    if (result.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected recovery capability to resolve.');\n    expect(result.known_recovery_before_boundary.options).toEqual([{\n      rescuer: members[0]?.profile.id,\n      spellId: 'healing-word',\n      kind: 'healing',\n      slotLevel: 1,\n      castingTime: 'bonus_action',\n      turnRound: 1,\n      reach: 'in_range',\n      movementFeet: 0,\n      knowledge: 'dm_omniscient_party_resources',\n      source: 'encounter_state_and_loaded_party',\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('qualifies Cure Wounds by available movement when it starts out of range', () => {\n    const members = loadedParty(['cure-wounds']);\n    const target = members[1];\n    if (target === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const state = encounter(members, 7);\n    const result = recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      state, projectEncounterTimeline(state, []), members, target.profile.id, targetStart(state, target),\n    );\n\n    if (result.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected recovery capability to resolve.');\n    expect(result.known_recovery_before_boundary.options).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(result.known_recovery_before_boundary.options[0]).toMatchObject({\n      spellId: 'cure-wounds', reach: 'movement_qualified', movementFeet: 30, castingTime: 'action',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('does not treat healing as revival for a dead target', () => {\n    const healingOnlyMembers = loadedParty(['healing-word']);\n    const healingOnlyTarget = healingOnlyMembers[1];\n    if (healingOnlyTarget === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const healingOnlyState = encounter(healingOnlyMembers, 1, 'dead');\n    const healingOnly = recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      healingOnlyState,\n      projectEncounterTimeline(healingOnlyState, []),\n      healingOnlyMembers,\n      healingOnlyTarget.profile.id,\n      targetStart(healingOnlyState, healingOnlyTarget),\n    );\n    if (healingOnly.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected recovery capability to resolve.');\n    expect(healingOnly.known_recovery_before_boundary.options).toEqual([]);\n\n    const revivalMembers = loadedParty(['healing-word', 'revivify']);\n    const revivalTarget = revivalMembers[1];\n    if (revivalTarget === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const revivalState = encounter(revivalMembers, 1, 'dead');\n    const revival = recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      revivalState, projectEncounterTimeline(revivalState, []), revivalMembers,\n      revivalTarget.profile.id, targetStart(revivalState, revivalTarget),\n    );\n    if (revival.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected recovery capability to resolve.');\n    expect(revival.known_recovery_before_boundary.options).toMatchObject([{\n      spellId: 'revivify', kind: 'revival', slotLevel: 3,\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('returns a typed unresolved result when the loaded party is unavailable', () => {\n    const members = loadedParty(['healing-word']);\n    const target = members[1];\n    if (target === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const state = encounter(members, 1);\n\n    expect(recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      state, projectEncounterTimeline(state, []), null, target.profile.id, targetStart(state, target),\n    )).toEqual({\n      policy: RECOVERY_CAPABILITY_POLICY,\n      status: 'unresolved',\n      reason: 'party_data_unavailable',\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/spells-ranking-r9.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2022","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster pins Divine Favor as a one-minute non-concentration 1d4 Radiant rider"},{"id":"2023","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster pins Ensnaring Strike save, restraint, recurring dice, scaling, and concentration literals"},{"id":"2024","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster pins the Searing Smite next-hit and slot-scaling literals"},{"id":"2025","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster armed_rider_persists_after_hit: Searing Smite fires on the next weapon hit only once"},{"id":"2026","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster Divine Favor remains an active rider across subsequent weapon hits"},{"id":"2027","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster Ensnaring Strike consumes on hit and applies its failed-save restrained damage lifecycle"},{"id":"2028","name":"r9 single-spell manifest wins heal_value_drifted: Heal pins and restores the flat 70 HP literal"},{"id":"2029","name":"r9 single-spell manifest wins moonbeam_save_dropped: Moonbeam pins 2d10 Radiant plus Constitution save-half and repeats the save at turn end"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand, EncounterEvent } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { spellDefinition } from '../../../src/combat/spells/definitions';\nimport type { SpellCastCommand } from '../../../src/combat/spells/types';\nimport { feetPoint } from '../../../src/combat/templates';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, feet, persistentAreaId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nfunction startedEncounter(\n  caster: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  targetColumn = 1,\n): EncounterState {\n  const created = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [caster, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0, 1), placedToken(target, targetColumn, 1)],\n  });\n  return reduceEncounter(created, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\nfunction cast(\n  caster: CombatantProfile,\n  spellId: string,\n  slotLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 6,\n  options: Partial<Pick<SpellCastCommand, 'targets' | 'area'>> = {},\n): SpellCastCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'cast_spell',\n    actor: caster.id,\n    spellId,\n    slotLevel,\n    castAsRitual: false,\n    casterLevel: 7,\n    attackBonus: 8,\n    saveDc: 100,\n    spellcastingModifier: 4,\n    targets: options.targets ?? [],\n    area: options.area ?? null,\n    weaponAttack: null,\n    selectedOption: null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction weaponAttack(\n  caster: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: caster.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Slashing'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(8), modifier: 0 } }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attackEvent(events: readonly EncounterEvent[]) {\n  const event = events.findLast(\n    (candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'attack_resolved' }> =>\n      candidate.type === 'attack_resolved',\n  );\n  if (event === undefined) throw new Error('Expected an attack resolution.');\n  return event;\n}\n\ndescribe('r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster', () => {\n  it('pins Divine Favor as a one-minute non-concentration 1d4 Radiant rider', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('divine-favor')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 1,\n      castingTime: 'bonus_action',\n      targeting: { kind: 'self' },\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'weapon_attack_augmentation',\n        extraDamage: { type: damageType('Radiant'), dice: { baseCount: 1, sides: 4, perSlotCount: 0 } },\n        consumeOnHit: false,\n        concentration: false,\n        durationRounds: 10,\n        followUp: null,\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('pins Ensnaring Strike save, restraint, recurring dice, scaling, and concentration literals', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('ensnaring-strike')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 1,\n      castingTime: 'bonus_action',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'weapon_attack_augmentation',\n        extraDamage: null,\n        consumeOnHit: true,\n        concentration: true,\n        followUp: {\n          kind: 'save_then_restrain',\n          saveAbility: 'strength',\n          damageType: damageType('Piercing'),\n          dice: { baseCount: 1, sides: 6, perSlotCount: 1 },\n          timing: 'target_start',\n        },\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('pins the Searing Smite next-hit and slot-scaling literals', () => {\n    const definition = spellDefinition('searing-smite');\n    expect(definition).toMatchObject({\n      level: 1,\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'weapon_attack_augmentation',\n        extraDamage: { type: damageType('Fire'), dice: { baseCount: 1, sides: 6, perSlotCount: 1 } },\n        consumeOnHit: true,\n        followUp: {\n          kind: 'ongoing_damage_save_ends',\n          dice: { baseCount: 1, sides: 6, perSlotCount: 1 },\n          saveAbility: 'constitution',\n          timing: 'target_start',\n        },\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('armed_rider_persists_after_hit: Searing Smite fires on the next weapon hit only once', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('searing-caster', {\n      hitPoints: 100,\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      attacksPerAction: 2,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 3, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('searing-target', { hitPoints: 200, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'searing-smite', 3), () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(state.effects[0]?.payload).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'damage_rider',\n      damage: { terms: [{ type: damageType('Fire'), dice: { count: 3, sides: 6 } }] },\n      followUp: { damage: { terms: [{ type: damageType('Fire'), dice: { count: 3, sides: 6 } }] } },\n    });\n\n    const first = reduceEncounter(state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5);\n    expect(attackEvent(first.events).damage?.terms).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(first.state.effects.map((effect) => effect.payload.kind)).toEqual(['ongoing_damage']);\n\n    const second = reduceEncounter(first.state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5);\n    expect(attackEvent(second.events).damage?.terms).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(second.events.filter((event) =>\n      event.type === 'effect_ended' && event.reason === 'trigger_consumed')).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n\n  it('Divine Favor remains an active rider across subsequent weapon hits', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('favor-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      attacksPerAction: 2,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('favor-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'divine-favor', 1), () => 0.5).state;\n    const first = reduceEncounter(state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5);\n    const second = reduceEncounter(first.state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(attackEvent(first.events).damage?.terms).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(attackEvent(second.events).damage?.terms).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(second.state.effects).toMatchObject([{ payload: { kind: 'damage_rider', consumeOnHit: false } }]);\n  });\n\n  it('Ensnaring Strike consumes on hit and applies its failed-save restrained damage lifecycle', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('ensnaring-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 2, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('ensnaring-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'ensnaring-strike', 2), () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(state.effects).toMatchObject([{\n      targets: [target.id],\n      concentrationOwner: caster.id,\n      payload: {\n        kind: 'ensnaring_strike',\n        damage: { terms: [{ type: damageType('Piercing'), dice: { count: 2, sides: 6 } }] },\n      },\n    }]);\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Restrained' });\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('r9 single-spell manifest wins', () => {\n  it('heal_value_drifted: Heal pins and restores the flat 70 HP literal', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('heal')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 6,\n      targeting: { kind: 'single', rangeFeet: 60 },\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'fixed_healing',\n        baseAmount: 70,\n        additionalPerSlot: 10,\n        removesConditions: ['Blinded', 'Deafened', 'Poisoned'],\n      },\n    });\n    const caster = playerProfile('heal-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 6, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('heal-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = {\n      ...state,\n      combatants: state.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.profile.id === target.id ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 1 } : combatant),\n    };\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'heal', 6, { targets: [target.id] }), () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(71);\n  });\n\n  it('moonbeam_save_dropped: Moonbeam pins 2d10 Radiant plus Constitution save-half and repeats the save at turn end', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('moonbeam')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 2,\n      targeting: { kind: 'area', rangeFeet: 120, shape: 'cylinder', baseSizeFeet: 5, secondarySizeFeet: 40 },\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'persistent_area',\n        origin: 'selected_when_cast',\n        movableFeet: 60,\n        hooks: expect.arrayContaining([\n          expect.objectContaining({\n            hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'once_per_turn',\n            effect: expect.objectContaining({\n              kind: 'save_gated', ability: 'constitution', onSuccess: 'half',\n              payload: { kind: 'damage', damageType: damageType('Radiant'), dice: expect.objectContaining({ baseCount: 2, sides: 10, perSlotCount: 1 }) },\n            }),\n          }),\n        ]),\n      },\n    });\n    const caster = playerProfile('moonbeam-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 2, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('moonbeam-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target, 4);\n    const placed = {\n      shape: 'cylinder' as const,\n      template: { origin: feetPoint(20, 5), radius: feet(5), height: feet(40) },\n    };\n    const initial = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      cast(caster, 'moonbeam', 2, { area: placed }),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    expect(initial.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(initial.state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(88);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(initial.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const recurring = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: target.id }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(recurring.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(recurring.state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(76);\n\n    const distantTarget = monsterProfile('moonbeam-move-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let movable = startedEncounter(caster, distantTarget, 6);\n    movable = reduceEncounter(movable, cast(caster, 'moonbeam', 2, {\n      area: { shape: 'cylinder', template: { origin: feetPoint(15, 5), radius: feet(5), height: feet(40) } },\n    }), () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(movable.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === distantTarget.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(100);\n    movable = reduceEncounter(movable, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    movable = reduceEncounter(movable, { type: 'end_turn', actor: distantTarget.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const movedBeam = reduceEncounter(movable, {\n      type: 'move_persistent_area', actor: caster.id, areaId: persistentAreaId('area:1'),\n      origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(30, 5) },\n    }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(movedBeam.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'persistent_area_triggered', areaId: persistentAreaId('area:1'), hook: 'on_enter', target: distantTarget.id,\n    }));\n    expect(movedBeam.state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === distantTarget.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(88);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/tools/agent-conformance.SIMULATED.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2030","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification emits VERIFIED rows and exit 0 for four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification classifies timeout distinctly as transport and preserves a timeout excerpt"},{"id":"2033","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification keeps a Pi run UNVERIFIED when the adapter reports skipped MCP wiring"},{"id":"2034","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification does not report attempts and records attempts_used"},{"id":"2037","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification keeps generic lifecycle_incomplete reporting for a non-OpenCode MCP proof prefers per-CLI timeout overrides over the global timeout"},{"id":"2042","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification emits UNVERIFIED absent and exit not live CLI verification parses filtering and report arguments"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\nimport { AgentAdapterError } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-adapters/process';\nimport { PI_MCP_SKIPPED_NO_EXTENSION } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-adapters/pi';\nimport { encounterSessionId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { agentSessionIdFromCli } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-session';\nimport type { AgentCliKind, AgentFailureClassification, AgentInvocation, AgentSessionAdapter, AgentSessionBinding, AgentTurnResult, CliProbe } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-session';\nimport { parseAgentConformanceArguments, runAgentConformance } from '../../../tools/agent-conformance';\nimport type { AgentConformanceDependencies } from '../../../tools/agent-conformance';\n\ntype Mode = 'verified' | 'absent' | 'authentication' | 'failed' | 'timeout' | 'skipped_mcp' |\n  'resume_failure' | 'bad_mcp_proof' | 'retry_mcp_proof';\n\nconst SIMULATED_DIGEST = '0123456789abcdef'.repeat(4);\nconst SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN = '51b0af273f28f31751890e5dfd277624e7b1b2594f4c9f50a6ab938886e9b0bb';\nconst SIMULATED_PROOF = {\n  proofToken: SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN,\n  stateRef: {\n    runId: encounterSessionId('encounter:engine-mcp'),\n    stateHandle: `engine-state:${SIMULATED_DIGEST}`,\n    expectedRevision: 1,\n  },\n} as const;\n\nclass SIMULATEDCli implements AgentSessionAdapter {\n  #resumes = 0;\n  #proofAttempts = 0;\n  constructor(\n    readonly kind: AgentCliKind,\n    private readonly mode: Mode,\n    private readonly invocations: AgentInvocation[],\n    private readonly bindings: AgentSessionBinding[],\n  ) {}\n  probe(): Promise<CliProbe> { return Promise.resolve(this.mode === 'absent' ? { present: false, version: null } : { present: true, version: 'SIMULATED-1' }); }\n  start(_invocation: AgentInvocation, _signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentTurnResult> {\n    this.invocations.push(_invocation);\n    if (this.mode === 'authentication') return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError('credentials_absent', 'SIMULATED authentication'));\n    if (this.mode === 'failed') {\n      return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError(\n        'malformed_output',\n        `SIMULATED malformed output ${'M'.repeat(600)}`,\n        { stderr: `discarded-prefix-${'S'.repeat(600)}` },\n      ));\n    }\n    if (this.mode === 'timeout') {\n      return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError('timeout', 'Agent CLI timed out after 300000 ms.'));\n    }\n    return Promise.resolve({\n      resumeSessionId: agentSessionIdFromCli(`${this.kind}-SIMULATED-session`),\n      sessionId: null,\n      finalText: 'BOOT',\n      usage: null,\n      exit: 'completed',\n      ...(this.mode === 'skipped_mcp' ? { contractEvidence: [PI_MCP_SKIPPED_NO_EXTENSION] } : {}),\n    });\n  }\n  resume(binding: AgentSessionBinding, _invocation: AgentInvocation, _signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentTurnResult> {\n    this.invocations.push(_invocation);\n    this.bindings.push(binding);\n    this.#resumes += 1;\n    if (this.mode === 'resume_failure' && this.#resumes === 1) {\n      return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError('malformed_output', 'SIMULATED resume failure'));\n    }\n    if (_invocation.prompt.includes('deliberately missing session')) {\n      return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError('resume_not_found', 'SIMULATED missing'));\n    }\n    const proof = _invocation.prompt.includes('proof_token');\n    if (proof) this.#proofAttempts += 1;\n    const proofSucceeded = this.mode !== 'bad_mcp_proof' &&\n      (this.mode !== 'retry_mcp_proof' || this.#proofAttempts >= 3);\n    return Promise.resolve({\n      resumeSessionId: binding.sessionId,\n      sessionId: null,\n      finalText: proof && proofSucceeded ? SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN : proof ? SIMULATED_DIGEST : 'RESUME',\n      usage: null,\n      exit: 'completed',\n    });\n  }\n  classifyFailure(error: unknown): AgentFailureClassification {\n    if (!(error instanceof AgentAdapterError)) return 'unknown';\n    if (error.code === 'credentials_absent') return 'authentication';\n    if (error.code === 'timeout') return 'transport';\n    return error.code === 'resume_not_found' ? 'resume_not_found' : 'unknown';\n  }\n}\n\nconst MODES: Readonly<Record<AgentCliKind, Mode>> = { codex: 'verified', opencode: 'verified', pi: 'verified', 'claude-code': 'verified' };\n\nfunction dependenciesFor(modes: Readonly<Record<AgentCliKind, Mode>>) {\n  const output: string[] = [];\n  const errors: string[] = [];\n  const invocations: AgentInvocation[] = [];\n  const bindings: AgentSessionBinding[] = [];\n  const dependencies: AgentConformanceDependencies = {\n    adapter: (kind) => new SIMULATEDCli(kind, modes[kind], invocations, bindings),\n    now: () => '2026-08-27T20:00:00.000Z',\n    stdout: (line) => { output.push(line); },\n    stderr: (line) => { errors.push(line); },\n    expectedMcpProof: () => Promise.resolve(SIMULATED_PROOF),\n    writeReport: () => Promise.resolve(),\n  };\n  return { dependencies, output, errors, invocations, bindings };\n}\n\ndescribe('SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification', () => {\n  it('emits VERIFIED rows and exit 0 for all lifecycle cases', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: null, reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report).toMatchObject({ aggregate: 'VERIFIED', exitCode: 0 });\n    expect(report.records.map((row) => row.status)).toEqual(['VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED']);\n    expect(report.records[0]?.lifecycle).toEqual({\n      coldStart: true,\n      sessionIdCaptured: true,\n      resume: true,\n      mcpProof: true,\n      attempts_used: 1,\n      classifiedResumeFailure: true,\n    });\n    expect(report.records[0]?.contractEvidence.marker).toContain('UNVERIFIED_CONTRACT');\n    expect(fake.output.slice(0, 2)).toEqual([\n      expect.stringContaining('SUBSTITUTED_LOCAL'),\n      'CLI | PRESENT | VERSION | STATUS | REASON | ERROR',\n    ]);\n    expect(fake.invocations.every((value) => value.reasoningEffort === 'low')).toBe(true);\n    expect(fake.invocations.every((value) => value.timeoutMs === 300_000)).toBe(true);\n    expect(fake.errors).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it('emits FAILED and exit 1 for an installed contract failure', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, pi: 'failed' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: null, reportPath: null },
