fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report).toMatchObject({ aggregate: 'FAILED', exitCode: 1 });\n    expect(report.records[2]).toMatchObject({ cli: 'pi', status: 'FAILED', reason: 'unknown' });\n    expect(report.records[2]?.errorExcerpt).toHaveLength(500);\n    expect(report.records[2]?.errorExcerpt).toContain('SIMULATED malformed output');\n    expect(report.records[2]?.stderrTail).toBe('S'.repeat(500));\n    expect(fake.errors[0]).toContain('pi | yes | SIMULATED-1 | FAILED | unknown');\n    expect(fake.errors[0]).toContain('SIMULATED malformed output');\n  });\n\n  it('classifies timeout distinctly as transport and preserves a timeout excerpt', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, codex: 'timeout' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'FAILED',\n      reason: 'transport',\n      errorExcerpt: 'Agent CLI timed out after 300000 ms.',\n      stderrTail: '',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('keeps a Pi run UNVERIFIED when the adapter reports skipped MCP wiring', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, pi: 'skipped_mcp' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'pi', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report).toMatchObject({ aggregate: 'UNVERIFIED', exitCode: 2 });\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'UNVERIFIED',\n      reason: 'mcp_wiring_skipped_no_extension',\n      errorExcerpt: 'Pi MCP wiring was skipped because no extension path was configured.',\n      contractEvidence: { turnMarkers: [PI_MCP_SKIPPED_NO_EXTENSION] },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('does not report VERIFIED when MCP proof only echoes the prompt-supplied capsule digest', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, opencode: 'bad_mcp_proof' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'opencode', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'FAILED',\n      reason: 'upstream_mcp_tools_not_exposed_issue_33027',\n      lifecycle: { coldStart: true, sessionIdCaptured: true, resume: true, mcpProof: false, attempts_used: 3, classifiedResumeFailure: true },\n      errorExcerpt: expect.stringContaining('anomalyco/opencode#33027'),\n    });\n    expect(fake.invocations[2]?.prompt).not.toContain('engine.get_state_summary');\n  });\n\n  it('judges MCP proof by the independently derived response token and never puts that token in the prompt', async () => {\n    const openCode = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    const openCodeReport = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'opencode', reportPath: null }, openCode.dependencies);\n    expect(openCodeReport.records[0]?.lifecycle.mcpProof).toBe(true);\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('engine state summary tool');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).not.toContain('engine.get_state_summary');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('\"run_id\":\"encounter:engine-mcp\"');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain(`\"state_handle\":\"engine-state:${SIMULATED_DIGEST}\"`);\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('\"expected_revision\":1');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('proof_token');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).not.toContain(SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN);\n\n    const pi = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    const piReport = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'pi', reportPath: null }, pi.dependencies);\n    expect(piReport.records[0]?.lifecycle.mcpProof).toBe(true);\n    expect(pi.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('engine_engine_get_state_summary');\n    expect(pi.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('mcp({search:\"engine\"})');\n    expect(pi.invocations[2]?.prompt).not.toContain(SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN);\n  });\n\n  it('uses up to three same-session MCP proof attempts and records attempts_used', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, pi: 'retry_mcp_proof' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'pi', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'VERIFIED',\n      lifecycle: { mcpProof: true, attempts_used: 3 },\n    });\n    const proofInvocations = fake.invocations.filter((value) => value.prompt.includes('proof_token'));\n    expect(proofInvocations).toHaveLength(3);\n    expect(proofInvocations.every((value) => !value.prompt.includes(SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN))).toBe(true);\n    expect(fake.bindings.slice(1, 4).every((value) => value.sessionId === 'pi-SIMULATED-session')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('keeps generic lifecycle_incomplete reporting for a non-OpenCode MCP proof failure', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, pi: 'bad_mcp_proof' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'pi', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'FAILED',\n      reason: 'lifecycle_incomplete',\n      lifecycle: { mcpProof: false, attempts_used: 3 },\n      errorExcerpt: 'One or more required lifecycle proofs did not complete.',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('uses a valid-format fixed UUID for the Claude missing-session proof only', async () => {\n    const claude = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'claude-code', reportPath: null }, claude.dependencies);\n    expect(claude.bindings[2]?.sessionId).toBe('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001');\n\n    const codex = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null }, codex.dependencies);\n    expect(codex.bindings[2]?.sessionId).toBe('missing-session-codex');\n  });\n\n  it('preserves accumulated lifecycle evidence when a mid-lifecycle case fails', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, codex: 'resume_failure' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'FAILED',\n      lifecycle: { coldStart: true, sessionIdCaptured: true, resume: false, mcpProof: false, attempts_used: 0, classifiedResumeFailure: false },\n      errorExcerpt: 'SIMULATED resume failure',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('reads the optional conformance timeout override', async () => {\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS', '456789');\n    try {\n      const fake = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n      await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n      expect(fake.invocations.every((value) => value.timeoutMs === 456_789)).toBe(true);\n    } finally {\n      vi.unstubAllEnvs();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('prefers per-CLI timeout overrides over the global timeout', async () => {\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS', '456789');\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS_CODEX', '310001');\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS_OPENCODE', '310002');\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS_PI', '310003');\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS_CLAUDE_CODE', '310004');\n    try {\n      const expected = new Map<AgentCliKind, number>([\n        ['codex', 310_001],\n        ['opencode', 310_002],\n        ['pi', 310_003],\n        ['claude-code', 310_004],\n      ]);\n      for (const kind of ['codex', 'opencode', 'pi', 'claude-code'] as const) {\n        const fake = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n        await runAgentConformance({ cli: kind, reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n        expect(fake.invocations.every((value) => value.timeoutMs === expected.get(kind))).toBe(true);\n      }\n    } finally {\n      vi.unstubAllEnvs();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it.each([['absent', 'cli_absent'], ['authentication', 'authentication']] as const)(\n    'emits UNVERIFIED %s and exit 2', async (mode, reason) => {\n      const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, opencode: mode });\n      const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'opencode', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n      expect(report).toMatchObject({ aggregate: 'UNVERIFIED', exitCode: 2 });\n      expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({ cli: 'opencode', status: 'UNVERIFIED', reason });\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('parses filtering and report arguments', () => {\n    expect(parseAgentConformanceArguments(['--cli', 'codex', '--report', '/tmp/live.json'])).toEqual({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: '/tmp/live.json' });\n    expect(parseAgentConformanceArguments(['--', '--cli', 'codex'])).toEqual({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null });\n    expect(() => parseAgentConformanceArguments(['--cli', 'other'])).toThrow('--cli requires');\n    expect(() => parseAgentConformanceArguments(['--unknown'])).toThrow('Unknown agent conformance argument');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/ui/authoring-form-components.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2045","name":"HA-6 shared authoring form controls HA-EFFECT-EXHAUSTIVE renders a specific field set and preview for every domain effect kind"},{"id":"2046","name":"HA-6 shared authoring form controls keeps hostile names and descriptions visible, marked, and inert across every requested string class"},{"id":"2047","name":"HA-6 shared authoring form controls moves ordered cards only through labelled keyboard-reachable buttons and disables boundaries"},{"id":"2048","name":"HA-6 shared authoring form controls matches a reordered item by collection and item key together"},{"id":"2049","name":"HA-6 shared authoring form controls focuses the first invalid labelled field and reports every validation path together"},{"id":"2050","name":"HA-6 shared authoring form controls screen-scoped dirty guard refuses navigation and is disposed on real screen unmount"},{"id":"2051","name":"HA-6 shared authoring form controls warns on browser unload only while the draft has unsaved local changes"},{"id":"2052","name":"HA-6 stale draft conflict dialog attaches before showModal, recognizes revision-CAS errors, and traps/restores focus"},{"id":"2053","name":"HA-6 stale draft conflict dialog refuses malformed lookalike conflict data"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { AuthoringValidationIssue } from '../../../src/authoring/contracts';\nimport type {\n  AuthorableEffectKind,\n  AuthoringDraftCharacterEffect,\n  AuthoringDraftFeatureEffect,\n} from '../../../src/authoring/effect-forms';\nimport type { HomebrewDraftItemUuid, HomebrewDraftUuid } from '../../../src/authoring/ids';\nimport type { DraftRevision } from '../../../src/authoring/contracts';\nimport { RpcError } from '../../../src/rpc/protocol';\nimport { damageType } from '../../../src/domain/enums';\nimport {\n  authoringPathKey,\n  createEffectCard,\n  createOrderedCardControls,\n  effectPreview,\n  installDraftBeforeUnloadGuard,\n  installDraftNavigationGuard,\n  renderValidationSummary,\n  type AuthoringEffectDraft,\n} from '../../../src/ui/authoring/form-components';\nimport {\n  createDraftConflictDialog,\n  draftRevisionConflict,\n} from '../../../src/ui/authoring/draft-conflict-dialog';\nimport {\n  elementText,\n  installInteractiveDocument,\n  interactiveElement,\n} from '../../fixtures/interactive-dom';\nimport { Router } from '../../../src/ui/router';\nimport { Application } from '../../../src/ui/app';\n\nfunction uuid(value: string): HomebrewDraftItemUuid {\n  return value as HomebrewDraftItemUuid;\n}\n\nconst EFFECTS = {\n  damage_resistance: {\n    kind: 'damage_resistance', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-resistance'),\n    label: 'Void ward', notes: null, damage_type: damageType('Void'),\n  },\n  hp_modifier: {\n    kind: 'hp_modifier', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-hp'),\n    label: 'Sturdy', notes: null, hit_points_flat: 2, hit_points_per_level: null,\n  },\n  speed: {\n    kind: 'speed', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-speed'),\n    label: 'Quick', notes: null, speed_bonus_feet: 5,\n  },\n  ability_increase: {\n    kind: 'ability_increase', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-increase'),\n    label: 'Mighty', notes: null, ability: 'strength', amount: 2, maximum: 20,\n  },\n  ability_override: {\n    kind: 'ability_override', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-override'),\n    label: 'Giant strength', notes: null, ability: 'strength', maximum: 23,\n  },\n  armor_class_bonus: {\n    kind: 'armor_class_bonus', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-ac-bonus'),\n    label: 'Guarded', notes: null, amount: 1,\n  },\n  armor_class_formula: {\n    kind: 'armor_class_formula', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-ac-formula'),\n    label: 'Natural armor', notes: null, base: 13, ability_1: 'dexterity',\n    ability_2: null, allows_shield: true,\n  },\n  attack_ability_override: {\n    kind: 'attack_ability_override', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-attack-ability'),\n    label: 'Bonded strikes', notes: null, ability: 'charisma',\n    weapon_scope: 'one_bonded_weapon',\n  },\n  weapon_attack_bonus: {\n    kind: 'weapon_attack_bonus', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-attack'),\n    label: 'Accurate', notes: null, amount: 1, weapon_scope: 'any_weapon',\n  },\n  weapon_damage_bonus: {\n    kind: 'weapon_damage_bonus', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-damage'),\n    label: 'Forceful', notes: null, amount: 1, weapon_scope: 'any_weapon',\n  },\n  extra_attack: {\n    kind: 'extra_attack', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-extra'),\n    label: 'Extra Attack', notes: null, attack_count: 2,\n    weapon_scope: 'any_weapon',\n  },\n} as const satisfies Readonly<Record<AuthorableEffectKind, AuthoringEffectDraft>>;\n\nfunction noEffectActions() {\n  return {\n    onKindChange: () => undefined,\n    onCommonChange: () => undefined,\n    onFieldChange: () => undefined,\n    onMoveUp: () => undefined,\n    onMoveDown: () => undefined,\n    onRemove: () => undefined,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction keydown(key: string, shiftKey = false): KeyboardEvent {\n  const event = new Event('keydown', { cancelable: true }) as KeyboardEvent;\n  Object.defineProperties(event, {\n    key: { value: key },\n    shiftKey: { value: shiftKey },\n  });\n  return event;\n}\n\nfunction routerWindow(initialUrl: string): Window {\n  const events = new EventTarget();\n  const location = {\n    href: initialUrl,\n    origin: new URL(initialUrl).origin,\n  };\n  let state: unknown = null;\n  const moveTo = (target: string | URL): void => {\n    location.href = new URL(String(target), location.href).href;\n  };\n  const history = {\n    get state(): unknown {\n      return state;\n    },\n    pushState(nextState: unknown, _unused: string, target?: string | URL | null): void {\n      state = nextState;\n      if (target !== undefined && target !== null) moveTo(target);\n    },\n    replaceState(nextState: unknown, _unused: string, target?: string | URL | null): void {\n      state = nextState;\n      if (target !== undefined && target !== null) moveTo(target);\n    },\n  };\n  return {\n    location,\n    history,\n    addEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject) =>\n      events.addEventListener(type, listener),\n    removeEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject) =>\n      events.removeEventListener(type, listener),\n  } as unknown as Window;\n}\n\nasync function settle(): Promise<void> {\n  for (let turn = 0; turn < 4; turn += 1) await Promise.resolve();\n}\n\ndescribe('HA-6 shared authoring form controls', () => {\n  it('HA-EFFECT-EXHAUSTIVE renders a specific field set and preview for every domain effect kind', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const kinds = Object.keys(EFFECTS) as AuthorableEffectKind[];\n      const cards = kinds.map((kind, index) => interactiveElement(createEffectCard({\n        effect: EFFECTS[kind],\n        position: index + 1,\n        count: kinds.length,\n        allowFeatureOnly: kind === 'extra_attack',\n        ...noEffectActions(),\n      })));\n\n      expect(cards).toHaveLength(11);\n      expect(cards.map((card) => card.getAttribute('data-draft-item-uuid')))\n        .toEqual(kinds.map((kind) => EFFECTS[kind].draft_item_uuid));\n      for (const [index, card] of cards.entries()) {\n        expect(card.getAttribute('aria-label')).toContain(\n          `Effect ${String(index + 1)} of 11`,\n        );\n        const preview = card.querySelector('[aria-label=\"Effect preview\"]');\n        expect(preview).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(\n          preview?.querySelector('[data-free-text=\"unverified-origin\"]')?.textContent,\n        ).toBe(effectPreview(EFFECTS[kinds[index]!]!));\n        expect(effectPreview(EFFECTS[kinds[index]!]!)).not.toContain('undefined');\n        expect(elementText(card as unknown as Node)).not.toContain('Other');\n        expect(elementText(card as unknown as Node)).not.toContain('Numeric bonus');\n      }\n      expect(elementText(cards[0] as unknown as Node)).toContain('Damage type');\n      expect(elementText(cards[1] as unknown as Node)).toContain('Flat hit points');\n      expect(elementText(cards[6] as unknown as Node)).toContain('Allows a shield');\n      expect(elementText(cards[10] as unknown as Node)).toContain('Total attacks');\n      expect(elementText(cards[7] as unknown as Node)).toContain(\n        'Not applied to sheet numbers until the character has a bonded weapon.',\n      );\n      const knownCustom = cards[0]?.querySelectorAll('input').find(\n        (input) => input.getAttribute('list') !== null,\n      );\n      expect(knownCustom?.getAttribute('type')).toBe('text');\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('keeps hostile names and descriptions visible, marked, and inert across every requested string class', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const hostile = '</legend><img data-hostile-authoring src=x> \"quoted\" 🐉 \\u202eRTL\\u202c nul\\u0000\\u0001tail';\n      const effect: AuthoringDraftCharacterEffect = {\n        ...EFFECTS.damage_resistance,\n        label: hostile,\n        notes: hostile,\n      };\n      const card = interactiveElement(createEffectCard({\n        effect,\n        position: 1,\n        count: 1,\n        allowFeatureOnly: false,\n        ...noEffectActions(),\n      }));\n\n      expect(elementText(card as unknown as Node)).toContain(hostile);\n      expect(card.querySelectorAll('img')).toHaveLength(0);\n      expect(card.querySelectorAll('script')).toHaveLength(0);\n      expect(card.querySelectorAll('[data-hostile-authoring]')).toHaveLength(0);\n      const marked = card.querySelectorAll('[data-free-text=\"unverified-origin\"]');\n      expect(marked.map((node) => node.textContent)).toEqual([\n        effectPreview(effect),\n        hostile,\n      ]);\n      expect(card.innerHTML).toBe('');\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('moves ordered cards only through labelled keyboard-reachable buttons and disables boundaries', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const calls: string[] = [];\n      const controls = interactiveElement(createOrderedCardControls({\n        collectionKey: 'aegis-collection',\n        itemKey: 'aegis-item',\n        accessibleName: 'Aegis', position: 1, count: 2,\n        onMoveUp: () => calls.push('up'),\n        onMoveDown: () => calls.push('down'),\n        onRemove: () => calls.push('remove'),\n      }));\n      const buttons = controls.querySelectorAll('button');\n      expect(buttons.map((button) => button.getAttribute('aria-label'))).toEqual([\n        'Move up Aegis, item 1 of 2',\n        'Move down Aegis, item 1 of 2',\n        'Remove Aegis, item 1 of 2',\n      ]);\n      expect(buttons[0]?.disabled).toBe(true);\n      expect(buttons[1]?.disabled).toBe(false);\n      buttons[0]?.click();\n      buttons[1]?.click();\n      buttons[2]?.click();\n      expect(calls).toEqual(['down', 'remove']);\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('matches a reordered item by collection and item key together', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const host = document.createElement('div');\n      host.setAttribute('data-authoring-form-kind', 'test');\n      document.body.append(host);\n      const render = (moved = false): void => {\n        const duplicate = createOrderedCardControls({\n          collectionKey: 'other-collection', itemKey: 'shared-item',\n          accessibleName: 'Other item', position: 2, count: 2,\n          onMoveUp: () => undefined, onMoveDown: () => undefined, onRemove: () => undefined,\n        });\n        const intended = createOrderedCardControls({\n          collectionKey: 'intended-collection', itemKey: 'shared-item',\n          accessibleName: moved ? 'Moved intended item' : 'Intended item',\n          position: moved ? 1 : 2, count: 2,\n          onMoveUp: () => render(true), onMoveDown: () => undefined, onRemove: () => undefined,\n        });\n        host.replaceChildren(duplicate, intended);\n      };\n      render();\n\n      const moveUp = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(\n        '[data-authoring-order-action]',\n      ))\n        .find((candidate) =>\n          candidate.getAttribute('data-authoring-order-collection') === 'intended-collection' &&\n          candidate.getAttribute('data-authoring-order-action') === 'move-up');\n      moveUp?.click();\n\n      expect(document.activeElement?.getAttribute('data-authoring-order-collection'))\n        .toBe('intended-collection');\n      expect(document.activeElement?.getAttribute('aria-label'))\n        .toBe('Move down Moved intended item, item 1 of 2');\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('focuses the first invalid labelled field and reports every validation path together', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const form = document.createElement('form');\n      const name = document.createElement('input');\n      name.dataset.authoringPath = authoringPathKey(['name']);\n      const second = document.createElement('input');\n      second.dataset.authoringPath = authoringPathKey(['traits', 0, 'name']);\n      form.append(name, second);\n      const issues: readonly AuthoringValidationIssue[] = [\n        { path: ['name'], code: 'required', message: 'Name is required.' },\n        { path: ['traits', 0, 'name'], code: 'required', message: 'Trait name is required.' },\n        { path: ['effects', 0], code: 'invalid_value', message: 'Effect is incomplete.' },\n      ];\n      const summary = interactiveElement(renderValidationSummary(form, issues));\n\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(name);\n      expect(name.getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('true');\n      expect(second.getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('true');\n      expect(elementText(summary as unknown as Node)).toContain('Name is required.');\n      expect(elementText(summary as unknown as Node)).toContain('Trait name is required.');\n      expect(elementText(summary as unknown as Node)).toContain('Effect is incomplete.');\n      summary.querySelectorAll('a')[1]?.click();\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(second);\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('screen-scoped dirty guard refuses navigation and is disposed on real screen unmount', async () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    let allow = false;\n    try {\n      const root = document.createElement('div');\n      document.body.append(root);\n      const router = new Router(routerWindow('https://example.test/guarded'));\n      const application = new Application(\n        root,\n        null as never,\n        router,\n        () => true,\n        [\n          {\n            id: 'guarded-test-screen',\n            matches: (route) => route.path === '/guarded',\n            render: (context) => {\n              installDraftNavigationGuard(context, {\n                isDirty: () => true,\n                confirmLeave: () => allow,\n              });\n            },\n          },\n          {\n            id: 'plain-test-screen',\n            matches: () => true,\n            render: () => undefined,\n          },\n        ],\n      );\n      application.start();\n      await settle();\n\n      expect(router.navigate('/refused')).toBe(false);\n      expect(router.current.path).toBe('/guarded');\n\n      allow = true;\n      expect(router.navigate('/unmounted')).toBe(true);\n      allow = false;\n      expect(router.navigate('/after-unmount')).toBe(true);\n      expect(router.current.path).toBe('/after-unmount');\n\n      application.stop();\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('warns on browser unload only while the draft has unsaved local changes', () => {\n    const target = new EventTarget();\n    let dirty = true;\n    const cleanup = installDraftBeforeUnloadGuard(\n      target as unknown as Window,\n      () => dirty,\n    );\n    const blocked = new Event('beforeunload', { cancelable: true });\n    target.dispatchEvent(blocked);\n    expect(blocked.defaultPrevented).toBe(true);\n    dirty = false;\n    const clean = new Event('beforeunload', { cancelable: true });\n    target.dispatchEvent(clean);\n    expect(clean.defaultPrevented).toBe(false);\n    cleanup();\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('HA-6 stale draft conflict dialog', () => {\n  it('attaches before showModal, recognizes revision-CAS errors, and traps/restores focus', async () => {\n    const conflict = draftRevisionConflict(new RpcError(\n      'handler_error',\n      'Draft revision is stale.',\n      {\n        reason: 'stale_draft_revision',\n        draft_uuid: 'draft-conflict',\n        expected_revision: 3,\n        actual_revision: 4,\n      },\n    ));\n    expect(conflict).toEqual({\n      draft_uuid: 'draft-conflict', expected_revision: 3, actual_revision: 4,\n    });\n    if (conflict === null) throw new Error('Conflict was not recognized.');\n\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const invoker = document.createElement('button');\n      document.body.append(invoker);\n      invoker.focus();\n      const choices: string[] = [];\n      const rendered = createDraftConflictDialog({\n        conflict,\n        mount: document.body,\n        restoreFocus: () => invoker.focus(),\n        onLoadSaved: () => { choices.push('load'); },\n        onKeepLocal: () => { choices.push('keep'); },\n      });\n      const dialog = interactiveElement(rendered.element);\n      const buttons = dialog.querySelectorAll('button');\n\n      expect(dialog.getAttribute('aria-modal')).toBe('true');\n      expect(dialog.isConnected).toBe(true);\n      expect(dialog.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).toBe('authoring-conflict-heading');\n      expect(elementText(dialog as unknown as Node)).toContain(\n        'revision 3, but revision 4 is now saved. Nothing was overwritten.',\n      );\n      expect(elementText(dialog as unknown as Node)).not.toContain('Overwrite');\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(buttons[0]);\n      dialog.dispatchEvent(keydown('Tab', true));\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(buttons[1]);\n      dialog.dispatchEvent(keydown('Tab'));\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(buttons[0]);\n      dialog.dispatchEvent(keydown('Escape'));\n      await rendered.whenSettled();\n      expect(choices).toEqual(['keep']);\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(invoker);\n      rendered.cleanup();\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('refuses malformed lookalike conflict data', () => {\n    expect(draftRevisionConflict(new RpcError(\n      'handler_error',\n      'bad',\n      { reason: 'stale_draft_revision', draft_uuid: 'draft', expected_revision: '3', actual_revision: 4 },\n    ))).toBeNull();\n    expect(draftRevisionConflict(new Error('Draft revision is stale.'))).toBeNull();\n  });\n});\n\n// Compile-only witnesses keep both effect unions exercised by this test file.\nconst characterWitness: AuthoringDraftCharacterEffect = EFFECTS.ability_override;\nconst featureWitness: AuthoringDraftFeatureEffect = EFFECTS.extra_attack;\nconst draftUuidWitness = 'draft' as HomebrewDraftUuid;\nconst revisionWitness = 1 as DraftRevision;\nvoid characterWitness;\nvoid featureWitness;\nvoid draftUuidWitness;\nvoid revisionWitness;\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/wild-shape-persistence.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2054","name":"Wild Shape session persistence round-trips a wildshaped combatant through export, strict decode, import, replay, and resume"},{"id":"2055","name":"Wild Shape session persistence closed_union_decode: refuses an unrecognized persisted overlay kind instead of widening it"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport {\n  encounterBranchId,\n  encounterSessionId,\n  statblockId,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { createWildShapeCharacterSheet, decodeWildShapeOverlay } from '../../../src/combat/wild-shape';\nimport type { PersistedCoordinatorState } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport {\n  EncounterSessionJournal,\n  MemoryBrowserSessionStore,\n  MemoryMirrorSink,\n  exportSavedSession,\n  importSavedSession,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/session-persistence';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst COORDINATOR: PersistedCoordinatorState = {\n  requestSequence: 1,\n  pendingRequest: null,\n  pendingCommand: null,\n  continuation: { kind: 'idle' },\n  pause: null,\n};\n\nfunction shapedEncounter() {\n  const base = playerProfile('persist-wild-druid', { hitPoints: 24, initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  if (base.kind !== 'player_character') throw new Error('Wild Shape persistence fixture is not a PC.');\n  const druid: Extract<CombatantProfile, { readonly kind: 'player_character' }> = {\n    ...base,\n    wildShape: createWildShapeCharacterSheet(2, [\n      'statblock:wolf',\n      'statblock:boar',\n      'statblock:homebrew-beast/brush-bear',\n      'statblock:homebrew-beast/threadling-weaver',\n    ]),\n  };\n  const enemy = monsterProfile('persist-wild-enemy', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const started = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [druid, enemy],\n    tokens: [placedToken(druid, 0), placedToken(enemy, 1)],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  const shaped = reduceEncounter(started, {\n    type: 'assume_wild_shape',\n    actor: druid.id,\n    formId: statblockId('statblock:wolf'),\n    equipmentDisposition: 'merged_into_form',\n  }, () => 0).state;\n  return { druid, shaped };\n}\n\ndescribe('Wild Shape session persistence', () => {\n  it('round-trips a wildshaped combatant through export, strict decode, import, replay, and resume', () => {\n    const fixture = shapedEncounter();\n    const source = new MemoryBrowserSessionStore();\n    const sessionId = encounterSessionId('session:wild-shape-round-trip');\n    EncounterSessionJournal.create({\n      sessionId,\n      branchId: encounterBranchId('branch:wild-shape-main'),\n      encounterState: fixture.shaped,\n      coordinatorState: COORDINATOR,\n      controllers: [],\n      rng: mulberry32(4242),\n      store: source,\n      mirror: new MemoryMirrorSink(),\n    });\n    const destination = new MemoryBrowserSessionStore();\n    expect(importSavedSession(destination, exportSavedSession(source, sessionId))).toBe(sessionId);\n    const resumed = EncounterSessionJournal.resume(sessionId, destination, new MemoryMirrorSink());\n    const restored = resumed.encounterState.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === fixture.druid.id);\n    expect(restored?.wildShape).toEqual(\n      fixture.shaped.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === fixture.druid.id)?.wildShape,\n    );\n    expect(restored?.wildShapeUses).toEqual({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 2, remaining: 1 });\n  });\n\n  it('closed_union_decode: refuses an unrecognized persisted overlay kind instead of widening it', () => {\n    const fixture = shapedEncounter();\n    const overlay = fixture.shaped.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === fixture.druid.id)?.wildShape;\n    if (overlay === undefined) throw new Error('Wild Shape overlay fixture is absent.');\n    expect(() => decodeWildShapeOverlay({ ...overlay, kind: 'wild_shape_from_the_future' }))\n      .toThrow('unknown kind');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/legendary-windows.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2056","name":"M4 legendary-windows-v1 reports Unicorn pools, the hand-built post-player window, and tactical verdicts for pending actions"},{"id":"2057","name":"M4 legendary-windows-v1 mutation_guard: reports two remaining legendary uses after one declared-use action"},{"id":"2058","name":"M4 legendary-windows-v1 exposes pending legendary-resistance save and severity facts without choosing a policy"},{"id":"2059","name":"M4 legendary-windows-v1 returns typed unresolved results when no legendary actor or no timeline is available"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { monsterCombatantProfile, type CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { damageType, dieSides } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { UNICORN } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/monsters';\nimport {\n  LEGENDARY_WINDOWS_POLICY,\n  provideLegendaryWindows,\n  type LegendaryWindowsIntel,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/intel/legendary-windows';\nimport {\n  projectEncounterTimeline,\n  type EncounterTimelineProjection,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/session-timeline';\nimport { placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction face(value: number): () => number {\n  return () => (value - 0.5) / 20;\n}\n\nfunction unicornProfile(key = 'legendary-window-unicorn'): CombatantProfile {\n  return monsterCombatantProfile(UNICORN, {\n    combatantId: `combatant:${key}`,\n    tokenId: `token:${key}`,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction startedEncounter(\n  player: CombatantProfile,\n  unicorn = unicornProfile(),\n): { readonly state: EncounterState; readonly player: CombatantProfile; readonly unicorn: CombatantProfile } {\n  const combatants = [player, unicorn];\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 4 },\n    combatants,\n    tokens: combatants.map((profile, index) => placedToken(profile, index, 1)),\n  });\n  return {\n    state: reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.975).state,\n    player,\n    unicorn,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction full(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  severityInputs: Parameters<typeof provideLegendaryWindows>[0]['resistanceSeverityInputs'] = [],\n  timeline: EncounterTimelineProjection | null = projectEncounterTimeline(state, []),\n): LegendaryWindowsIntel {\n  return provideLegendaryWindows({\n    state,\n    timeline,\n    detail: 'full',\n    resistanceSeverityInputs: severityInputs,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction requireDetails(intel: LegendaryWindowsIntel) {\n  if (intel.status !== 'resolved' || intel.details === null) throw new Error('Expected resolved full legendary intel.');\n  return intel.details;\n}\n\ndescribe('M4 legendary-windows-v1', () => {\n  it('reports Unicorn pools, the hand-built post-player window, and tactical verdicts for pending actions', () => {\n    const player = playerProfile('legendary-window-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const setup = startedEncounter(player);\n    const handBuiltTimeline = {\n      phase: setup.state.phase,\n      round: 1,\n      currentCombatant: player.id,\n      initiative: [],\n      upcoming: [{\n        kind: 'legendary_action_window', legendaryCombatant: setup.unicorn.id,\n        boundary: { round: 1, combatant: player.id, boundary: 'end' },\n      }],\n      roundBoundaries: [],\n      branchPoints: [],\n    } satisfies EncounterTimelineProjection;\n    const beforeWindow = requireDetails(full(setup.state, [], handBuiltTimeline)).actors[0];\n    if (beforeWindow === undefined || beforeWindow.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected resolved Unicorn facts.');\n    expect(beforeWindow.nextWindow).toEqual({\n      status: 'resolved', afterCombatant: player.id, round: 1, source: 'timeline',\n    });\n\n    const state = reduceEncounter(setup.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: player.id }, face(10)).state;\n\n    const intel = full(state);\n    const details = requireDetails(intel);\n    const unicorn = details.actors[0];\n    if (unicorn === undefined || unicorn.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected resolved Unicorn facts.');\n\n    expect(intel.policy).toBe(LEGENDARY_WINDOWS_POLICY);\n    expect(intel.compact).toEqual([\n      'legendary', 'Unicorn', 'actions', '3/3', 'resistance', '3/3',\n      'next', String(player.id), 'pending', 'action',\n    ]);\n    expect(intel.compact).toHaveLength(10);\n    expect(unicorn.nextWindow).toEqual({\n      status: 'resolved', afterCombatant: player.id, round: 1, source: 'pending_decision',\n    });\n    expect(unicorn.pendingWindow?.options.map((option) => option.option.id)).toEqual([\n      'legendary_action:charging-horn', 'legendary_action:shimmering-shield', 'pass',\n    ]);\n    const horn = unicorn.pendingWindow?.options[0];\n    if (horn === undefined || horn.status !== 'resolved' || horn.assessment.kind !== 'attack') {\n      throw new Error('Expected a scored Charging Horn.');\n    }\n    expect(horn.assessment.tactical).toEqual({\n      policy: 'tactical-evaluator-v2',\n      range: { status: 'resolved', distanceFeet: 5, band: 'melee', legal: true },\n      rollMode: { mode: 'normal', reasons: [], sources: [] },\n      probabilities: { status: 'resolved', hit: 0.7, critical: 0.05, miss: 0.3 },\n      damage: {\n        // (13/20 × 9.5) + (1/20 × 15), represented by the evaluator's IEEE-754 arithmetic.\n        status: 'resolved', normalHitAverage: 9.5, criticalHitAverage: 15, expectedDamage: 6.924999999999999,\n      },\n      consequences: {\n        deathFailureOnHit: false, failuresOnHit: 0, failuresOnCritical: 0,\n        automaticCriticalOnHit: false, automaticCriticalMaximumDistanceFeet: null,\n      },\n      unresolved: [],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('mutation_guard: reports two remaining legendary uses after one declared-use action', () => {\n    const player = playerProfile('legendary-window-spend-player', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 100 });\n    const setup = startedEncounter(player);\n    const queued = reduceEncounter(setup.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: player.id }, face(10)).state;\n    const decision = queued.pendingDecisions.find((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'legendary_action_window');\n    if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Expected Unicorn legendary window.');\n    const spent = reduceEncounter(queued, {\n      type: 'resolve_pending_decision', decisionId: decision.id, optionId: 'legendary_action:charging-horn',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n\n    const unicorn = requireDetails(full(spent)).actors[0];\n    if (unicorn === undefined || unicorn.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected resolved Unicorn facts.');\n    // A plausible off-by-one mutant reports 3 here; the reducer has spent Charging Horn's cost of 1.\n    expect(unicorn.actionUses).toEqual({ remaining: 2, maximum: 3 });\n  });\n\n  it('exposes pending legendary-resistance save and severity facts without choosing a policy', () => {\n    const player = playerProfile('legendary-resistance-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const setup = startedEncounter(player);\n    const failed = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'force_save', actor: player.id, target: setup.unicorn.id,\n      ability: 'constitution', dc: 20, rollMode: 'normal', cost: 'none', onSuccess: 'none',\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 4 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n    }, face(1)).state;\n    const decision = failed.pendingDecisions.find((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'legendary_resistance');\n    if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Expected failed-save Legendary Resistance decision.');\n\n    const details = requireDetails(full(failed, [{\n      decisionId: decision.id,\n      effectSeverity: {\n        damageExpected: 4, imposedConditions: ['Poisoned'], forcedMovementFeet: null, removesTurn: false,\n      },\n    }]));\n    expect(details.resistanceSpendInputs).toEqual([{\n      status: 'resolved', decisionId: decision.id, combatant: setup.unicorn.id,\n      source: player.id, failedAbility: 'constitution', saveDc: 20,\n      effectSeverity: {\n        damageExpected: 4, imposedConditions: ['Poisoned'], forcedMovementFeet: null, removesTurn: false,\n      },\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('returns typed unresolved results when no legendary actor or no timeline is available', () => {\n    const player = playerProfile('ordinary-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const ordinary = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 4 }, combatants: [player], tokens: [placedToken(player, 0, 0)],\n    });\n    expect(provideLegendaryWindows({ state: ordinary, timeline: null, detail: 'compact' })).toMatchObject({\n      policy: LEGENDARY_WINDOWS_POLICY, status: 'unresolved', reason: 'no_legendary_actor',\n    });\n\n    const setup = startedEncounter(playerProfile('timeline-missing-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 }));\n    const intel = provideLegendaryWindows({ state: setup.state, timeline: null, detail: 'full' });\n    const unicorn = requireDetails(intel).actors[0];\n    if (unicorn === undefined || unicorn.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected Unicorn facts.');\n    expect(unicorn.nextWindow).toEqual({ status: 'unresolved', reason: 'timeline_unavailable' });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/symmetric-pc-evaluator.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2060","name":"symmetric scripted-PC evaluator chooses the hand-computed movement-evaluator optimum through actor knowledge"},{"id":"2061","name":"symmetric scripted-PC evaluator does not use full monster AC or HP when full knowledge would pick another target"},{"id":"2062","name":"symmetric scripted-PC evaluator keeps unknown AC and HP in typed tactical unresolved results"},{"id":"2063","name":"symmetric scripted-PC evaluator is deterministic for equal state and legal-command transcripts"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { armorClass, damageType, dieSides, feet } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { evaluateTacticalAttack } from '../../../src/combat/tactical-evaluator';\nimport {\n  DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_PC_DECISION_POLICY,\n  evaluateSymmetricPcDecision,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/symmetric-pc-evaluator';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ndeclareTestInputs({});\n\nfunction attack(\n  actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'],\n  target: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>['id'],\n  range: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }>['tacticalRange'],\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  if (range === undefined) throw new Error('The test attack requires a typed tactical range.');\n  return {\n    type: 'attack', actor, target, attackBonus: 5, criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true, tacticalRange: range,\n    damage: { terms: [{ type: damageType('Piercing'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(8), modifier: 3 } }], critical: false, responses: [] },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction ready(state: EncounterState, actorId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id']): EncounterState {\n  return {\n    ...state,\n    combatants: state.combatants.map((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === actorId\n      ? {\n          ...combatant,\n          turn: {\n            ...combatant.turn,\n            action: { kind: 'available' },\n            movement: { speed: feet(30), spent: feet(0), remaining: feet(30) },\n          },\n        }\n      : combatant),\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('symmetric scripted-PC evaluator', () => {\n  it('chooses the hand-computed movement-evaluator optimum through actor knowledge', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('symmetric-pc');\n    const target = monsterProfile('symmetric-target');\n    const state = ready(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(target, 3)],\n    }), actor.id);\n    const ranged = attack(actor.id, target.id, {\n      kind: 'ranged', normalRangeFeet: feet(10), longRangeFeet: feet(20),\n    });\n    const move: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'move' }> = {\n      type: 'move', actor: actor.id, path: [{ column: 1, row: 0 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    };\n\n    // At 15 feet the attack is legal only at long range. Moving 5 feet makes\n    // the distance 10 feet, exactly normal range, so movement-eval ranks it first.\n    const decision = evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({\n      state, actorId: actor.id, legalActions: [ranged, move, { type: 'end_turn', actor: actor.id }],\n    });\n\n    expect(DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_PC_DECISION_POLICY).toBe('symmetric_evaluator_v1');\n    expect(decision.policyVersions).toEqual({\n      tactical: 'tactical-evaluator-v2',\n      movement: 'movement-eval-v1',\n      concentration: 'concentration-intel-v1',\n      actorKnowledge: 'actor-knowledge-v2',\n    });\n    expect(decision.selected.command).toEqual(move);\n    const movement = decision.selected.movement;\n    if (movement?.status !== 'evaluated') throw new Error('Expected projected movement evaluation.');\n    expect(movement.evaluation.candidates.find((candidate) =>\n      candidate.destination.column === 1 && candidate.destination.row === 0)?.semantic).toEqual({\n      status: 'resolved', kind: 'move_5_to_normal_range',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('does not use full monster AC or HP when full knowledge would pick another target', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('symmetric-pc');\n    const alphaBase = monsterProfile('alpha', { hitPoints: 10 });\n    const betaBase = monsterProfile('beta', { hitPoints: 40 });\n    const alpha = { ...alphaBase, rules: { ...alphaBase.rules, armorClass: armorClass(18) } };\n    const beta = { ...betaBase, rules: { ...betaBase.rules, armorClass: armorClass(10) } };\n    const created = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 3, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [actor, alpha, beta],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(alpha, 1, 0), placedToken(beta, 1, 1)],\n    });\n    const state = ready({\n      ...created,\n      combatants: created.combatants.map((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === alpha.id\n        ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 1 }\n        : combatant),\n    }, actor.id);\n    const range = { kind: 'melee' as const, reachFeet: feet(5) };\n    const alphaAttack = attack(actor.id, alpha.id, range);\n    const betaAttack = attack(actor.id, beta.id, range);\n    const decision = evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({\n      state,\n      actorId: actor.id,\n      legalActions: [betaAttack, alphaAttack, { type: 'end_turn', actor: actor.id }],\n    });\n    const fullAlpha = evaluateTacticalAttack({\n      attackerId: actor.id, targetId: alpha.id, attackerPosition: { column: 0, row: 0 }, targetPosition: { column: 1, row: 0 },\n      range, attackBonus: 5, targetArmorClass: 18, criticalFloor: 20,\n      damageTerms: [{ dice: { count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 3 } }], attackerConditions: [], targetConditions: [],\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true, rollModeSources: [],\n      target: { hitPoints: 1, usesDeathSaves: false },\n    });\n    const fullBeta = evaluateTacticalAttack({\n      attackerId: actor.id, targetId: beta.id, attackerPosition: { column: 0, row: 0 }, targetPosition: { column: 1, row: 1 },\n      range, attackBonus: 5, targetArmorClass: 10, criticalFloor: 20,\n      damageTerms: [{ dice: { count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 3 } }], attackerConditions: [], targetConditions: [],\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true, rollModeSources: [],\n      target: { hitPoints: 40, usesDeathSaves: false },\n    });\n    if (fullAlpha.damage.status !== 'resolved' || fullBeta.damage.status !== 'resolved') {\n      throw new Error('Full-knowledge comparison must resolve both attacks.');\n    }\n\n    // Full knowledge favours beta's AC 10. The PC receives only AC bands and\n    // never turns either band or alpha's 1 HP into a numeric evaluator input.\n    expect(fullBeta.damage.expectedDamage).toBeGreaterThan(fullAlpha.damage.expectedDamage);\n    expect(decision.selected.command).toEqual(alphaAttack);\n    expect(decision.actorKnowledge.targets.map((targetKnowledge) => targetKnowledge.kind === 'perceived'\n      ? [targetKnowledge.targetId, targetKnowledge.armorClass, targetKnowledge.hitPoints]\n      : [targetKnowledge.targetId, targetKnowledge.kind])).toEqual([\n      [alpha.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'heavily_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'near_death' }],\n      [beta.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'lightly_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'uninjured' }],\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('keeps unknown AC and HP in typed tactical unresolved results', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('symmetric-pc');\n    const target = monsterProfile('unknown-target');\n    const state = ready(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 3, rows: 1 }, combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(target, 1)],\n    }), actor.id);\n    const command = attack(actor.id, target.id, { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: feet(5) });\n    const decision = evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({\n      state, actorId: actor.id, legalActions: [command, { type: 'end_turn', actor: actor.id }],\n    });\n    const tactical = decision.selected.tactical;\n    if (tactical?.status !== 'evaluated') throw new Error('Expected an evaluated tactical input.');\n\n    expect(tactical.evaluation.probabilities).toEqual({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_armor_class_unresolved',\n    });\n    expect(tactical.evaluation.damage).toEqual({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_armor_class_unresolved',\n    });\n    expect(tactical.evaluation.consequences).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_hit_points_unresolved',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('is deterministic for equal state and legal-command transcripts', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('symmetric-pc');\n    const target = monsterProfile('deterministic-target');\n    const state = ready(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 3, rows: 1 }, combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(target, 1)],\n    }), actor.id);\n    const legalActions = [\n      attack(actor.id, target.id, { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: feet(5) }),\n      { type: 'dodge' as const, actor: actor.id },\n      { type: 'end_turn' as const, actor: actor.id },\n    ];\n\n    expect(evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({ state, actorId: actor.id, legalActions }))\n      .toEqual(evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({ state: structuredClone(state), actorId: actor.id, legalActions: structuredClone(legalActions) }));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/detection-ui.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2064","name":"D373 detection UI projections tray_hides_autofire: always-policy auto-fire remains a non-interactive tray audit entry"},{"id":"2065","name":"D373 detection UI projections projects queued decision context and the typed turn-boundary refusal highlight"},{"id":"2066","name":"D373 detection UI projections keeps the tray non-blocking until end turn, then allows a retry after resolution"},{"id":"2067","name":"D373 detection UI projections hidden_token_rendered: hidden occupants become fog-only cells in DM and shared board data"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { ControllerRegistry, HumanController, type ControllerIdentity } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { projectDmView, projectPlayerView } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { encounterBoardRenderModel, projectEncounterBoard } from '../../../src/vtt/encounter-board';\nimport { projectDmBoard, projectPlayerBoard } from '../../../src/vtt/encounter-projections';\nimport { REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART } from '../../../src/vtt/reference-encounter-art';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst IDLE = {\n  requestSequence: 1,\n  pendingRequest: null,\n  pendingCommand: null,\n  continuation: { kind: 'idle' as const },\n  pause: null,\n};\n\nfunction face(value: number): () => number {\n  return () => (value - 0.5) / 20;\n}\n\nfunction encounter(policy: 'ask' | 'always' = 'ask'): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly mover: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>;\n  readonly reactor: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>;\n} {\n  const mover = playerProfile('detection-ui-mover', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const reactor = monsterProfile('detection-ui-reactor', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [mover, reactor],\n    tokens: [placedToken(mover, 1, 1), placedToken(reactor, 0, 1)],\n    reactionPolicies: [{ combatant: reactor.id, reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack', policy }],\n  });\n  return {\n    state: reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, face(10)).state,\n    mover,\n    reactor,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction identities(state: EncounterState): readonly ControllerIdentity[] {\n  return state.combatants.map((subject) => ({\n    combatantId: subject.profile.id,\n    controllerId: `${subject.profile.id}:human:test`,\n    kind: 'human',\n    generation: 0,\n  }));\n}\n\ndescribe('D373 detection UI projections', () => {\n  it('tray_hides_autofire: always-policy auto-fire remains a non-interactive tray audit entry', () => {\n    const setup = encounter('always');\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.mover.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    const projection = projectDmBoard({\n      view: projectDmView(moved),\n      coordinator: IDLE,\n      controllers: identities(moved),\n      history: [],\n    });\n\n    expect(projection.decisionTray.entries).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'auto_fire_log',\n      combatantId: setup.reactor.id,\n      reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack',\n      policy: 'always',\n      resolution: 'accept',\n      autoFired: true,\n      interactive: false,\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('projects queued decision context and the typed turn-boundary refusal highlight', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.mover.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    const projection = projectDmBoard({\n      view: projectDmView(moved),\n      coordinator: IDLE,\n      controllers: identities(moved),\n      history: [],\n      boundaryRefusal: {\n        code: 'turn_boundary_blocked',\n        message: 'The turn cannot advance while a pending decision for this boundary is unresolved.',\n      },\n    });\n\n    expect(projection.decisionTray.entries[0]).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'pending',\n      combatantName: 'detection-ui-reactor',\n      triggerContext: expect.stringContaining('moved from 1,1 to 2,1'),\n      interactive: true,\n    });\n    expect(projection.decisionTray.boundaryRefusal).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      code: 'turn_boundary_blocked',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('keeps the tray non-blocking until end turn, then allows a retry after resolution', async () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.mover.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    const moverController = new HumanController();\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n      moved,\n      new ControllerRegistry([\n        { combatantId: setup.mover.id, controller: moverController, controllerId: 'controller:mover' },\n        { combatantId: setup.reactor.id, controller: new HumanController(), controllerId: 'controller:reactor' },\n      ]),\n      face(10),\n      {\n        pendingDecisionTray: true,\n        turnLegalActions: (_state, actor) => ({ actions: [{ type: 'end_turn', actor }] }),\n      },\n    );\n    const pendingStep = coordinator.step();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const request = moverController.pendingRequest();\n    if (request === null) throw new Error('Expected the mover turn request.');\n    moverController.submit({\n      requestId: request.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: setup.mover.id },\n    });\n    const refusal = await pendingStep;\n    expect(refusal).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'refused',\n      pendingDecisionCode: 'turn_boundary_blocked',\n    });\n\n    const decision = coordinator.state().pendingDecisions[0];\n    if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Expected a queued tray decision.');\n    expect(coordinator.resolvePendingDecision({\n      type: 'resolve_pending_decision', decisionId: decision.id, optionId: 'decline',\n    }).kind).toBe('applied');\n    expect(coordinator.state().activeCombatant).toBe(setup.mover.id);\n    const resumedStep = coordinator.step();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const resumedRequest = moverController.pendingRequest();\n    if (resumedRequest === null) throw new Error('Expected the resumed mover turn request.');\n    moverController.submit({\n      requestId: resumedRequest.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: resumedRequest.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: setup.mover.id },\n    });\n    expect((await resumedStep).kind).toBe('applied');\n    expect(coordinator.state().activeCombatant).toBe(setup.reactor.id);\n  });\n\n  it('hidden_token_rendered: hidden occupants become fog-only cells in DM and shared board data', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const hidden: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      hiddenCombatants: [{ combatant: setup.reactor.id, stealthTotal: 18, edition: '2024' }],\n    };\n    const dmBoard = projectEncounterBoard(projectDmView(hidden));\n    const dmCell = encounterBoardRenderModel(dmBoard, {\n      ...REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART,\n      room: { ...REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART.room, columns: 6, rows: 3 },\n      combatantTokens: {\n        ...REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART.combatantTokens,\n        [setup.mover.id]: REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART.combatantTokens['combatant:fighter']!,\n        [setup.reactor.id]: REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART.combatantTokens['combatant:training-brute']!,\n      },\n    }).find((cell) => cell.key === '0,1');\n    expect(dmCell?.layers).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ role: 'fog' }));\n    expect(dmCell?.token).toBeNull();\n    expect(dmBoard.combatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).not.toContain(setup.reactor.id);\n\n    const playerView = projectPlayerView(hidden, {\n      seatId: 'seat:detection-ui',\n      combatantId: setup.mover.id,\n      ownedCombatantIds: [setup.mover.id],\n    });\n    const playerBoard = projectPlayerBoard(playerView, IDLE);\n    expect(playerBoard.concealedCells).toContainEqual({ column: 0, row: 1 });\n    expect(playerBoard.combatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).not.toContain(setup.reactor.id);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/watabou-adapter.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2068","name":"Watabou One Page Dungeon adapter maps documented rectangles, doors, notes, and provenance into reducer state"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { reduceEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport {\n  adaptWatabouDungeon,\n  decodeWatabouDungeon,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/watabou-adapter';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\n\nconst FIXTURE = 'tests/fixtures/watabou/one-page-dungeon-sample.json' as const;\nconst inputs = declareTestInputs({ fixtures: [FIXTURE] });\n\ndescribe('Watabou One Page Dungeon adapter', () => {\n  it('maps documented rectangles, doors, notes, and provenance into reducer state', () => {\n    const source: unknown = JSON.parse(inputs.fixtures.readText(FIXTURE));\n    const decoded = decodeWatabouDungeon(source);\n    const encounter = adaptWatabouDungeon(source, { seed: 1_143_801_683 });\n\n    expect(decoded.rects).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(encounter.provenance).toEqual({\n      source: 'watabou',\n      licenseTag: 'LicenseRef-Watabou-Output-Free-Use',\n      seed: 1_143_801_683,\n    });\n    expect(encounter.state.bounds).toEqual({ columns: 14, rows: 12 });\n    expect(encounter.state.worldObjects).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'door', position: { column: 7, row: 4 } }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'door', position: { column: 0, row: 2 } }),\n    ]));\n    expect(encounter.state.dmNotes).toContain('1: A brazier marks the old crossing.');\n\n    const started = reduceEncounter(encounter.state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, mulberry32(7));\n    expect(started.state.revision).toBe(1);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/actor-knowledge.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2069","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 projects a visible target as perceived with its current position"},{"id":"2070","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 projects PC actor knowledge as hand-computed bands without numeric AC or HP"},{"id":"2071","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 projects only visibly manifest conditions as positive markers"},{"id":"2072","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 observes a public reaction spend but never infers availability from no spend"},{"id":"2073","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 redacts a hidden target rather than exposing its position"},{"id":"2074","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 redacts a target in fog even when ordinary detection could see its cell"},{"id":"2075","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 records missing last-seen memory as a typed unresolved basis"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { effectStackingIdentity, encounterEffectId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  ACTOR_KNOWLEDGE_POLICY,\n  projectActorKnowledge,\n  type ActorTargetKnowledge,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/intel/actor-knowledge';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ndeclareTestInputs({});\n\nfunction encounter(overrides: Partial<Pick<\n  Parameters<typeof createEncounter>[0],\n  'blockedCells' | 'foggedCells'\n>> = {}): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly actor: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>;\n  readonly target: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>;\n} {\n  const actor = monsterProfile('actor-knowledge-monster');\n  const target = playerProfile('actor-knowledge-player');\n  return {\n    actor,\n    target,\n    state: createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(target, 2)],\n      ...overrides,\n    }),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction onlyTarget(state: EncounterState, actor: CombatantProfile): ActorTargetKnowledge {\n  const projection = projectActorKnowledge(state, actor.id);\n  expect(projection.policy).toBe(ACTOR_KNOWLEDGE_POLICY);\n  expect(projection.targets).toHaveLength(1);\n  const target = projection.targets[0];\n  if (target === undefined) throw new Error('Expected exactly one projected target.');\n  return target;\n}\n\ndescribe('actor-knowledge-v2', () => {\n  it('projects a visible target as perceived with its current position', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n\n    expect(onlyTarget(setup.state, setup.actor)).toEqual({\n      kind: 'perceived',\n      targetId: setup.target.id,\n      position: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n      conditions: [],\n      armorClass: { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'guarded' },\n      hitPoints: { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'uninjured' },\n      reciprocalVisibility: { kind: 'perceived', targetCanSeeActor: true },\n      reaction: { kind: 'unknown' },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('projects PC actor knowledge as hand-computed bands without numeric AC or HP', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('actor-knowledge-pc');\n    const uninjured = monsterProfile('actor-knowledge-uninjured', { hitPoints: 12 });\n    const bloodied = monsterProfile('actor-knowledge-bloodied', { hitPoints: 12 });\n    const nearDeath = monsterProfile('actor-knowledge-near-death', { hitPoints: 12 });\n    const created = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [actor, uninjured, bloodied, nearDeath],\n      tokens: [\n        placedToken(actor, 0),\n        placedToken(uninjured, 1),\n        placedToken(bloodied, 2),\n        placedToken(nearDeath, 3),\n      ],\n    });\n    const state: EncounterState = {\n      ...created,\n      combatants: created.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.profile.id === bloodied.id\n          ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 7 }\n          : combatant.profile.id === nearDeath.id\n            ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 3 }\n            : combatant),\n    };\n\n    const projection = projectActorKnowledge(state, actor.id);\n    expect(projection.policy).toBe('actor-knowledge-v2');\n    expect(projection.targets.map((target) => target.kind === 'perceived'\n      ? [target.targetId, target.armorClass, target.hitPoints]\n      : [target.targetId, target.kind])).toEqual([\n      [bloodied.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'lightly_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'bloodied' }],\n      [nearDeath.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'lightly_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'near_death' }],\n      [uninjured.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'lightly_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'uninjured' }],\n    ]);\n    for (const target of projection.targets) {\n      if (target.kind !== 'perceived') throw new Error('Expected a perceived target.');\n      expect('value' in target.armorClass).toBe(false);\n      expect('value' in target.hitPoints).toBe(false);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('projects only visibly manifest conditions as positive markers', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const state: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      effects: [{\n        id: encounterEffectId('effect:actor-knowledge-prone'),\n        source: setup.actor.id,\n        targets: [setup.target.id],\n        createdRevision: 0,\n        duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n        concentrationOwner: null,\n        stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('actor-knowledge-prone'),\n        stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n        repeatedSave: null,\n        payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Prone' },\n      }],\n    };\n\n    expect(onlyTarget(state, setup.actor)).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'perceived',\n      conditions: [{ kind: 'perceived', condition: 'Prone' }],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('observes a public reaction spend but never infers availability from no spend', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const unobserved: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      combatants: setup.state.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.profile.id === setup.target.id\n          ? { ...combatant, turn: { ...combatant.turn, reactionAvailable: false } }\n          : combatant),\n    };\n    expect(onlyTarget(unobserved, setup.actor)).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'perceived', reaction: { kind: 'unknown' },\n    });\n\n    const observed: EncounterState = {\n      ...unobserved,\n      eventLog: [\n        { sequence: 1, type: 'turn_started', combatant: setup.target.id, round: 1 },\n        {\n          sequence: 2,\n          type: 'resource_spent',\n          combatant: setup.target.id,\n          resource: 'reaction',\n          purpose: 'Opportunity Attack',\n        },\n      ],\n    };\n    expect(onlyTarget(observed, setup.actor)).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'perceived', reaction: { kind: 'observed_spent' },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('redacts a hidden target rather than exposing its position', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const hidden: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      hiddenCombatants: [{ combatant: setup.target.id, stealthTotal: 18, edition: '2024' }],\n    };\n\n    const target = onlyTarget(hidden, setup.actor);\n    expect(target).toMatchObject({ kind: 'unknown', targetId: setup.target.id });\n    expect('position' in target).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('redacts a target in fog even when ordinary detection could see its cell', () => {\n    const setup = encounter({ foggedCells: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }] });\n\n    expect(onlyTarget(setup.state, setup.actor)).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'unknown',\n      targetId: setup.target.id,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('records missing last-seen memory as a typed unresolved basis', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const hidden: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      hiddenCombatants: [{ combatant: setup.target.id, stealthTotal: 18, edition: '2024' }],\n    };\n\n    expect(onlyTarget(hidden, setup.actor)).toEqual({\n      kind: 'unknown',\n      targetId: setup.target.id,\n      lastSeen: {\n        status: 'unresolved',\n        reason: 'last_seen_position_not_modeled',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/projected-movement-options.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2076","name":"projected movement options matches the full movement decision when every movement-sensitive fact is observed"},{"id":"2077","name":"projected movement options makes opportunity risk unresolved when no reaction spend was observed"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { monsterCombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { MovementEvaluation } from '../../../src/combat/movement-evaluator';\nimport { GOBLIN_WARRIOR } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/monsters';\nimport { feet } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  canonicalEngineQueryPort,\n  projectedMovementOptions,\n  type EngineProjectedMovementRequest,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/engine-query-port';\nimport { projectActorKnowledge } from '../../../src/vtt/intel/actor-knowledge';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\nimport { placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ndeclareTestInputs({});\n\nfunction encounter(reaction: 'observed_spent' | 'unknown'): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly actorId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'];\n  readonly targetId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'];\n} {\n  const actor = monsterCombatantProfile(GOBLIN_WARRIOR, {\n    combatantId: 'combatant:projected-goblin',\n    tokenId: 'token:projected-goblin',\n  });\n  const target = playerProfile('projected-fighter');\n  const created = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n    combatants: [actor, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(target, 0), placedToken(actor, 1)],\n  });\n  const state: EncounterState = {\n    ...created,\n    combatants: created.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n      combatant.profile.id === actor.id\n        ? {\n            ...combatant,\n            turn: {\n              ...combatant.turn,\n              action: { kind: 'available' },\n              bonusActionAvailable: true,\n              reactionAvailable: true,\n              movement: { speed: feet(30), spent: feet(0), remaining: feet(30) },\n            },\n          }\n        : combatant.profile.id === target.id\n          ? {\n              ...combatant,\n              turn: {\n                ...combatant.turn,\n                reactionAvailable: reaction === 'unknown',\n              },\n            }\n          : combatant),\n    eventLog: reaction === 'observed_spent'\n      ? [\n          { sequence: 1, type: 'turn_started', combatant: target.id, round: 1 },\n          {\n            sequence: 2,\n            type: 'resource_spent',\n            combatant: target.id,\n            resource: 'reaction',\n            purpose: 'Opportunity Attack',\n          },\n        ]\n      : [],\n  };\n  return { state, actorId: actor.id, targetId: target.id };\n}\n\nfunction request(\n  actorId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'],\n  targetId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'],\n): EngineProjectedMovementRequest {\n  return {\n    actorId,\n    targetId,\n    attack: {\n      range: { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: feet(5) },\n      attackBonus: 4,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      damageTerms: [{ dice: { count: 1, sides: 6, modifier: 2 } }],\n      attackerConditions: [],\n      rollModeSources: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction movementDecision(evaluation: MovementEvaluation) {\n  return {\n    start: evaluation.start,\n    earliestAttackTurn: evaluation.earliestAttackTurn,\n    candidates: evaluation.candidates.map((candidate) => ({\n      destination: candidate.destination,\n      path: candidate.path,\n      semantic: candidate.semantic,\n      beforeRange: candidate.before.status === 'resolved'\n        ? candidate.before.evaluation.range\n        : candidate.before,\n      afterRange: candidate.after.status === 'resolved'\n        ? candidate.after.evaluation.range\n        : candidate.after,\n    })),\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('projected movement options', () => {\n  it('matches the full movement decision when every movement-sensitive fact is observed', () => {\n    const setup = encounter('observed_spent');\n    const projection = projectActorKnowledge(setup.state, setup.actorId);\n    const projected = projectedMovementOptions(\n      setup.state,\n      projection,\n      request(setup.actorId, setup.targetId),\n    );\n    const full = canonicalEngineQueryPort.movementOptions(\n      setup.state,\n      setup.actorId,\n      setup.targetId,\n      'scimitar',\n    );\n    if (projected === null || full === null) throw new Error('Expected both movement evaluations.');\n\n    expect(movementDecision(projected)).toEqual(movementDecision(full));\n    expect(projected.candidates.every((candidate) => candidate.path.status !== 'found' ||\n      candidate.path.opportunityAttackRisk.status === 'resolved')).toBe(true);\n    const first = projected.candidates[0];\n    if (first?.before.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Projected tactical input is absent.');\n    expect(first.before.evaluation.probabilities).toEqual({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_armor_class_unresolved',\n    });\n    expect(first.before.evaluation.consequences).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_hit_points_unresolved',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('makes opportunity risk unresolved when no reaction spend was observed', () => {\n    const setup = encounter('unknown');\n    const projection = projectActorKnowledge(setup.state, setup.actorId);\n    const projected = projectedMovementOptions(\n      setup.state,\n      projection,\n      request(setup.actorId, setup.targetId),\n    );\n    const full = canonicalEngineQueryPort.movementOptions(\n      setup.state,\n      setup.actorId,\n      setup.targetId,\n      'scimitar',\n    );\n    if (projected === null || full === null) throw new Error('Expected both movement evaluations.');\n    const retreat = projected.candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.destination.column === 2);\n    const fullRetreat = full.candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.destination.column === 2);\n    if (retreat?.path.status !== 'found' || fullRetreat?.path.status !== 'found') {\n      throw new Error('Expected the one-square retreat candidate.');\n    }\n\n    expect(retreat.path.opportunityAttackRisk).toEqual({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'opportunity_attack_eligibility_unresolved',\n    });\n    expect(fullRetreat.path.opportunityAttackRisk).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'resolved', atRisk: true,\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/alerting.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2078","name":"D420 NPC help-calling normalizes a pre-D420 state with every roster combatant participating"},{"id":"2079","name":"D420 NPC help-calling treats an unlisted existing combatant as participating and emits no unconfigured help call"},{"id":"2080","name":"D420 NPC help-calling joins exactly nearby NPCs within yelling distance and excludes one cell farther"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { defaultEncounterAlertingState, yellingDistance } from '../../../src/combat/alerting';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, feet } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst fixedD20 = (face: number) => () => (face - 0.5) / 20;\n\nfunction requiredAlerting(state: EncounterState) {\n  if (state.alerting === undefined) throw new Error('Expected persisted D420 alerting state.');\n  return state.alerting;\n}\n\nfunction attack(\n  actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n  target: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{\n        type: damageType('Force'),\n        dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 0 },\n      }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('D420 NPC help-calling', () => {\n  it('normalizes a pre-D420 state with every roster combatant participating', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('legacy-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('legacy-monster', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const created = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 0), placedToken(monster, 2)],\n    });\n    const preD420Record = structuredClone(created) as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;\n    delete preD420Record['alerting'];\n    delete preD420Record['searchMemories'];\n    const serialized = JSON.stringify(created);\n    expect(serialized).toBe(JSON.stringify(preD420Record));\n    const legacyRecord = JSON.parse(serialized) as unknown;\n\n    const result = reduceEncounter(\n      legacyRecord as EncounterState,\n      { type: 'roll_initiative' },\n      fixedD20(10),\n    );\n\n    expect(result.state.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([pc.id, monster.id]);\n    expect(result.state.searchMemories).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(result.state.alerting).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it('treats an unlisted existing combatant as participating and emits no
